Mishneh Torah, Offerings for Unintention:
Kol davar shechayyavin al shiggato chattat kevua im shaggu bet din haggadol behoraa vehoru lehattiro veshaggu haam behoraatan veasu haam vehem somchin al horaatan veachar kach noda levet din shettau hare bet din chayyavin lehavi karban chattat al shiggatan behoraa veaf al pi shello asu hen beatzman maase sheen mashgichin al asiyyat bet din kelal ben asu ben lo asu ella al horaatan bilvad. ushear haam peturin min hakkarban veaf al pi shehem haosin mippene shettalu bevet din. uma hu hakkarban shemmeviin al shegaga zo. im baavoda zara shaggu vehoru meviin par leola vesair lechattat mikkol shevet veshevet vekarban ze hu haamur befarashat shelach lecha shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 24)</small> "vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga" mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbeshiggat avoda zara hu medabber. veim bishar keretot shechayyavin al shiggatan chattat kevua shaggu vehoru. mevi kol shevet veshevet par chattat vezehu haamur befarashat vayyikra shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 13)</small> "veim kol adat yisrael yishgu". nimtzeta lamed sheim shaggu bet din haggadol behoraa baavoda zara meviin kol hakkahal shenem asar parim olot ushenem asar seirim chattaot vehem nisrafot shehare daman nichnas lefanim vehem hannikrain seire avoda zara. veim bishar hammitzvot shaggu meviin shenem asar parim chattaot vehen nisrafot mippene sheddamam nichnas lefanim. vechol par mehen nikra par helem davar shel tzibbur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 14)</small> "vehikriv hakkahal" kol kahal vekahal vechol shevet veshevet karuy kahal shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 20 5)</small> "vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda". ben sheasu kol yisrael shebbeeretz yisrael al pi bet din shehoru ben sheasu rov yisrael af al pi shehen miut minyan hashshevatim. ben sheasu rov hashshevatim af al pi shehen miut kol yisrael. meviin keminyan kol hashshevatim par lechol shevet veshevet uvaavoda zara par vesair lechol shevet veshevet. sheaf ellu shello chatu meviin al yede hachotim. afillu asa shevet echad bilvad vehu rov hakkahal hare kol hatztzibbur meviin shenem asar parim uvaavoda zara shenem asar parim ushenem asar seirim:
Bet din shennistappek lahen im shaggu behoraa o lo shaggu enan chayyavin beasham taluy shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 14)</small> "venoda hachattat" ad shettivvada veachar kach yitchayyevu bekarban kemo sheyyitbaer. bamme devarim amurim shebbet din chayyavin veellu haosim al pihem peturin min hakkarban. keshehayu hammorim bet din haggadol shel shivim veechad veyihye rosh yeshiva immahen behoraa veyihyu kullan reuyin lehoraa veyitu kullan o rubban bedavar ze shehoru bo veyoru beferush veyomru laam muttarin attem laasot. vechen ellu sheshshamu mippi bet din im amru laacherim muttarim attem laasot veyaasu kol hakkahal o rubbo al pihem veyihyu haosim shoggim al pihem umedammim shehaddavar shehoru bo kaddat horu. veyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat lo sheyyaakru kol hagguf uchesheyyivvada lahem yedu gufo shel davar shehoru bo bishgaga. bechol ellu hameoraim hu shehayu bet din chayyavin bekarban vehaose al pihem patur. aval im chaser achat mikkol ellu hadderachim hare bet din peturin min hakkarban vechol mi sheshshagag veasa maase mevi chattat kevua al shiggato:

Ketzad im chaser achat mikkol hadderachim shebbearnu yippatru bet din veyitchayyevu haosim. hare shehoru bet din shel echad min hashshevatim lahem shechelev hakkeva muttar vaachaluhu anshe mekomam al pihem oto bet din peturin vechol mi sheachal mevi chattat kevua al shiggato. vechen im horu bet din haggadol sheddam hallev muttar velo haya rosh yeshiva immahen o shehaya echad mehen eno rauy lihyot memunne besanhedrin kegon shehaya ger o mamzer o zaken o shello raa banim vechayyotze bahen veasu haam al pihem veachlu dam hallev hare bet din peturin vechol mi sheachal mevi chattat kevua al shiggato. uminnayin sheen hakkatuv medabber ella bevet din haggadol shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 13)</small> "veim kol adat yisrael yishgu" vegomer. uminnayin shead sheyyihyu kullan reuyin lehoraa shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 24)</small> "veim meene haeda" ad sheyyihyu lahem keenayim. ulehallan hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la 24)</small> "veshaftu haeda" ma haeda haamura bedine nefashot kullan reuyin lehoraa af eda haamura bishgaga zo ad sheyyihyu kullan reuyin lehoraa. vechen im horu veyada echad mehen shettau veamar lahem toim attem verabbu alav hammattirim vehittiru. hare bet din peturin vechol mi sheasa al pihem chayyav lehavi chattat kevua al shiggato. shenneemar veim kol adat yisrael yishgu ad sheyyishgu kol hassanhedrin. yada echad min hassanhedrin o miutan shettau hammattirin veshatku hoil vehoru velo haya sham cholek ufashta hahoraa berov hakkahal hare bet din chayyavin bekarban vechol sheasa al pihem patur. veellu sheshshatku im asu al pi ellu shehoru hare ellu chayyavin mippene shello talu bevet din. vechen im nasu venatnu baddavar veamru davar ze muttar hu velo horu laam velo amru lahem muttarin attem laasot veshama hashshomea mehen beet sheggamru muttar vehalach veasa kefi ma sheshshama hare kol haose chayyav chattat kevua uvet din peturin shehare lo horu lahem beferush laasot. vechen im horu veasu miut hakkahal al pihem venoda hashshegaga. hare bet din peturin veellu hammiut sheasu chayyavin vechol echad veechad mevi chattato: 
Vehassanhedrin atzman sheasu behoraatan enan mitztarfin lerov hakkahal. ad sheyyihyu harov sheasu chutz min hassanhedrin. asu rov anshe eretz yisrael al pihem. af al pi sheellu haosim shevet echad. vechen im asu rov hashshevatim af al pi shehen miut hakkahal. bet din chayyavim vehaosin peturin. ketzad. hayu yoshve eretz yisrael shesh meot elef veechad. vehayu haosin behoraat bet din shelosh meot elef veechad vahare kullan bene yehuda bilvad. o shehayu haosim bene shiva shevatim kullan af al pi sheyyesh bahen mea elef. hare bet din chayyavin vechol haosim al pihem peturin. veen mashgichin al yoshve chutza laaretz sheen karuy kahal ella bene eretz yisrael. veshevet menashshe veefrayim enan chashuvin kishne shevatim lainyan hazze ella shenehem shevet echad:
Hayu haosim merubbin bishat hachet umuatin bishat yedia. o muatin bishat hachet umerubbin bishat yedia. hakkol holech achar sheat hammaase:
Horu bet din bechelev min hachalavim shehu muttar veachal miut hakkahal al pihem venoda lahem shechatu vechazru bahen. veachar kach horu sheavoda zara pelonit mutteret veavad otah avoda zara miut acher al pihem. uchesheyyitztarfu haochlim laovdim yihyu rov. hare ellu mitztarfin af al pi shehayta lahen yedia bentayim. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammore bet din echad. aval im met bet din shehora techilla veamad acher vehoru en ellu mitztarfin leellu:
Afillu horu shene batte haddinim bedavar echad kegon chelev vechelev. o dam vedam. vechen im lo hayu haosim shoggin al pi hahoraa. hare bet din peturin vechol haosim chayyavin. ketzad. horu bet din leechol chelev hakkeva kullo. veyada echad min hakkahal shettau veshechelev hakkeva asur veachlu mippene horaatan. shehaya ole al datan shemmitzva lishmoa mibbet din af al pi shehem toim. hare ze haochel chayyav chattat kevua al achilato. veeno mitztaref leminyan hashshoggim al pihem. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ze sheyyada shettau chacham o talmid shehiggia lehoraa. aval im haya am haaretz hare ze patur sheen yediato beissurin yedia vaddait umitztaref lichlal hashshoggim al pihem. vechen im lo yada shettau venitkavvin leechol shumman vechelev veachal chelev hakkeva shehittiruhu vehu lo yada shehu chelev keva. hare ze chayyav mippene sheachilato mippene shiggato lo mippene hahoraa. veeno mitztaref leminyan hashshoggim al pihem shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 26)</small> "lechol haam bishgaga". ad shettihye shegaga achat lakkol. vechen im tala beatzmo veachal chelev hakkeva shehoru lehattiro lo mippene horaatan ella mippene shehu muttar bedato hare ze chayyav chattat kevua bifne atzmo. ze hakkelal kol hattole bevet din patur vehu sheyyihyu sham kol hadderachim shemmaninu. vechol hachayyav bifne atzmo eno mitztaref lerov hashshoggim:
Horu bet din lehattir davar haasur bezadon veasu hakkahal al pihem bishgaga bet din peturin min hakkarban mippene shehen mezidin. vechol echad veechad min haosim al pihem chayyav karban bifne atzmo mippene shehu shogeg. horu bet din bishgaga veyadu hakkahal shettau vesheen rauy lekabbel mehen veaf al pi ken asu hakkahal al pihem. ellu veellu peturin min hakkarban. bet din peturin shehare lo asu hakkahal mippene horaatan shehitatam. vechol haosim peturin min hakkarban mippene shemmezidin hem shehare yadu shettau vesheen rauy laasot:

Vet din sheshshaggu vehoru laakor guf miggufe tora veasu kol haam al pihem bet din peturin vechol echad veechad min haosim chayyav chattat kevua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 13)</small> "venelam davar" velo kol hagguf:
Leolam en bet din chayyavin ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat bidvarim sheenan meforashin battora umevoarim veachar kach yihyu bet din chayyavin bekarban vehaosim al pihem peturin. ketzad. shaggu vehoru shemmuttar lehishtachavot laavoda zara. o shemmuttar lehotzi mershut lirshut beshabbat. o shemmuttar lavo al shomeret yom keneged yom. hare ellu kemi sheamru en shabbat battora o en avoda zara battora o en nidda battora sheakru kol hagguf veen zo vechayyotze baze shiggat horaa ella shichcha. lefichach peturin min hakkarban vechol haose al pihen chayyav chattat bifne atzmo. aval im tau vehoru veamru hammotzi mershut lirshut hu shechayyav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 29)</small> "al yetze ish mimmekomo" aval hazzorek o hammoshit muttar. o sheakru av meavot melachot vehoru sheenah melacha. hare ellu chayyavin. vechen im tau veamru hammishtachave laavoda zara befishshut yadayim veraglayim hu hachayyav shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 34 14)</small> "lo tishtachave leel acher" aval hakkorea al haaretz velo pashat yadav veraglav hare hu muttar hare ellu chayyavin. vechen im tau veamru habba al shomeret yom keneged yom sheraata dam bayyom hu chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 26)</small> "kol yeme zovah" aval raata ballayla muttar lavo aleha. vechen im horu veamru shemmi sheppersa ishto nidda bishat tashmish muttar lifrosh mimmenna keshehu mitkashshe. hare ellu chayyavin. vechen im tau veamru shehaochel dam sheyyatza bishat shechita hu hachayyav aval haochel dam hallev muttar hare ellu chayyavim. vechen kol kayyotze betaeyyot ellu im horu bahen veasu rov hakkahal al pihen peturin uvet din meviin karban al shiggatan:
Horu bet din sheyyatza hashshabbat lefi shennitkasset hachamma vedimmu sheshshaka chamma veachar kach zarcha en zo horaa ella taut vechol sheasa melacha chayyav aval bet din peturin. vechen im hittiru bet din eshet ish lehinnase lefi sheheidu bifnehem shemmet balah veachar kach ba balah en zo horaa ella taut vehaishsha uvalah haacharon chayyavin chattat al shiggatan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Bet din shehoru bishgaga veshachchu atzmo shel chet shehoru bo. af al pi shehen yodim bevadday shechatu bishgaga veaf al pi shehaam modiin otan veomrim lahen bechach vechach horetem lanu. hem peturin vehaosim al pihem chayyavin bifne atzman. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 14)</small> "venoda hachattat asher chatu aleha" lo sheyyodiu oto hachotim. ketzad. shaggu vehittiru chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva vaachaluhu rov haam veachar sheyyadu sheshshagu behoraa veshehittiru davar shechayyavim al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat kevua nistappek lahem im miktzat hachalavim hittiru o miktzat haddamim hittiru hare ellu peturin vechol mi sheachal mevi chattat kevua:
Bet din shehoru bishgaga venoda lahem shiggatan ben sheheviu kapparatan ben shello heviu kol haose kefi horaatan sheppashta berov hatztzibbur meachar sheyyadu hare ze mevi asham taluy. hoil vehaya lo lishl bechol et al devarim shennitchaddeshu bevet din velo shaal hare ze kemi shennistappek lo im chata o lo chata. bamme devarim amurim bemi shehaya im bet din bammedina. aval mi sheraa hahoraa vehalach limdina acheret af al pi sheasa achar sheyyadu patur mippene shettala bahen vahare i efshar lo lishl. velo od ella hannivhal latzet af al pi sheadayin lo yatza ladderech veasa al pihem meachar sheyyadu hare ze patur:

Kevar bearnu shekkol shegaga shehahedyot mevi aleha chattat hakkevua kisba o seira im shagag bah hannasi mevi sair veim shagag bah kohen mashiach mevi par. bamme devarim amurim shekkohen mashiach mevi par al shiggato keshettaa behoraat atzmo veasa maase beshiggat horaato levaddah vehu sheyyihye chacham mufla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 3)</small> "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta leashmat haam" hare mashiach ketzibbur ma hatztzibbur shehen bet din enan chayyavin bekarban ad sheyyihyu chachamim reuyin lehoraa veyitu behoraa veyaasu haosim al pihem veyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat kach hammashiach bechol hadderachim haellu:
Ketzad. kohen mashiach shettaa behoraa leatzmo. vedimma shehazzorek mershut lirshut beshabbat muttar vezarak mershut lirshut vehu tole behoraato leatzmo. kesheyyivvada lo cheto yavi par lechattat. aval im lo tala behoraato ella shagag vezarak bishgaga. o shettala behoraato velo haya chacham mufla. o sheakar kol hagguf behoraato leatzmo. o sheshshagag behoraato levattel miktzat velo asa vehu somech al horaato ella asa bishgaga acheret. o shehaya mezid behoraa veshagag bemaase hare ze patur mikkarban kelal sheddino lehoraat atzmo kedin hakkahal lehoraat bet din lechol davar. hora leatzmo veshachach mee ze taam hora uvishat maase amar hareni ose al daat horaati hare ze mevi par chattat:
Hora leatzmo levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat baavoda zara veasa kefi horaato. hare ze mevi seira kehedyot vehu sheyyishgog behoraa kemo shebbearnu. sheen hakkohen hammashiach chayyav karban ella behelem davar behoraa im shiggat hammaase betzibbur aval im shagag bemaase bilvad belo horaa ben baavoda zara ben bishar mitzvot eno mevi karban kelal:
Hora hakkohen hammashiach im bet din veshagag hu vehem behoraa af al pi sheasu al pi hahoraa hazzot shettau bah. hoil velo samach bishat maase al horaato levaddah ella al horaato im horaat bet din hare ze patur veen tzarich lehavi kappara bifne atzmo. ella im hayu bet din meviin karban mitkapper lo bichlal hatztzibbur. veim hayu haosim hem hammeviim karban hu eno mevi karban shehare en tzarich kappara bifne atzmo:
Hora im bet din bishgaga veshaggu hem bedam vehu bechelev. eno mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur ella mevi par leatzmo:
Kohen mashiach shennistappek lo im shagag shegaga zo shehi shiggat horaa im hammaase o lo shagag otah. eno mevi asham taluy mippene shehu bah ketzibbur sheenan meviin asham taluy al lo hoda shel shiggat horaa. aval hannasi im nistappek lo im chata o lo chata mevi asham taluy kishar hahedyotot. mippene sheen shiggato teluya behoraato. e zehu nasi haamur battora ze melech sheen alav reshut meadam miyyisrael veen lemala mimmennu bemalchuto ella Adonai elohav. ben shehaya mibbet david o mishshear shivte yisrael. veim hayu melachim rabbim veen echad mehen oved et chavero. kol echad veechad mehen mevi seir izzim al shiggato. vee zehu kohen mashiach ze kohen gadol shennimshach beshemen hammishcha lo hamerubbe bivgadim:
Kohen gadol shennimshach beshemen hammishcha veavar meavodato mippene mum o zikna vechayyotze bahen vechata bishgaga zo mevi par al shiggato. lefi sheen ben kohen mashiach hameshammesh lechohen mashiach sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa shel kol yom sheen makriv otan ella kohen hameshammesh bichhuna gedola. aval par habba al kol hammitzvot shavim hem bo:
Nasi sheasa im hatztzibbur behoraat bet din hare ze mitkapper lo bichlal haam. sheim hayu bet din hem shehikrivu al shiggatan kol haam vehammelech peturin min hakkarban kemo shebbearnu. veim hayu haosim al pi bet din hem shechayyavin bekarban vehaya hammelech min haosim. hare ze mevi sair shesseir nasi bimkom kisba o seira shel hedyot hu omed:
Nasi shennitztarea avar minnesiuto venasi sheavar minnesiuto hare hu kehedyot. chata keshehaya nasi veavar miggedullato hare ze mevi sair shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 3)</small> "al chattato asher chata". kishat chattato hu mevi:
Kohen mashiach o melech shechatu ad shello nitmannu. af al pi shello noda lahem ella achar shennitmannu hare ellu kehedyot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 22)</small> "asher nasi yecheta". <small>(Vayikra 4 3)</small> "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta". ad sheyyechta keshehu nasi ucheshehu mashiach. lefichach im achal sefek chelev keshehu hedyot venoda lo al sefeko achar shennitmanna lihyot kohen gadol hare ze mevi asham taluy. achal chatzi zayit chelev keshehu hedyot vachatzi zayit keshehu nasi behelem achat o sheachal chatzi zayit keshehu nasi vachatzi zayit achar sheavar eno mitztaref ufatur. achal chatzi zayit keshehu hedyot venitmanna veavar veachal chatzi zayit keshehu hedyot. hare ze safek im mitztaref o kevar hifsika hannesiut:
Mishneh Torah, One Who Injures a Person: Hachovel bachavero chayyav leshallem lo chamishsha devarim veellu hem. nezek vetzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. vachamishsha devarim ellu kullan mishtallemim min hayyafe shebbinchasav kedin kol hammazzikin:

Nezek ketzad. sheim kata yad chavero o raglo roin oto keillu hu eved nimkar bashshuk kamma haya yafe [az] vechamma hu yafe atta umeshallem happechat shehifchit middamav. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "ayin tachat ayin". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar tachat leshallem mamon hu:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo" eno lachavol baze kemo shechaval bachavero ella shehu rauy lechassero evar o lachavol bo kaasher asa ulefichach meshallem nizko. vahare hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la lo)</small> "velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach" lerotzeach bilvad hu sheen bo kofer aval lechesron evarim o lechabbalot yesh bo kofer:

Vechen ze shenneemar bechovel bachavero umazziko <small>(Devarim 25 12)</small> "lo tachos enecha" shello tachus betashlumin shemma tomar ani hu ze veshello bechavvana chaval bo arachamennu lechach neemar lo tachos enecha:

Uminnayin shezze shenneemar beevarim <small>(Shemot 21 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "ayin tachat ayin" tashlumin hu. shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 21 25)</small> "chabbura tachat chabbura" uveferush neemar <small>(Shemot 21 18)</small> "vechi yakke ish et reehu beeven o beegrof" vegomer <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe". ha lamadta shettachat shenneemar bechabbura tashlumin. vehu haddin letachat haamur beayin uvishar evarim:

Veaf al pi sheddevarim ellu nirim meinyan tora shebbichtav vechullan meforashin hen mippi moshe rabbenu mehar sinay. kullan halacha lemoshe hen beyadenu vechaze rau avotenu danin bevet dino shel yehoshua uvevet dino shel shemuel haramati uvechol bet din uvet din sheamdu mimot moshe rabbenu vead achshav:

Uminnayin shemmazzik bachavero chayyav betzaar bifne atzmo. shehare neemar beones <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "tachat asher innah". vehu haddin lechol hametzaer et chavero begufo shehu chayyav leshallem deme hatztzaar:
Uminnayin shehu chayyav beshevet bifne atzmo verippuy bifne atzmo. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe":

Uminnayin shehu chayyav bevoshet bifne atzmo shehare neemar <small>(Devarim 25 11)</small> "veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav" <small>(Devarim 25 12)</small> "vekatztzota et kappah" bichlal din ze kol hamevayyesh:

Hamevayyesh eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyyihye mitkavven shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 11)</small> "veshalcha yadah". aval hamevayyesh chavero belo kavvana patur. lefichach yashen vechayyotze bo shebbiyyesh patur:

Adam muad leolam ben shogeg ben mezid ben er ben yashen ben shikkor im chaval bachavero o hizzik mamon chavero meshallem min hayyafe shebbinchasav. bamme devarim amurim shehayyashen chayyav leshallem bishnayim sheyyashnu keechad venithappech echad mehen vehizzik et chavero o kara bigdo. aval im haya echad yashen uva acher veshachav betziddo. ze shebba baacharona hu hammuad veim hizziko hayyashen patur. vechen im hinniach keli betzad hayyashen ushevaro patur shezze shehinnicho hu hammuad sheppasha:

Mi shennafal min haggag beruach metzuya vehizzik chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur min habboshet. nafal beruach sheenah metzuya chayyav benezek bilvad ufatur mearbaa devarim. veim nithappech chayyav bakkol af bevoshet shekkol hammitkavven lehazzik af al pi shello nitkavven levayyesh chayyav bevoshet:
Shenayim shechavlu beechad keechad shenehem chayyavin umeshalleshin benehen. haya echad mitkavven veechad sheeno mitkavven ze sheeno mitkavven patur min habboshet:
Hammitkavven levayyesh et hakkatan uviyyesh et haggadol noten laggadol deme bashto shel katan. nitkavven levayyesh haeved uviyyesh et ben chorin noten leven chorin deme bashto shel eved:

Hayta lo even munnachat becheko ben shello hikkir bah meolam ben shehikkir bah ushechachah veamad venafla vehizzika chayyav benezek bilvad ufatur mearbaa devarim. vechen im nitkavven lizrok shetayim vezarak arba vehizzik o shehizzik keshehu yashen chayyav benezek ufatur mearbaa devarim:

Hammazzik et chavero bechavvana bechol makom chayyav bachamishsha devarim. vaafillu nichnas lirshut chavero shello birshut vehizziko baal habbayit chayyav sheyyesh lo reshut lehotzio veen lo reshut lehazziko. aval im huzzak ze shennichnas bevaal habbayit hare baal habbayit patur. veim huzzak bo baal habbayit chayyav mippene shennichnas shello birshut. hayu shenehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut vehuzzeku ze baze shenehem peturin:

Hamevakkea etzim birshut harabbim ufarach etz mehen vehizzik birshut hayyachid. o shebbikkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim. o shebbikkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher. o shennichnas lachanuto shel naggar ben birshut ben shello birshut venitteza bekaat vetafcha al panav. bechol ellu chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur min habboshet:

Keshem sheomdin lemita kach omdin linzakin. ketzad. hare shehikka chavero bitzror katan sheen bo kede lehazzik o bekesam shel etz katan vechaval bo chabbala sheen chefetz ze rauy laasoto hare ze patur. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 18)</small> "beeven o veegrof" davar harauy lehazzik. aval chayyav hu bevoshet bilvad. afillu rakak begufo shel chavero chayyav bevoshet. lefichach tzerichin haedim leda bema hizzik umeviin hachefetz shehizzik bo levet din ad sheomdin oto vedanin alav. veim avad hachefetz veamar hachovel lo haya bo kede lehazzik uchemo anus ani. vehannechbal omer haya bo kede lehazzik. yishshava hannechbal veyittol kemo sheyyitbaer:

Habbarzel en lo omed afillu machat ketanna reuya hi lehamit veen tzarich lomar lehazzik. hazzorek even uleachar sheyyatza mittachat yado hotzi halla et rosho min hachallon vekibbelah patur mikkelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 5)</small> "umatza et reehu" perat lemamtzi et atzmo:

Hachovel bachavero chabbala shehu rauy leshallem hachamishsha devarim kullam meshallem chamishsha. hizziko nezek sheen bo ella arbaa meshallem arbaa. shelosha meshallem shelosha. shenayim meshallem shenayim. echad meshallem echad: 
Ketzad. kata yado o raglo o etzba mehen o shessimme eno meshallem chamishsha nezek vetzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. hikkahu al yado vetzavta vesofah lachzor. al eno umarda vesofah lichyot. meshallem arbaa tzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. hikkahu al rosho vetzava meshallem shelosha tzaar verippuy uvoshet. hikkahu bemakom sheeno nire kegon shehikka al birkav o begabbo meshallem shenayim tzaar verippuy. hikkahu bemitpachat shebbeyado o bishtar vechayyotze beellu noten achat vehi habboshet bilvad: 
Kevaahu beshippud o bemasmer al tzipparnav bemakom sheeno ose chabbura velo meakkev melacha meshallem hatztzaar bilvad. hishkahu sam o sacho sam veshinna mare oro meshallem lo rippuy bilvad ad sheyyachazor marehu keshehaya. asaro becheder noten lo deme shevet bilvad. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Hamegalleach sear rosh chavero noten lo deme bashto bilvad mippene shessofo lachzor. gillecho besam o shekkevaahu ad sheen sof hassear lachzor chayyav bachamishsha devarim. benezek betzaar verippuy shehare yitchammem rosho min hakkeviyya o min hassam venimtza chash berosho. umeshallem lo shevet shehare hu rauy lirkod ulenadned delet rosho bishat rikkud venimtza batel mimmelacha zo. uvoshet sheen lecha boshet gadol mizze: 
Ha lamadta shekkol hamechasser chavero evar sheeno chozer chayyav bechol hachamishsha devarim. afillu hippil shinno chayyav bakkol shei efshar shello yechele piv shaa achat. af al pi shehashshen en lo refua besar hashshinnayim tzarich refua: 
Afillu chissero kesaara meor besaro chayyav bachamishsha devarim. shehaor eno chozer ella tzalleket. lefichach hachovel bachavero vekara haor vehotzi mimmennu dam chayyav bachamishsha devarim: 
Hammavit chavero af al pi shechala min happachad hare ze patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vehu shello naga bo ella kegon shetztzaak meachorav o shennitraa [lo] baafela vechayyotze baze. vechen im tzaak beazno vechersho patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. achazo vetaka beazno vechersho o shennaga bo udechafo beet shehivito o sheachaz bivgadav vechayyotze bidvarim ellu chayyav betashlumin: 
Yerae li shehannechbal sheamar nitcharashti o nismet eni vahare eni roe o eni shomea eno neeman. shehare en anu makkirin haddavar shemma yaarim. veeno notel hannezek ad sheyyibbadek zeman merubbe veyihye muchzak sheavad meor enav o nitcharesh veachar kach yeshallem ze: 
Kamma hu hatztzaar. hakkol hu lefi hannizzak. yesh adam shehu rach veanog meod uvaal mamon veillu natnu lo mamon harebe lo haya mitztaer meat. veyesh adam shehu amlan vechazak veani umippene zuz echad mitztaer tzaar harebe. veal pi haddevarim haelle omdin ufoskin hatztzaar: 
Ketzad meshaarin hatztzaar bemakom shechissero evar. hare shekkata yado o etzbao omdim kamma adam kaze rotze litten ben liktoa lo evar ze besayif o liktoa oto besam im gazar alav hammelech liktoa yado o raglo. veomdin kamma yesh ben ze laze umeshallem hammazzik: 
Ketzad meshaarin hashshevet. im lo chissero evar ella chala venafal lemishkav o shetztzavta yado vesofah lachzor noten lo deme shivto shel kol yom veyom kefoel batel shel otah melacha shebbittel mimmennu. veim chissero evar o shekkata yado noten deme yado shehu hannezek. veshevet roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuim veroin kamma hu sechar shomer kishshuin bechol yom veosin cheshbon kol yeme chalyo shel ze venoten lo. vechen im kata raglo roin oto keillu hu shomer al happetach. simme eno roin oto keillu hu tochen berechayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hikka et chavero al azno o achazo vetaka beazno vechersho noten lo deme kullo shehare eno rauy limlacha kelal: 
Simme et eno velo amaduhu kata et yado velo amaduhu vekata et raglo velo amaduhu veachar kach chersho hoil velo amaduhu lechol nezek venezek noten lo deme kullo. amaduhu lechol nezek venezek veachar kach amaduhu lechullo en govin mimmennu ella deme kullo bilvad. veim tafas hannizzak nezek kol evar veevar udeme kullo en motziin miyyado: 
Ketzad meshaarin harippuy. omdin kamma yamim yichye ze mecholi ze vechamma hu tzarich venoten lo miyyad. veen mechayyevin oto litten devar yom beyomo. vedavar ze takkana hi lammazzik: 
Vechen hashshevet omdin otah venoten hakkol miyyad. im haya mitgalgel bechalyo veholech vearach bo hacholi yeter al ma sheamaduhu eno mosif lo kelum. vechen im hivri miyyad en pochatin lo mimma sheamaduhu: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheratza hammazzik shezzo takkana hi lo. aval im amar hammazzik en retzoni betakkana zo ella arappeennu devar yom beyomo shomin lo: 
Amar lo hannizzak pesok immi veten al yadi vaani arappe et atzmi en shomin lo shehare omer lo shemma lo terappe atzmecha veechezak ani kemazzik ella noten lo devar yom beyomo. o posek al hakkol venoten deme harippuy al yede bet din: 
Amar lo hammazzik ani arappe otcha o yesh li rofe shemmerappe bechinnam en shomin lo ella mevi rofe umman umerappeehu besachar: 
Hare shello pasak immo ella haya merappe yom veyom vealu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka o nistera hammakka achar shechayta. chayyav lerappeoto velatet lo deme shivto. alu bo tzemachim shello mechamat hammakka chayyav lerappeoto veeno noten lo deme shivto. avar al divre rofe vehichbid alav hacholi eno chayyav lerappeoto: 
Keshepposkin bet din al hammazzik umechayyevin oto leshallem govin mimmennu hakkol miyyad veen kovin lo zeman kelal. veim nitchayyev bevoshet bilvad kovin lo zeman leshallem shehare lo chissero mamon:

Ketzad meshaarin habboshet. hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. eno dome mitbayyesh min hakkatan lemitbayyesh meadam gadol umechubbad shezze shebbiyyesho ze hakkal bashto merubba: 
Hamevayyesh et hearom o mi shehu bemerchatz patur. nashva haruach vehafcha shulav al panav vahare hu arom vehosif ze behafeshatato chayyav bevoshet. veeno dome mevayyesh et ze shennaasa arom limvayyesh et sheeno arom. vechen im higbiah begadav lered lannahar o sheala min hannahar uviyyesho chayyav. veeno dome mevayyesh ze limvayyesh et hamechusse bivgadav: 
Hamevayyesh et hayyashen chayyav bevoshet. veim met betoch shenato velo hekitz velo hirgish baze shebbiyyesho en govin boshet ze min hamevayyesh. veim tafsu hayyorshin en motziin miyyadan: 
Hamevayyesh et hashshote patur. vehamevayyesh et hacheresh chayyav. hamevayyesh et hagger o et haeved chayyav. hamevayyesh et hakkatan im keshemmachlimin oto nichlam chayyav veim lav patur. umikkol makom eno dome hamevayyesh et hakkatan limvayyesh et haggadol. velo hamevayyesh et haeved limvayyesh et ben chorin. velo mevayyesh cheresh limvayyesh pikkeach: 
Hamevayyesh et chavero bidvarim o sherakak al begadav patur min hattashlumin. veyesh levet din ligdor baddavar bechol makom uvechol zeman kefi sheyyiru. veim biyyesh talmid chachamim chayyav leshallem lo boshet shelema af al pi shello biyyesho ella bidvarim. kevar nifsak haddin shekkol hamevayyesh talmid chacham afillu bidvarim konsin oto vegovin mimmennu mishkal sheloshim vachamishsha dinar min hazzahav shehu mishkal tesha selaim pachot revia. vekabbala hi beyadenu sheggovin kenas ze bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz: 
Maasim hayu etzlenu tamid bechach bisfarad. veyesh talmide chachamim shehayu mochalin al ze vechach nae lahem. veyesh shettovea veosin peshara benehen. aval haddayyanim hayu omrin lamvayyesh chayyav atta litten lo litra zahav: 
Af al pi shehamevayyesh shear haam bidvarim patur min hattashlumin avon gadol hu. veeno mecharef umegaddef laam ella rasha shote. veamru chachamim harishonim shekkol hammalbin pene adam kasher miyyisrael bidvarim en lo chelek laolam habba: 
Yesh hakkaot rabbot sheyyesh bahen bizzuy vetzaar meat veen bahen nezek. uchevar pasku lahem chachamim damim ketzuvim. vechol hammakke lachavero hakkaa mehen meshallem oto hammamon hakkatzuv vechullan kenasot hen. veoto hammamon hakkatzuv hu deme hatztzaar vehabboshet veharippuy vehashshevet. ben tzarich lirfua veshevet ben lo tzarich kaze hu meshallem: 
Vechamma hu meshallem. habboet bachavero beraglo meshallem chamesh selaim. hikkahu bearkubbato meshallem shalosh selaim. kibbetz etzbeotav kemo oged aguda vehikkahu beyado keshehi aguda meshallem shelosh esre selaim. taka et chavero bechappo meshallem sela. setaro al panav meshallem chamishshim selaim. setaro meachore yado meshallem mea sela. vechen im tzirem beazno o talash bisaro o sherakak vehiggio [harok bivsaro o heevir tallit mealav ufara rosh haishsha] meshallem mea sela. vechaze hu meshallem al kol maase umaase. ketzad. kegon shebbaat bachavero arba beitot afillu zo achar zo meshallem esrim selaim. setaro al panav shete setirot meshallem mea sela. vechen bashshear: 
Kol ellu hasselaim hem mikkesef eretz yisrael beoto hazzeman. shehaya bechol sela chatzi dinar kesef ushelosha dinarin umechetza nechoshet. lefichach mi shennitchayyev behakkaot ellu leshallem mea sela hare ze meshallem shetem esre sela umechetza kesef naki: 
Bamme devarim amurim bimchubbad. aval adam shehu mevuzze veeno makpid bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen eno notel ella lefi ma sherauy lo uchemo sheyyiru haddayyanim shehu rauy littol. lefi sheyyesh bene adam keurin sheen makpidin al bashtam vechol hayyom mevazzim atzman bechol mine bizzuy derech sechok vekallut rosh o kede littol peruta achat min halletzim hamesachakim immahem:

Hannogef et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha af al pi shello nitkavven chayyav leshallem deme veladot labbaal venezek vetzaar laishsha: 
Vechetzad meshaarin deme veladot. shamin haishsha kamma hayta yafa ad shello yalda vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalda venotnin labbaal. im met habbaal notnin leyorshav. veim niggefa achar mitat habbaal notnin af deme veladot laishsha: 
Hayta nesua leger vechaval bah bechayye hagger noten deme veladot labbaal. met hagger patur. veim chaval bah achar mitat hagger zachta hi bidme veladot: 
Hayta shifcha o akkum bishat herayon uvishat negifa nishtachrera o nitgayyera hare deme havveladot shellah: 
Hannogef et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha umeta af al pi shehaya shogeg hare ze patur min hattashlumin veeno meshallem kelum. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh". lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid bedavar sheyyesh bo mitat bet din lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Bamme devarim amurim shennitkavven laishsha. aval im nitkavven lachavero venagaf et haishsha af al pi shemmeta hoil vehemitah belo kavvana hare ze kedavar sheen bo mitat bet din umeshallem deme veladot: 
Hammakke aviv veimmo velo asa bahen chabbura chayyav bachamishsha devarim. aval im asa bahem chabbura o shechaval bachavero beshabbat afillu haya shogeg patur min hattashlumin mippene shehu avon mitat bet din. uchevar bearnu shello chillek hakkatuv bedavar sheyyesh bo mitat bet din ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Vahalo hachovel mekalkel hu vechol hamekalkelin beshabbat peturin min hammita velamma nachshov ze hachovel avon sheyyesh bo mitat bet din. hoil veasa nachat ruach leyitzro hara beet shechaval bachavero hare hu kimtakken venimtza avon mita lefichach patur mittashlumin: 
Hachovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim afillu bemezid chayyav betashlumin. af al pi sheavar avera shehu chayyav aleha malkot. vahalo kol hamechuyyav malkot vetashlumin loke veeno meshallem sheen adam loke umeshallem. kach hem haddevarim bakkol chutz mechovel bachavero shehu meshallem shehare beferush ribbeta tora chovel bachavero letashlumin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten": 
Hachovel beeved kenaani shello patur. chaval beeved ivri shello chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet. hachovel beeved kenaani shel chavero rabbo shel eved notel chamishsha devarim. vaafillu tziaro besam venitirappe bimhera hare kol refuato lerabbo: 
Kol eved sheyyatza lecherut vaadayin lo higgia get shichrur leyado en lo kenas. vaacherim shechavlu bo eno yachol lehotzi mehen leatzmo sheadayin lo gamar shichruro. velo haadon yachol lehotzi mehen shehare lo nishar [lo] bo kinyan. lefichach hammappil shen avdo veachar kach simme eno yotze beshinno veeno noten lo deme eno. veim tafas en motziin miyyado: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin shebbiyyesho adam o tziaro o shennegacho shor vechayyotze baellu. im ero ze bayyom shel rabbo lerabbo. bayyom shel atzmo leatzmo: 
Hachovel beeved ivri shel chavero chayyav bachamishsha devarim veyillakach bahen karka verabbo ochel peroteha. velichsheyyetze haeved lecherut yetze hassade mittachat rabbo. hizziko hezzek sheeno meakkev melacha kelal kegon shekkata rosh azno o rosh chatmo hakkol laeved veen lerabbo bahen perot: 
Hachovel bevat ketanna shel acherim im nezek happochet otah mikkaspah hu hare hu shel av. vechen shivtah shel av shehare maase yadeha vechesef mechiratah shel aviha hu. aval tzaar uvoshet verippuy hare hu shellah. vechen nezek sheeno pochatah mikkaspah hare hu shellah. vechen hachovel bevitto meshallem tzaar verippuy uvoshet: 
Hachovel beeshet ish hashshevet veharippuy levaalah vehatztzaar shellah. vehabboshet vehannezek im begaluy hu kegon shechaval befaneha uvetzavvarah o beyadeha uzerooteha hashshelish shellah ushene shelishim labbaal. veim basseter hu hannezek hashshelish labbaal ushene shelishim laishsha. shel baal notnin lo miyyad veshel ishsha yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perot: 
Bamme devarim amurim shechavlu bah acherim. aval habbaal shechaval beishto chayyav leshallem lah miyyad kol hannezek vechol habboshet vehatztzaar vehakkol shellah veen labbaal bahen perot. veim ratzta litten haddamim leacher notenet. vechaze horu haggeonim. vehabbaal merappe otah kederech shemmerappe kol chalyah: 
Vehammazzik ishto betashmish hammitta chayyav binzakeha: 
Haishsha shechavla bevalah im haya tosefet bichtubbatah mechayyevin otah limkor hattosefet levaalah betovat hanaa vegove mimmenna im ratza habbaal. veim ratza legarshah veligbot min hakkol gove. veim lo haya lah tosefet enah yechola limkor lo ikkar ketubbatah. sheasur lo laadam lashhot et ishto shaa achat belo ketubba kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah. ella im ratza habbaal kotev aleha shetar bidme chavalo o megarshah venotel mikketubbatah harauy lo: 
Hachovel bevanav haggedolim im en somchin al shulchano noten lahem miyyad. vehakketannim yillakach bahen karka benizkan vehen ochlin perotav. vechen haddin baacherim shechavlu bahen. veim hayu semuchin al shulchano vechaval bahen patur ben shehayu gedolim ben shehayu ketannim. veim chavlu bahen acherim baggedolim yitten lahem miyyad uvakketannim yillakach bahen karka vehen ochlin peroteha ad sheyyagdilu: 
Cheresh shote vekatan pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav vehen shechavlu baacherim peturin. af al pi shennitpatteach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan enam chayyavin leshallem shebbeshaa shechavlu bahen lo hayu bene daat: 
Haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa hachovel bahen chayyav vehen shechavlu baacherim peturin. aval meshallemin leachar zeman im nitgarsha haishsha o met balah o nishtachrer haeved. shehare bene dea hen vahare hen kevaal chov sheen lo ma yigbe sheim heeshir chayyav leshallem: 
Avdo shel adam kegufo uvehemto kemamono. ketzad. hare shehinniach gachelet al lev avdo shel chavero umet o sheddechafo layyam o laesh vehu yachol laalot mishsham velo ala umet patur min hattashlumin. veim asa chen levehemat chavero keillu hinniach haggachelet al bigdo venisraf shehu chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Asur leadam lachavol ben beatzmo ben bachavero. velo hachovel bilvad ella kol hammakke adam kasher miyyisrael ben katan ben gadol ben ish ben ishsha derech nitztzayon hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "lo yosif" <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "lehakkoto". im hizhira tora millehosif behakkaat hachote kal vachomer lemakke et hatztzaddik: 
Afillu lehagebiah yado al chavero asur vechol hammagbiah yado al chavero af al pi shello hikkahu hare ze rasha: 
Hammakke et chavero hakkaa sheen bah sheve peruta loke shehare en kan tashlumin kede sheyyihye lav ze nittan letashlumin. vaafillu hikka eved chavero hakkaa sheen bah sheve peruta loke shehare yeshno bemiktzat mitzvot. veakkum shehikka et yisrael chayyav mita shenneemar <small>(Shemot 2 12)</small> "vayyifen ko vacho" <small>(Shemot 2 12)</small> "vayyach et hammitzri": 
Kenas kansu chachamim leellu hashshotim baale zeroa sheyyihye hannechbal neeman venishba binkitat chefetz shezze chaval bo chaval ze venotel ma sherauy lo. vehu sheyyihyu sham edim. ketzad. hayu shene edim meidin oto shennichnas letoch yado shalem veyatza chavul velo rauhu beet shechaval bo vehu omer lo chavalti vehalla omer atta chavalta bi hare ze nishba venotel: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta hammakka bemakom sheefshar lo lehakkot beatzmo o shehaya immahem shelishi sheefshar shezze hannechbal amar lo lachavol bo ulehitraem al acher. aval im en immahem acher vehayta hammakka bemakom sheeno yachol laasot beatzmo kegon shehayta neshicha ben ketefav vechayyotze baze hare ze notel belo shevua: 
Hoda hachovel shehu chaval meshallem chamishsha devarim shehare haedim hayu sham shennichnas letoch yado shalem bishat hammeriva veyatza chavul. aval im lo hayu sham edim kelal hu omer chavalta bi vehoda meatzmo patur min hannezek umin hatztzaar vechayyav beshevet uvevoshet uverippuy al pi atzmo. lefichach im kafar veamar lo chavalti nishba shevuat hesset: 
Velamma meshallem adam shelosha devarim ellu al pi atzmo. shehashshevet veharippuy mamon hu velo kenas. sheim lo yitten lo hare chissero mamon shehu mitrappe bo uvittel mimmelachto. vehabboshet lo higgia lo ella beshaa shehoda befanenu shehu chaval bo. shehannechbal shello chaval bo [bifne] adam en lo boshet vehodaato bevet din hi shebbiyyesha oto: 
Nimtzeta lamed sheen hefresh bevoshet ben boshet hammaggia lo im chaval bo bifne acherim uven boshet hammaggia lo beet shehoda bifne acherim shechaval bo. lefichach meshallem adam boshet al pi atzmo: 
Eno dome mazzik chavero begufo lemazzik mamono. shehammazzik mamon chavero kevan sheshshillem ma shehu chayyav leshallem nitkapper lo. aval chaval bachavero af al pi shennatan lo chamishsha devarim en mitkapper lo. vaafillu hikriv kol ele nevayot eno mitkapper lo velo nimchal avono ad sheyyevakkesh min hannechbal veyimchol lo: 
Veasur lannechbal lihyot achzari velo yimchol en zo derech zera yisrael ella kevan shebbikkesh mimmennu hachovel venitchannen lo paam rishona usheniyya veyada shehu shav mecheto venicham al raato yimchol lo. vechol hamemaher limchol hare hu meshubbach veruach chachamim nocha hemennu: 
Veod yesh hefresh ben nizke gufo lenizke mamono. shehaomer lachavero samme et eni keta et yadi al menat sheatta patur hare ze chayyav bachamishsha devarim shehaddavar yadua sheen adam rotze bechach. aval haomer lachavero kera et kesuti shevor et kaddi al menat sheatta patur hare ze patur. veim lo amar lo al menat sheatta patur hare ze chayyav leshallem af al pi shehirshahu lehashechit: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshebbau hakkelim leyado techilla betorat shemira. kegon shehayu sheulin o mufkadin etzlo veamar lo shevor ukera veasa chen chayyav leshallem ad sheyyomar lo al menat sheatta patur. aval im amar lo kach keli ze veshavro. beged ze vekaro. veasa chen hare ze patur: 
Haomer lachavero shevor kelav shel peloni al menat sheatta patur veasa hare ze chayyav leshallem. ucheillu amar lo samme eno shel peloni al menat sheatta patur. veaf al pi shehaose hu chayyav leshallem. hare ze haomer lo shuttafo baavon verasha hu. shehare hichshil ivver vechizzek yede ovre avera:

Hammazzik mamon chavero chayyav leshallem nezek shalem ben shehaya shogeg ben shehaya anus hare hu kemezid. ketzad. nafal min haggag veshavar et hakkelim o shennitkal keshehu mehallech venafal al hakkeli ushevaro chayyav nezek shalem. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 21)</small> "umakke vehema yeshallemenna" lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid: 
Veechad hahoreg behemto shel chavero o hashshover kelav o hakkorea begadav o kotzetz netiotav hakkol din echad hu: 
Bamme devarim amurim birshut hannizzak. aval birshut hammazzik eno chayyav leshallem ella im hizzik bezadon aval bishgaga o beones patur. vechen im hayu shenehen birshut o shenehem shello birshut vehizzik echad mehen mamon chavero shello bechavvana patur: 
Haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachtav venafla vehizzika. im lo hayta mehuddeket vachazaka chayyav. hayta chazaka umehuddeket venishmeta o shehitlia hare ze patur shezzo makka bide shamayim hi. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kol ellu haddevarim birshut hannizzak aval birshut hammazzik patur ad sheyyitkavven lehazzik kemo shebbearnu: 
Hare shemmille chatzar chavero kadde yayin veshemen afillu hichnisam birshut hoil velo kibbel alav baal hechatzer lishmor hare ze nichnas veyotze kedarko vechol sheyyishtabber min hakkaddim bichnisato uvitziato hare hu patur alehen. veim shevaran bechavvana afillu hichnisam baal hakkaddim shello birshut hare ze chayyav leshallem. [vechen kol kayyotze baze]: 
Shor sheala al gabbe shor lehargo birshut hammazzik shehu baal hattachton ben shehaya tam ben shehaya muad uva baal hattachton veshamat et shoro lehatztzilo venafal elyon umet hare ze patur: 
Dechafo leelyon umet im haya yachol leshamto velo shemato hare ze chayyav. veim lo haya yachol leshamto hare ze patur: 
Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato venishbera chavito shel ze bekorato shel ze patur shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech. haya baal hakkora rishon uvaal hechavit acharon venishbera chavit bakkora patur. veim amad baal hakkora lanuach mikkoved massao chayyav. veim hizhir levaal hechavit veamar lo amod patur. amad letakken massao hare hu kimhallech ufatur. veaf al pi shello hizhir levaal hechavit, shehu tarud bedarko. haya baal hechavit rishon uvaal kora acharon venishbera chavit bakkora chayyav shezze kemo sheshshevaro beyado bechavvana. veim amad baal chavit lanuach patur. veim hizhir levaal hakkora veamar lo amod hare ze chayyav. veim amad letakken massao af al pi shello hizhir levaal hakkora hare hu chayyav. vechen ze ba benero veze ba befishtano. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim echad ratz veechad mehallech vehuzzak echad mehen bachavero shello bechavvana. ze haratz chayyav mippene shehu meshanne. veim haya erev shabbat ben hashshemashot patur mippene shebbirshut hu ratz kede shello tikkanes hashshabbat vehu eno panuy. hayu shenehem ratzim vehuzzeku ze baze shenehem peturin vaafillu bishar hayyamim: 
Echad hammazzik beyado o shezzarak even o yara chetz vehizzik bo o sheppatar mayim al chavero o al hakkelim vehizzik o sherak o na vehizzik bechicho venio beet shehalchu mikkocho hare ze kemazzik beyado vehem toladot shel adam. aval im nach harok vehakkiach al haaretz veachar kach nitkal bahen adam hare ze chayyav mishshum boro. shekkol takkala toledet bor hi kemo shebbearnu: 
Lotesh shehaya makke befattish veyatza getz mittachat happattish vehizzik hare ze chayyav kemi shezzarak even o chetz. vechen habbanay shekkibbel alav et hakkotel lesatro veshavar et haavanim o hizzik chayyav. haya soter mitztzad ze venafal mitztzad acher patur. veim mechamat hammakka chayyav shezze kezorek chetz vehizzik bo hu: 
Hakkovesh behemat chavero bemayim o shennafla umenaah millaalot ad shemmeta bammayim. o shehinnichah bachamma vetzimtzem aleha hammakom kede shello timtza tzel ad sheharagatta hachamma. chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shehemitu et habbehema keachat o shavru et hakkeli keachat meshalleshin benehen: 
Chamishsha shehinnichu chamesh chavilot al habbehema velo meta uva ze haacharon vehinniach chavilato aleha umeta. im hayta mehallechet beotan hachavilot umishshehosif ze chavilato amda velo halcha haacharon chayyav. veim mittechilla lo hayta mehallechet haacharon patur. veim en yadua kullan meshallemin beshave: 
Vechen chamishsha sheyyashvu al hakkisse velo nishbar uva acharon veyashav alav venishbar af al pi shehaya rauy lehishshaver bahen kodem sheyyashav hoil vekerev et shevirato haacharon chayyav. shehare omrim lo illu lo nismachta alenu hayinu omdim kodem sheyyishshaver. veim yashvu keachat venishbar kullan chayyavin. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Adam veshor sheddachafu behema o adam o kelim o behemat pesule hammukdashin labbor vehuzzak hannidchaf babbor o met o nishtabberu hakkelim. leinyan nizke adam o hezzek behema shelashtan chayyavin haadam haddochef uvaal hashshor uvaal habbor umeshalleshin benehen. leinyan deme veladot vearbaa devarim adam chayyav uvaal hashshor uvaal habbor peturin. leinyan kofer usheloshim shel eved baal hashshor chayyav veadam uvaal habbor peturin. leinyan kelim ufesule hammukdashin adam uvaal hashshor chayyavin uvaal habbor patur:

Hammazzik mamon chavero hezzek sheeno nikkar. hoil velo nishtanna haddavar velo nifseda tzurato hare ze patur min hattashlumin din tora. aval middivre sofrim amru hoil vehifchit demehen hare ze chayyav umeshallem ma shehifchit middemehen:

Ketzad. hare shettimme ochalin tehorim shel chavero o sheddimmea lo perot o erev lo tippat yen nesech betoch yeno shehare asar alav hakkol. vechen kol kayyotze baze. shamin ma shehifsid umeshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbinchasav kederech kol hammazzikin:

Vedavar ze kenas hu shekkenasuhu chachamim kede shello yihye kol echad min hammashchitim holech umetamme tohorotav shel chavero veomer patur ani. lefichach im met ze shehizzik hezzek sheeno nikkar en govin hannezek minnechasav shello kansu chachamim ella ze sheavar vehizzik. aval hayyoresh shello asa kelum lo kenasuhu. vechen hammazzik hezzek sheeno nikkar bishgaga o beones patur shello kansu ella hammitkavven lehazzik middato:
Hakkohanim sheppiggelu et hazzevach bemezid chayyavin leshallem. beshogeg peturin. vechen haose melacha befarat chattat uveme chattat bemezid chayyav leshallem. beshogeg patur:
Hichnis para lemarbek kede shettinak vetadush vehissiach dato mimme chattat. patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim:

Hamenassech yen chavero laavoda zara lo neesar hayyayin. sheen adam miyyisrael oser davar sheeno shello. veim haya lo bo shuttafut. o shehaya mumar shehare hu keakkum. o shehitru bo vekibbel hahatraa shehare hu mumar. hare ze oser hayyayin vechayyav leshallem. veheach yitchayyev ze leshallem vahare hu mitchayyev benafsho. mippene shemmeet shehigbiho nitchayyev leshallem veeno mitchayyev benafsho ad sheyyenassech:

Kol haggorem lehazzik mamon chavero chayyav leshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbinchasav kishar hammazzikin. af al pi sheeno hu hammazzik ze hannezek atzmo baacharona hoil vehu haggorem harishon chayyav. ketzad. hazzorek keli shello merosh haggag al gabbe karim uchesatot uva acher vekadam vesillek et hakkarim meal haaretz venechbat hakkeli baaretz venishbar chayyav nezek shalem keillu shevaro beyado shessilluk hakkarim vehakkesatot garam lo sheyyishshaver. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hazzorek keli shel chavero merosh haggag al gabbe karim uchesatot shel baal hakkeli vekadam baal hakkeli vehesir hakkarim hazzorek chayyav shezzerikato hu haggorem harishon lishvirat hakkeli. veim kadam acher vesillekan shenehen chayyavin hazzorek vehamesallek sheshshenehem garmu leabbed mamono shel ze:

Vechen hassoref shitrotav shel chavero chayyav leshallem kol hachov shehaya bashshetar. sheaf al pi sheen guf hashshetar mamon hare garam leabbed hammamon. uvilvad sheyyode lo hammazzik sheshshetar mekuyyam haya vechach vechach haya katuv bo umechamat shesserafo hu eno yachol ligbot hachov. aval im lo heemino eno meshallem lo ella deme hanneyar bilvad:

Vechen reuven shehaya noshe beshimon umachar hashshetar lelevi vechazar achar shemmecharo umechalo leshimon. hare niftar shimon kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo venitchayyev reuven leshallem lelevi kol ma shebbashshetar. shehare garam lo leabbed hashshetar vahare hu kemi shesserafo. vechen im mechalo yoresh reuven meshallem hammochel min hayyafe shebbinchasav:

Vechen haose avdo appoteke vechazar veshichrero chayyav hameshachrer leshallem levaal hachov shehare hifkia shibudo vegaram leabbed mamono. vechofin et baal chov gam hu leshachrer haeved kede shello yifga bo veyomar lo avdi atta. vechen haddochef matbea chavero venitgalgel veyarad layyam chayyav leshallem. vechen hatztzorem ozen happara chayyav leshallem shehare garam lifchot dameha. vechen hamerakkea dinre chavero veheevir tzuratan chayyav leshallem mishshum gorem. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim:

Hazzorek keli merosh haggag laaretz velo haya tachtav kelim. vekadam acher ushevaro bemakkel keshehu baavir kodem sheyyaggia laaretz. hare ze haacher patur shello shavar ella keli shessofo lehishshaver miyyad bevadday venimtza keshover keli shavur veen ze kegorem. vechen kol kayyotze baze patur:

Shor shehaya omed lahariga mippene shehu mazzik et habberiyyot. veilan haomed liktzitza mippene shehu mazzik et harabbim. vekadam echad veshachat shor ze vekatzatz ilan ze shello middaat habbealim. chayyav leshallem labbealim kemo sheyyiru haddayyanim shehare hifkian millaasot mitzva. veim taan veamar atta amarta li lehargo ulekatztzo. hoil vehu omed lechach hare ze patur:

Vechen mi sheshshachat chayya veof uva acher vechissa haddam shello middaat hashshochet. chayyav litten kemo sheyyiru haddayyanim. veyesh mi shehora shehu noten kenas katzuv vehu asara zehuvim. vechen horu shekkol hammonea habbealim measot mitzvat ase shehen reuyin laasotah vekadam acher vaasaah meshallem labbealim asara zehuvim:

Shamin lammazzik beyado kederech sheshshamin lo im hizzik mamono. ketzad. hare sheharag behemat chavero o shavar kelav shamin kamma hayta habbehema shava vechamma hannevela shava. vechamma haya hakkeli shave vehu shalem vechamma shave atta. umeshallem happechat lannizzak im hannevela o hakkeli hashshavur. kederech shebbearnu beshoro shehizzik sheddin echad hu. darach anavim shel chavero shamin lo hezzeko. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kesheggovin happechat min hammazzik govin min hammittaltelin shello. im en lo mittaltelin govin min hayyafe shebbinchasav. vechen haones vehamefatte vehammotzi shem ra kullan govin mehen min hayyafe shebbinchasav:
Kol hammazzik mamon chavero veeno yodea ma hizzik. hare hannizzak nishba betakkanat chachamim venotel kemo sheyyiton hannigzal. vehu sheyyiton devarim shehu amud bahen kemo shebbearnu benigzal:

Ketzad. lakach kis chavero vehishlicho layyam o laesh. o shemmesaro beyad annas veavad. baal hakkis omer zehuvim haya male vehammazzik omer eni yodea me haya bo shemma afar o teven haya male. hare hannizzak nishba binkitat chefetz venotel. vehu sheyyiton devarim shehu amud bahen o amud lehafekidan etzlo vedarkan lehannichan bakkis vechayyotze bo. aval im en darkan lehannichan bichli ze hu pasha beatzmo. ketzad. hare shechataf chemet o sal meleim umechuppim vehishlicham layyam o serafan. vetaan hannizzak shemmargaliyyot hayu betochan. eno neeman veen mashbiin oto al kach. sheen derech bene adam lehanniach margaliyyot besallim uvachamatot. veim tafas en motziin miyyado. ella nishba shemmargaliyyot hayu bah venotel mimma sheyyesh etzlo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Yada hammazzik shehakkis haya bo zehuvim aval eno yodea kamma hayu. veomer hannizzak elef hayu. notel elef belo shevua. veeno yachol lehishshava kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan happikkadon:

Hammoser mamon chavero bide annas chayyav leshallem min hayyafe shebbinchasav. veim met govin miyyorshav kishar kol hammazzikin. ben shehaya haannas akkum ben shehaya yisrael hare ze hammoser chayyav leshallem kol ma shellakach haannas. af al pi shello nasa hammoser velo natan beyado ella hirgil bilvad:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehera hammoser meatzmo. aval im anasuhu ovde kochavim o yisrael annas lehareot vehera hare ze patur min hattashlumin. veim nasa venatan bayyad af al pi shehu anus chayyav leshallem. shehammatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero chayyav leshallem:

Ketzad. hare sheggazar hammelech lehavi lo yayin o teven vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. veamad moser veamar hare yesh lifloni otzar yayin o teven bemakom peloni vehalchu ulekachuha. chayyav leshallem. anaso hammelech lemoser ze ad sheyyare lo otzrot yayin o teven o ad sheyyare lo mamon chavero shehu boreach millefanav vehera lo mippene haones hare ze patur. sheim lo yare lo yakkehu o yemitehu:

Nasa mamon chavero beyado unetano leannas chayyav leshallem mikkol makom. af al pi shehammelech anaso lehavi. bamme devarim amurim sheim anaso lehavi vehevi chayyav beshello higgia hammamon lirshut haannas. aval annas sheanas yisrael ad sheherahu veamad haannas al hammamon venaasa birshuto veanas et yisrael ad sheholicho lo lemakom acher. vaafillu holicho ze hammoser sheherahu. hare ze patur milleshallem. shekkevan sheamad haannas betzad haotzar kevar avad kol ma sheyyesh bo ucheillu nisraf:

Baale din shehayta benehem meriva al hakkarka o al mittaltelin. ze omer shelli veze omer shelli. veamad echad mehen umesarah beyad oved kochavim. menaddin oto sheyyachzir haddavar lichmo shehaya visallek yad annas mibbenehem veyaasu din beyisrael:

Mi shennitpas al chavero velakchu ovde kochavim mamon mimmennu biglal chavero. en chavero chayyav leshallem. en lecha mi shennitpas al chavero veyihye chavero chayyav leshallem chutz min hannitpas mippene hammas hakkatzuv al kol ish veish bechol shana o hannitpas al hatteshura shennoten kol ish veish lemelech beavro alehem hu o chelotav hare ze chayyav leshallem lo. vehu sheyyikchu mimmennu beferush biglal peloni bifne edim:

Mi sheyyesh alav edim shemmasar mamon chavero. kegon shehera meatzmo o shenneenas venasa venatan. velo yadu haedim kamma hifsido bimsirato vehannimsar omer kach vechach hifsidani. vehammoser kofer bema shettaano. im tafas hannimsar en motziin miyyado ella nishba binkitat chefetz vezoche bema shettafas. veim lo tafas en motziin min hammoser ella biraya berura:

En mashbiin et hammoser shehera meatzmo lo shevua chamura velo shevuat hesset. mippene shehu rasha veen lecha pasul yater mizze. aval hammoser sheanasuhu lehareot o lehavi venasa venatan bayyad. af al pi shehu chayyav leshallem eno rasha ella ben tashlumin hu bilvad umashbiin oto kishar hakkesherin:

Asur limsor haadam beyad akkum ben begufo ben bemamono. vaafillu haya rasha uvaal averot vaafillu haya metzer lo umetzaaro. vechol hammosro beyad akkum ben begufo ben bemamono en lo chelek laolam habba:

Muttar laharog hammoser bechol makom vaafillu bazzeman hazze sheen danin dine nefashot. umuttar lehargo kodem sheyyimsor ella kesheamar hareni moser peloni begufo o bemamono. vaafillu mamon kal hittir atzmo lemita. umatrin lo veomrin lo al timsor. im heez panav veamar lo ki ella emserennu mitzva lehargo vechol hakkodem lehargo zacha:

Asa hammoser asher zamam umasar. yerae li sheasur lehargo ella im ken huchzak limsor hare ze yeanesh shemma yimsor acherim. umaasim bechol zeman beare hammaarav laanosh hammosrim shehuchzeku limsor mamon bene adam velimsor hammosrim beyad haakkum leansham ulehakkotam uleasram kefi risham. vechen kol hammetzer latztzibbur umetzaaran muttar lemasro beyad akkum lehakkoto uleasro ulekanso. aval mippene tzaar yachid asur leasro. veasur leabbed mamono shel moser veaf al pi shemmuttar leansho shehare mamono leyorshav:

Rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehargo o lidvar avera veshavar et hakkelim ben shel nirdaf ben shel kol adam. patur min hattashlumin mippene shehu mitchayyev benafsho. shekkevan sheradaf hittir atzmo lemita:
Nirdaf sheshshavar kelim shel rodef patur. lo yehe mamono chaviv miggufo. veim shavar kelim acherim chayyav. shehammatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero chayyav:

Mi sheradaf achar harodef lehoshia hannirdaf veshavar et hakkelim ben shel rodef ben shel kol adam patur. velo min haddin ella takkana hi shello yimmana millehatztzil o yitmahmeah viayyen beet sheyyirdof:

Sefina shechishsheva lehishshaver mikkoved hammassoy. veamad echad mehen vehekel mimmassaah vehishlich bayyam patur. shehammassa shebbah kemo rodef acharehem lehargam umitzva rabba asa shehishlich vehoshiam: seliku lehu hilchot chovel umazzik besad
Mishneh Torah, Other Sources of Defileme: Hannevela av meavot hattumot. kezayit mibbesarah metamme adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir. umetamme et haadam bemassa letamme begadim kemerkav hazzav. ketzad. adam shennaga binvela nitma vahare hu rishon letuma. veim naga bechelim afillu bishat maggao binvela hare hen tehorin. vechen kelim shealav tehorin lefi [shehu] valad veen valad metamme kelim. aval hannose et hannevela metamme kelim bishat nesiato shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 28)</small> "vehannsho et nivlatam yechabbes begadav". veotan habbegadim rishon letuma. veeno metamme lo adam velo kele cheres vaafillu bishat nesiato kemo shebbearnu bimtammee mishkav umoshav:

Echad behema vechayya ben hammuttarin baachila ben haasurin im metu kullan besaran metamme bichzayit. ushechitat behema tehora vechayya tehora metaharto bechol makom. vaafillu shachat chullin baazara vekadashim bachutz hare ellu tehorin. veim era pissul bashshechita hare zo nevela umetammea bemassa kemo shebbearnu behilchot shechita:

Behema temea vechayya temea en hashshechita moelet bah veechad hashshochatah o hannocharah o hachonkah o shemmeta kedarkah hare zo nevela. vechol hannevelot mitztarfot leinyan tuma lichzayit echad temeot veechad tehorot:
Moach hare hu kevasar. vedam hannevela eno metamme kinvela ella hare hu kemashkin temeim sheeno metamme lo adam velo kelim min hattora:

Chelev behema tehora shemmeta tahor. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 24)</small> "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha veachol lo tochluhu" mi sheissuro mishshum nevela uterefa. veim huchshar bemashkin hammachshirin hare hu koochalin temein veeno kivsar nevela. vehannogea bachelev hachofe et hakkulya kodem haferasha hare ze tame kenogea bakkulya atzmah shehare kamma chutin nimshachin mimmenna bachelev. aval behema temea vehachayya ben tehora ben temea echad besarah veechad chelbah letuma. umetamme adam vechelim bichzayit kivsar hannevela:
Hakkevi chelbo metamme kivsaro vetumato besafek. lefichach en sorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin karet al tumato veal biat hammikdash o al achilat kadashav:

Veellu devarim sheen metammein min hannevelot. haatzamot vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim afillu ikkaran harach sheim yachtoch min hachay yotze dam. vehaor af al pi sheeno meubbad. vehaalal vehaggidim vehammarak vehattavlin shemmitbashshelin immah. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheppershu min hannevela. aval hannogea beechad mikkol ellu keshehen mechubbarin babbasar hare ze tame. vehu sheyyihye babbasar kezayit. sheen echad mikkol ellu mitztaref lichzayit:
Haalal ben sheppelatattu chayya ben sheppelatattu sakkin eno mitztaref lichzayit. veim kenaso vehaya bo kezayit metamme:

Veellu behemot sheorotehem kivsaram. or chazir shel yishshuv veor chatoteret haggamal harakka veor bet habboshet veor hashshelil veor shettachat haalya. hare ellu metammein min hannevela. veim ibbedan o halach bahen kede avoda hare ellu tehorim. veim asa bahen maase shebbittelan tehorin af al pi shello halach bahen kede avoda. ketzad. ozen chamor shettelaah lichfifato tehora. kamma hu kede avoda arbaa milin. vee zo hi chatoteret rakka kol zeman shello taana. higgia zemannah liton velo taana o shettaana kodem sheyyaggia zemannah hare ze safek:

Hammafshit nivlat behema o chayya ben temea ben tehora ben dakka ben gassa. im lishticha hifshit kevan shehifshit min haor kede achiza vehu shene tefachim hannogea beor ze shehufshat tahor. vead shello hifshit shene tefachim hannogea baor kenogea babbasar. hifshitah kede laasot min haor chemet hare haor chibbur ad sheyyafshit et kol hechaze. veim hifshitah meragleha bilvad hare haor kullo chibbur vehannogea baor kenogea babbasar ad sheyyafrish haor kullo meal habbasar. vechen hammafshit bishratzim chibbur ad sheyyafshit kullo. or sheal hatztzavvar chibbur ad sheyyafshit kullo. vechol or shehu chibbur letamme kach hu chibbur lehittamme. sheim hayta shechuta venaga tuma beor ze shehu chibbur nitma habbasar:

Or sheyyesh alav kezayit nevela hannogea batztziv hayyotze mimmennu uvisaro shekkenegdo meachore haor nitma mippene shehaor bisaro shomer labbasar. bamme devarim amurim sheppelatattu chayya. aval pelatattu sakkin im haya meruddad batel aggav haor:

Or sheyyesh alav kishne chatzae zetim besar nevela haor mevattelan veenan metammein lo bemagga velo bemassa. shekkol sheeno metamme min hannevela bemagga eno metamme bemassa. aval shene chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam hannosan tame shehare nasa kezayit vehannogea tahor sheen chibbure adam chibbur vehu sheyyihyu shenehen meruddadin udevukin ze baze ad sheyyinnatlu keechad. aval im haya chatzi zayit ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo bekesam echad afillu holich vehevi kol hayyom kullo tahor:

Besar nevela shennifsad vehivish venifsal milleechol hakkelev tahor. lefichach netzel hannevela safek im metamme bichzayit im lo. besar nevela sheyyavash im yachol lishrot befoshrin meet leet velachazor lach verauy lakkelev metamme veim lav tahor vaafillu koochalin temein eno mittame:

Besar nevela shehaya saruach meikkaro veeno rauy lemaachal adam hare ze tahor shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah" ad shettihye techillatah reuya leger:
Shilya shel nevela hare hi keferesh ucherei veenah metammea kinvela. veim chashav aleha laachila mittamme tumat ochalin. hakkeva vehechalav shel nevela tehorin mikkelum:

Behema sheshshafa chararat dam af al pi shenniftera min habbechora enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa ad sheyyihye bah tzurat nefel lefi shehi betela barov hayyotze immah. lefichach hi tehora af al pi shehayta reuya lagger aggav immah:

Nevela shennitarva bishchuta im rov min hashshechuta betela hannevela bashshechuta veen hakkol metamme bemagga. aval im nasa hakkol nitma shei efshar lishchuta shettachzor nevela aval hannevela efshar shettithar keshettisrach lefichach tibbatel:

Behema o chayya temea shennishchata enah metammea mishshum nevela kol zeman shehi mefarkeset ad sheyyattiz et roshah vahare hi koochalin temein. necharah vahare hi mefarkeset en bah afillu tumat ochalin kol zeman shehi mefarkeset. veevar happoresh min hamefarkeset asur livne noach keforesh min hachay uvasar happoresh mimmenna keforesh min hachay. vechen tehora shennifsela bishchitatah vaadayin hi mefarkeset o shachat bah echad o rov echad en lah tuma kelal ad shettamut. chalak behema lishnayim o shennittela yarech vechalal shellah hare zo nevela umetammeah bemassa uvemagga af al pi shehi adayin bachayyim. vechen im keraah miggabbah o shennishbera mifreket verov basar ammah hare zo kinvela lechol davar:
Behema shemmet ubbarah betoch meeha vehoshit haroe et yado venaga bo ben bivhema temea ben bithora hare ze hannogea tahor ad sheyyetze hannefel laavir haolam:

Basar happoresh mibbehema vechayya keshehen chayyin ben tehorin ben temein tahor veeno metamme kinvela. aval evar min hachay happoresh mehen metamme kinvela. echad evar min hachay happoresh min habbehema atzmah o evar happoresh min hashshalil shebbevitnah. vehaevarim en lahen shiur afillu haya kisora o pachot metamme vehu sheyyihye haevar kivriyyato basar vegidin vaatzamot veyihye alav basar kede lehaalot arucha. haya habbasar pachot mehaalot arucha bechay o chasar atzmo tahor:
Hakkulya vehallashon vehassafa vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen evarim veen osin chalifin hoil veen bahem etzem hare hen kevasar:

Habbasar o haevar hameduldalin bivhema o chayya sheenan yecholin lichyot ulehadbik bishar hagguf enan metammein kinvela kol zeman shehabbehema bachayyim vahare hen kishar ochalin im huchsheru mekabbelin tuma bimkomah. nishchata habbehema huchsheru bishchita veenan metammein kinvela sheen hashshechita osa otan kemo sheppershu mechayyim. aval im meta habbehema habbasar shehaya meduldal bah tzarich hechsher. vehaevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar min hannevela. uma ben evar min hachay leevar min hannevela. shehabbasar happoresh meevar min hachay tahor. vehabbasar happoresh meevar min hannevela metamme bichzayit bemagga uvemassa. veze veze shavin leshiur:

Terefa shennishchata shechita keshera af al pi shehi asura baachila hare hi tehora. vechen hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah ebbar met shechitat immo metaharto mide nevela. matza bah ben shemona chay nitraf. af al pi shennishchat achar shennitraf en shechitato metaharattu miyyadi nevela lefi sheen lemino shechita. lefichach velad behema shello shaha shiva yamim gemurin im shechato betoch shiva en shechitato metaharattu mide nevela mippene shehu kenefel:

Hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah ben tisha chay kodem sheyyahaloch al hakkarka af al pi sheen tzarich shechita kemo shebbearnu shehare shechitat immo metaharattu im nitmet immo lo nitma hu. veim nitnabbela immo hare hu tahor sheen hachay mittamme lo tumat ochalin velo tumat nevelot veaf al pi shehu keevar meevareha. veim met kodem sheyyafris al gabbe karka hare hu tahor sheshshechitat immo tiharattu:
Terefa shennishchata af al pi shehi tehora min hattora im naga bah hekdesh nitma middivre sofrim vezo maala yetera sheasu bekodesh:

Behema hammaksha leled vehotzi haubbar et yado vachatachah veachar kach shachat et immo haevar shennechtach nevela ushear besar haubbar tahor. shachat et immo veachar kach chatachah haevar kitrefa shennishchata ushear besar haubbar magga terefa shechuta shehi metammea et hakkodesh aval lo et hatteruma. hotzi haubbar et yado ben shechitat siman lishchitat siman vachatacho mitztaref shechitat siman lesiman letaher haevar mide nevela:

Shechitat akkum nevela umetammea bemassa vaafillu yisrael omed al gabbav. veim shachat besakkin yafa shechita karauy echad haakkum veechad hakkuti o ger toshav shechitatan nevela. vekarov beenay sheaf ze middivre sofrim shehare tumat avoda zara vetumat tikravtah middivrehem kemo sheyyitbaer. uviglal avoda zara nitrachaku hakkutim veneesra shechitatan. veim tomar vahalo hi asura baachila din tora. lo kol haasur baachila metamme shehare hatterefa asura utehora. vei efshar lechayyev karet al tuma zo al biat mikdash vaachilat kadashav ella biraya berura:

Kuleyayt hannevela hannogea bah o nosah tahor shekkol davar min hannevela sheeno metamme bemagga eno metamme bemassa. nikkeva kol shehu hannogea bah o nosah tame. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammoach shebbah mitkashkesh shehare enah maala arucha. aval im haya omed bimkomo im yesh bo kede lehaalot arucha laetzem mibbachutz hare zo metammea bemagga uvemassa kechol haevarim. uchevar perashnu shehakkulit hi haetzem hassatum mikkol tzedadav:
Kulit shechashav aleha lenakkevah vaadayin lo nikkevah hare hannogea bah safek tame. shehare yesh baddavar safek i mechussar nekiva kimchussar maase o lo:

Nivlat haof hattahor metamma min hattora. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 15)</small> "vechol nefesh asher tochal nevela uterefa baezrach uvagger vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim" eno medabber ella beochel nivlat haof hattahor bilvad shehu asur mishshum nevela uterefa. vechetzad hi tumatah. enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa velo keshehi betoch happe ella betoch bet habbelia. shenneemar vechol nefesh asher tochal enah metammea ella keshehi bevet hannefesh. veze shenneemar tochal latet shiur letumatah keshiur achila shehu kezayit. vahare neemar bah vechibbes begadav melammed shehammittamme bah metamme begadav ad sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. habbolea kezayit minnivlat haof hattahor venaga bechelim bishat beliato temeim venaasu rishon letuma. haya nogea beadam uvichle cheres bishat beliato lo timmean kemo shebbearnu bishar avot hattumot. veachar shebbala eno metamme shear kelim shehare hu kichli rishon letuma achar shepperesh mimmetammeav sheaf al pi shehu taun tevila vehaarev shemesh eno metamme kelim: 
En nivlat haof hattahor tzericha machashava letamme tuma zo hachamura ella kevan shebbala mimmenna kezayit mikkol makom hare zo metammea bevet habbelia. chashav aleha laachila hare zo metammea tumat ochalin vahare hi keochel rishon letuma af al pi shello naga bah tuma acheret veenah tzericha hechsher: 
Para adumma useirin hannisrafim enan ken. af al pi shehen metammein hammitassek bahen im chashav alehen laachila tzerichin shettigga bahen tuma veachar kach yittammeu tumat ochalin: 
Kezayit minnivlat habbehema shettechavo bechush vehichnis letoch mei haishsha millematta. o shehichniso letoch beliato shel chavero bemakom shennivlat haof hattahor metammea. hare ze timmeo mishshum nose lo mishshum nogea kemo shebbearnu bitchillat hassefer: 
Hakkorech kezayit mibbesar nivlat haof hattahor bachazeret vechayyotze bah uvelao af al pi shello naga bigrono hare ze tame. keracho besiv uvelao hare ze tahor: 
Habbolea nivlat haof hattahor veachar shebbelaah hekiah kodem shettitakkel hare ze eno metamme begadim keshettetze ligrono beshaa shemmekiah. sheenah metammea bevet hannefesh ella bishat belia lo beshaa shemmekiah: 
Mei shel nivlat haof hattahor shebbelao miktzato bevet habbelia umiktzato bachutz letoch piv im yesh bevet habbelia kezayit hare ze tame veim lav tahor: 
Bala mimmenna evar shalem sheen bo kezayit eno mittamme. afillu natal tzippor vaachalah im yesh bah kezayit nitma veim lav tahor: 
Hakkenafayim vehannotza af al pi shehen koochalim umittammein umetammein tumat ochalin enan mitztarfin benivlat haof hattahor lichzayit. aval hammekomot harakkim hakkerovim labbasar min hachartom vehatztzipparnayim hare hen kevasar umitztarfin lichzayit. rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav vehaatzamot afillu harakkot enan mitztarfin: 
Haochel minnivlat haof hattahor min haatzamot harakkin o min haggidin umin hashshelal shel betzim umin haddam umibbasar min hachay mimmennu tahor. aval haochel min haeshkol shel betzim umin hakkurkevan umin bene hammeayim o shehimcha et hachelev beur ugemao hare ze tame keochel mibbesaram shehashshote bichlal ochel. himchahu bachamma ugemao tahor shehare hisricho: 
Nivlat haof hattahor shennifseda milleechol hakkelev tehora. vechen im yavsha kecheres veenah yechola lehishsharot befoshrin meet leet lachzor lichmot shehayta hare zo tehora. vehaochel netzel shel nivlat haof hattahor hare ze tahor: 
Of tahor shennitraf venishchat shechita keshera shechitato metaharto vaafillu nishchat baazara. veim nimlak venimtza terefa en melikato metaharto. nimtzeta omer shehashshochet of tahor ben bachutz ben bifnim ben kadashim ben chullin hare ze tahor. vehammolek chullin bifnim o shemmalak kadashim bachutz hare ellu metammein begadim bevet habbelia: 
Hammolek kadashim bifnim im hayu reuyin lekarban velo nimtzeu bahen mumin shebbearnu bimkomo hare ellu tehorin. kayyotze bo egla arufa shenneerefet kehilchatah tehora kappara ketiv bah kekadashim. vechen im nishchata achar yeridatah lannachal af al pi sheasura bahanaa hitztzila otah shechitatah mide nevela: 
Nivlat haof hattame tehora veenah metammea bevet habbelia. veim chashav aleha laachila vehuchshera hare hi koochalin temein shehen rishon letuma. uchenafayim vehannotza vehamekomot harakkim min hachartom umin hatztzipparnayim shellah hare hen kivsarah: 
Echad haof hattahor veechad haof hattame evar min hachay happoresh mehem tahor veen bo tuma kelal. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 24)</small> "uleelle tittammau" <small>(Vayikra 11 26)</small> "lechol habbehema" lehotzi et haof sheen lo parsa. umippi hashshemua lamdu shello ba hakkatuv ella letamme evar min hachay shel behema o chayya: 
Evar min hammet min haof hare hu kenivlat haof shepperash mimmennu. im hayta nivlat of tahor metammea tuma chamura bevet habbelia bichzayit. veim chashav alav laachila mittamme tumat ochalin. veim hayta nivlat of tame mittamme tumat ochalin im chashav alav vehuchshar. veeno metamme ochalin acherim ad sheyyihye bo kevetza keshiur kol hoochalin letamme kemo sheyyitbaer:
Shemonna sheratzim haamurin battora. vehen hacholed vehaachbar vehatztzav vehaanaka vehalletaa vehakkoach vehattinshemet vehachomet. tumat kullan shava vehen hannikrain sheretz leinyan tuma:

Hashsheretz av meavot hattumot metamme adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir veeno metamme bemassa. vehannogea bo eno metamme begadim bishat maggao. veshiur tumato bechaadasha vechol hashsheratzim mitztarfin lechaadasha:
Haevarim en lahen shiur. evar min hashsheretz kivriyyato:
Basar vegidim vaatzamot shehu pachot mikkaadasha ben shepperash min hachay ben shepperash min hammet metamme tumato. vehu sheyyihye babbasar shealav o bammoach shebbaetzem kede lehaalot arucha:
Basar min hachay happoresh min hashsheretz tahor sheen metamme ella evar haddome lashsheretz kullo. ma sheretz basar vegidim vaatzamot af evar happoresh basar vegidim vaatzamot:
Hakkulya vehakkaved vehallashon vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen evar veen osin chalifin hare hen kevasar. veim pershu min hachay tehorin:
Dam hashsheretz kivsaro umitztaref lechaadasha kol zeman shehu mechubbar babbasar:

Atzmot hashsheretz vegidav vetzipparnav tehorin. veor hacholed vehaachbar vehatztzav vehattinshemet tahor af al pi shehu lach vaadayin lo ibbedo velo halach bo. aval or haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet kivsaran umetamme bechaadasha. veim ibbedan o shehillech bahen kede avoda tehorin. vechamma hi kede avoda kede hilluch arbaa milin:

Kuleyayt hashsheretz hannogea bah tahor af al pi shehi melea moach vehu sheyyihye hammoach mitkashkesh sheeno maale arucha. aval im haya omed bimkomo veyesh bo kede lehaalot arucha bah mibbachutz hare hannogea bah tame kechol haevarim sheyyesh bahen kede lehaalot arucha kemo shebbearnu. nikkeva hakkulit bechol shehu hannogea bah mikkol makom tame:
Betzat hashsheretz hamerukkemet af al pi shehashsheretz niret mittochah tehora. nikkeva kol shehu hannogea bah tame:
Sheretz shechetzyo basar vechetzyo adama hannogea babbasar tame uvaadama tahor. veim hishritz al pene kullo af hannogea baadama sheadayin lo nigmera tzurato tame:

Besar hashsheretz shennifsad vehivish venifsal milleechol hakkelev tahor. yavash ad shennaasa kacheres im yachol lehasherot befoshrin meet leet velachazor lach keshehaya metamme veim lav tahor vaafillu koochalin temeim eno metamme. bamme devarim amurim bemiktzat hashsheretz. aval sheretz sheyyavash veshildo kayyam o shennisraf veshildo kayyam hoil vetavnit kullo omedet hare ze metamme. vekarov beenay shettuma zo middivrehem:

Kezayit min hannevela o kaadasha min hashsheretz shetztzamku vechasru tehorin. pachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz ufachot mikkezayit min hannevela shettafchu veamdu al kashshiur metammein middivre sofrim. hayu battechilla kashshiur vetzamku vechazru vetafchu ad shehiggiu leshiuran hare ellu metammein keshehayu din tora. vechen atta omer bichzayit min hammet:

Hashsheretz eno metamme ad sheyyamut. huttezu rashehen af al pi sheadayin harosh meore beor hagguf af al pi shehen mefarkesin kiznav halletaa metammein. shear shekatzim uremasim kullan kegon hatztzefardea vehannachash vehaakrav vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen asurin baachila hare hen tehorin mikkelum vaafillu koochalin temein enan. veen lecha bechol hashsheratzim ma shemmetamme bemoto chutz mishshemonat hamminin hameforashin battora:

Shichvat zera meavot hattuma metammea adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir veenah metammea bemassa veen hammittamme bah metamme begadim bishat maggao. veechad hannogea bah veechad haroe otah bivsaro shenehen rishon letuma din tora. vechamma shiurah lenogea bechaadasha velaroe bechol shehu. veen haroe tame ad shettetze mimmennu veyachtom mimmennu pi amma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 32)</small> <small>(Vayikra 22 4)</small> "asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara". lefichach afillu raa bekesam hoil vehiggia lefi amma nitma. veechad haroe mechamat besaro o haroe beones tame: 
En shichvat zera shel katan metammea ad sheyyihye ben tesha shanim veyom echad: 
Shichvat zera adumma tehora ad shettihye levana venimshechet: 
Vechol shichvat zera sheen gufo shel adam margish bah enah metammea. lefichach im raa belo kishshuy uvelo taava enah metammea mishshum shichvat zera. neekra beharegasha af al pi sheyyatzta shello beharegasha tame: 
Hameharher ballayla veraa sheshshimmesh mitta bachalom veamad umatza besaro cham af al pi shello matza shichvat zera hare ze tame kevan shehirgish sheshshimmesh bachalom kevar raa beharegasha ulefichach matza besaro cham vehayta meat venitkannecha bivsaro o bechelav ulefichach lo matza lachluchit. hirher velo matza besaro cham o shemmatza besaro cham velo hirher tahor: 
Hammetil mayim veraa mayim chalukin o achurim battechilla tahor. raa otam baemtza o bassof hare ze tame. hayu hammayim shehetil kullam mittechilla vead sof chalukin o achurim hare ze tahor. hayu levanim venimshachin tame. vehammetil tippim avot mittoch haamma tahor: 
Baal keri shettaval velo hetil mayim kodem sheyyitbol kesheyyatil mayim tame mippene tzichtzuche shichvat zera sheenan yotzin ella kesheyyatil mayim. bamme devarim amurim bechole o bezaken. aval yeled bari tahor mippene shehu yore shichvat zera bechazka kechetz vehi kullah ninteket min haamma. ad kamma hu yeled kol zeman shehu omed al raglo achat venoel o choletz minalo veim eno yachol laasot ken mippene chalyo hare ze chole leinyan ze: 
Vechol ishsha sheshshimmesha mittatah veyarda vetavla kodem shettekanneach atzmah yafe yafe hare hi betumatah: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha sheshshimmeshu mittatan shenehen temeim. ushenehen rishon letuma din tora. veen haishsha temea mishshum nogaat beshichvat zera shennegiat bet hassetarim enah negia. ella hameshammeshet hare hi keroa keri. vehu shettihye bat shalosh shanim veyom echad shenneemar [<small>(Vayikra 15 18)</small> "veishsha asher yishkav ish otah"]. hayta ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim enah mittammea bishchiva. aval mittammea bingiat shichvat zera im naga bivsarah mibbachutz.
