[lefichach habboel gedola shello kedarkah tehora]. shello timme otah hakkatuv betumat bet hassetarim ella kedarkah: 
Habboel et haishsha velo hotzi shichvat zera tahor af al pi sheheera. vechen haishsha tehora ad sheyyotzi haish: 
Haishsha sheppalta shichvat zera im palta otah betoch shalosh onot hare hi temea keroa keri. lefichach soteret yom echad im hayta zava keish sheraa keri. umittammeah bechol shehu af al pi shello yatzat lachutz ella neekra vehiggia leven hashshinnayim nitmea shehare shichvat zera kedamah ma damah metamme bifnim af shichvat zera shettiflot tetamme otah bifnim: 
Shichvat zera atzmah shennifleta betoch hashshalosh onot metammea acherim shennagu bah kederech shettimmea haishsha sheppalta otah. veim palta achar shalosh onot hare haishsha tehora vechen shichvat zera shennifleta tehora shekkevar nifseda tzuratah: 
Vechamma hi ona. yom o layla. veen haona shennivala bah min hamminyan. ketzad. nivala belel hashshabbat shalosh onot shellah yom hashshabbat velel echad beshabbat veechad beshabbat im palta betoch zeman ze temea. palta millel sheni vahala tehora. vehaish sheppersha mimmennu shichvat zera afillu leachar kamma onot hare zo temea kol zeman shehi lecha vehapporesh mimmennu tame: 
Shichvat zera enah metammea ella keshehi lecha. yavsha kecheres tehora. veim yechola lishrot meet leet befoshrin velachazor lichmot shehayta hare zo temea: 
Kevar bearnu beferek ze sheharoe keri vehaishsha sheshshachav ish otah shichvat zera vehannogea beshichvat zera temeim min hattora. vechen haishsha sheppalta betoch shalosh onot hare hi temea min hattora keroa keri. aval shear haamurin beferek ze shehen temeim kegon mehareher umetil mayim enan temein ella middivrehem velo gazru alehem tuma ella litruma aval lechullin tehorin: 
Nachrit sheppalta shichvat zera shel yisrael betoch hashshalosh onot. vechen habbehema sheppalta shichvat zera shel yisrael betoch zeman ze hare otah hannifletet temea. pelatattu leachar zeman ze hare hi safek nisrecha o adayin lo nisrecha: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot metammee mishkav umoshav sheshshichvat zaro shel akkum tahor mikkelum lefichach bat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera shel akkum afillu betoch shalosh onot tehora: 
Akkum shehirgish venitgayyer veyarad vetaval veyatza mimmennu shichvat zera shehirgish bah achar shettaval hare ze sefek tame: 
Gedola sheshshachav otah katan pachot mibben tesha [o akkum o behema] hare zo tehora shenneemar [<small>(Vayikra 15 18)</small> "veishsha asher yishkav ish otah"] ad sheyyihye hashshochev ish umiyyisrael kemo shebbearnu:

Tumat avoda zara middivre sofrim veyesh lah remez battora <small>(Bereshit la 2)</small> "hasiru et elohe hannechar asher betochchem vehittaharu vehachalifu simlotechem". vearbaa avot hattumot yesh bah. avoda zara atzmah. umeshammesheha. vetikrovet shellah. veyayin shennitnassech lah. vetumat kullan middivrehen: 
Avoda zara atzmah metammea adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir veenah metammea bemassa kesheretz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "shakketz teshakketzennu". veshiurah kezayit lo tihye zo chamura min hammet. aval im hayta hatztzura pechuta mikkezayit tehora: 
Katzatz evar mimmenna afillu haya kemardea hare ze tahor sheavoda zara enah metammea leevarim ella hatztzura kullah keshehi shelema shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 30 22)</small> "tizrem kemo dava" ma dava enah metammea leevarim af avoda zara enah metammea leevarim. kekulle avot hattumot danu bah mippene shettumatah middivrehem asauha kesheretz sheeno metamme bemassa uchemet sheeno metamme ella bichzayit uchenidda sheenah metammea leevarim: 
Nitparka avoda zara af al pi shehahedyot yachol lehachezirah vahare kol evareha kayyamim enah metammea: 
Kol meshammeshe avoda zara kesheretz metammein adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir veenan metammein bemassa. veshiur tumatan bichzayit vaafillu kitztzetz mimmeshammesheha kezayit min hakkeli metamme kesheretz. zo chomer bimshammesheha yoter meavoda zara atzmah. uvet avoda zara atzmo avanav veetzav vaafaro metammein bichzayit bemagga kechol hameshammeshin: 
Hammachnis rosho verubbo levet avoda zara nitma kenogea. vechen keli cheres shehichnis aviro levet avoda zara nitma. safsalim vekatedraot shehichnis rubban levet avoda zara temeim vechullan rishon letuma: 
Tikrovet avoda zara metammea bemagga uvemassa kinvela veshiurah bichzayit. kol davar shemmakrivin lah ben basar ben shear ochalim umashkin hakkol kinvela shehakkatuv keraan <small>(Tehillim 106 28)</small> "zivche metim". veaf al pi sheen tikrovet avoda zara shel ochalin betelin leolam lehattirah bahanaa im bittela hare zo safek letuma. aval keli shehu tikrovet avoda zara shebbittelo tahor vechen avoda zara umeshammesheha shebbittelan tehorin: 
Yayin shennitnassech laavoda zara metamme adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir. umetamme adam bemassa kinvela vetumato bichzayit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 38)</small> "asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham" hare yen nesicham kechelev zevachemo. veen metamme tuma zo ella yayin shennitnassech bayyad lifne avoda zara aval setam yenan shel akkum metamme tuma kalla kishar kol mashkin temein: 
Mikkol haddevarim shebbearnu mittechillat hassefer ad kan atta lamed sheavot hattumot mehen avot shel tora umehen avot shel divre sofrim: 
Kol hammittamme mechamat av shel tora hare hu velad tuma shel tora vechol hammittamme mechamat av shel divrehem hare ze valad shel divrehem: 
Kol av tuma shemmetamme bemagga veeno metamme bemassa ben av shel tora ben av shel divrehem adam hannogea bo eno metamme begadim bishat maggao. velo adam velo keli cheres af al pi sheadayin lo perash mimmetammeav. vehinno achar shepperash mimmetammeav o kodem sheyyifrosh valad shehu metamme ochalin veose otan sheni letuma mippene shehu rishon: 
Vechol av tuma shemmetamme bemagga uvemassa ben av shel tora ben av shel divrehem adam hannogea bo o hannoso metamme begadim bishat maggao uvishat nesiato veose otan rishon letuma. vechen im naga boochalin asaan rishon kol zeman shello perash mimmetammeav. perash mimmetammeav hare hu rishon letuma lechol davar veeno metamme begadim veim naga boochalin hare hen sheni. bamme devarim amurim bishar kol haavot chutz min hannevelot vehammerkav. aval hannevela vehammerkav af al pi shemmetammein bemagga uvemassa hannogea bahen eno metamme begadim bishat maggao veim naga boochalin hare hen sheni letuma. vehannose metamme begadim bishat nesiato veim naga boochalin ad shello perash hinnam rishon letuma kemo shebbearnu: 
Me chattat sheyyesh bahen kede hazzaa af al pi shehen kinvela uchemerkav sheen metammein begadim ella hannosan hare hannogea bahen metamme begadim bishat maggao mishshum nose shei efshar sheyyigga bammayim shello yasit otan. uchevar bearnu sheechad hannose veechad hammesit. vechen hannogea betzemer hannevela o shennaga benime hammerkav metamme begadim bishat maggao mishshum nose. shei efshar lingoa bidvarim ellu shello yasit otan. ulefichach metamme begadim ad shello perash kedin hannose: 
Habbolea nivlat of hattahor bishat beliato metamme begadim kemo shebbearnu vehen rishon letuma. vechen im naga boochalin hare hen rishon letuma. veachar shebbala hare ze perash mimmetammeav: 
Hassoref para adumma useirim hannisrafim vehameshalleach et hassair af al pi shebbishat maasehen metamme begadim kemo shebbearnu. im nagu boochalin afillu bishat maasehen hare hen sheni letuma: 
Hannogea beav meavot hattumot hammushlach betoch hammikve. kegon nevela o sheretz o mishkav shehu bemikve venaga bo hare ze tame. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 36)</small> "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor venogea benivlatam yitma" afillu keshehen betoch hammikve metammein. uchesheyyaale min hammikve ze hannogea yithar. [vehannosan metamme begadim bishat nesiatan. veim naga boochalim ad shello perash hare hen rishon letuma kemo shebbearnu]. vechen zav sheddaras al hammishkav shehu munnach bammikve hare hammishkav tame. uchesheyyaale hammishkav min hammikve yithar shehare alta lo tevila veze hannogea bammishkav keshehu bammikve im pashat yado venogea chutz lammikve hare ze metamme begadim veen tzarich lomar shehu metamme ochalin umashkin:

Davar meforash battora shehoochalin vehammashkin mittammein shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 34)</small> "mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim yitma vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma". veen haochel shennitma metamme ochel acher min hattora. velo hammashkin shennitmeu metammein davar acher min hattora. aval middivre sofrim gazru al haochel hattame sheim naga beochel acher timmeahu. vechen im naga ochel hattame bemashkin temein. veen ochel metamme keli shennaga bo leolam vaafillu middivrehem. vechen gazru al hammashkin hattemeim sheyyetammeu ochalin o mashkin o kelim shennagu bahen: 
En lecha velad tuma shemmetamme kelim ella mashkin temeim bilvad. vetuma zo middivrehem vehu sheyyihyu otan hammashkin temein mechamat av meavot hattumot ben shel tora ben shel divrehem. umippene ma gazru al hammashkin temein sheyyetammeu kelim gezera mishshum mashke hazzav shehu av umetamme kelim din tora. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 8)</small> "vechi yarok hazzav battahor" kemo shebbearnu: 
Kesheggazru al hammashkin sheyyetammeu et hakkelim gazru sheyyihyu metammein et hakkelim mittochan. ketzad. im naflu laavir keli cheres nitma kullo vahare hu sheni veim nagu bishar kelim mittochan metamme kullan venaasu sheniyyim. aval im nagu mashkin temeim baachore hakkeli sheyyesh lo toch ben bichli cheres ben bichli shetef ucheli mattachot nitmeu achorav bilvad vahare achorav sheni velo nitma tocho. bamme devarim amurim litruma. aval lekodesh keli shennitmeu achorav nitma kullo vahare kullo sheni letuma: 
Kevar bearnu shehoochalin en metammein kelim vehammashkin metammein. velamma asu betumat mashkin hekker ze veamru shehakkeli shennagu mashkin temein baachorav lo nitma tocho litruma. lehodia shettumat kelim ellu middivrehem shello yisrefu aleha teruma vekadashim: 
Kevar bearnu shehoochalin vehammashkin shennagu beav meavot hattumot hare hen rishon letuma. vechen im naga ochel beadam o bichli shennitma beav hare oto haochel sheni letuma. veochel shennaga beze hashsheni nikra shelishi letuma. veim naga hashshelishi beochel (revii) hare ze nikra revii letuma. bamme devarim amurim boochalin. aval hammashkin echad mashke shennaga beav hattuma o shennaga berishon o shennaga besheni hare oto hammashke techilla letuma umetamme et chavero vachavero et chavero afillu hen mea sheen monin bemashkin. ketzad. yayin shennaga beav hattuma o berishon o besheni hare yayin ze kerishon letuma. vechen im naga yayin ze beshemen veshemen bechalav vechalav bidvash udevash bemayim umayim beyayin acher vechen ad leolam kullan rishon letuma ucheillu kol echad mehen nitma beav techilla vechullan metammein et hakkelim. vechen keli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin venagu mashkin acherim baachore hakkelim hattemein afillu hayu mashkin chullin naasu hammashkin haacherim techilla letuma umetammein kelim acherim veosin otan sheniyyim veen tzarich lomar shehen metammein ochalin umashkin acherim: 
Achore hakkeli shennitmeu bemashkin venagu ochalin baachore hakkeli hattame afillu achle teruma hare hen tehorin shehakkeli shennitmeu achorav bilvad eno metamme et hoochalin ella lekodesh bilvad shehakkeli shennitmeu achorav hare ze tame kullo lekodesh kemo shebbearnu ulefichach metamme ochel hakkodesh:

Kol hannogea beyadav berishon letuma ben shehaya oto rishon adam o keli o ochel o mashkin temein nitmeu yadav bilvad ad happerek. vechen hammachnis yadav laavir keli cheres shennitma beav hattuma o shehichnis yadav levayit menugga nitmeu yadav. vetumat hayyadayim middivre sofrim: 
Hayyadayim sheniyyot middivre sofrim leolam sheen tumatan ella middivrehem uchesheggazru tuma alehen gazru sheyyihyu kesheni letuma. afillu hichnis yadav levayit hamenugga o shennaga beyadav beadam shemmetamme begadim ad shello perash mimmetammeav hare yadav sheniyyot: 
Happiggul vehannotar vetzarid shel menachot hare hen kerishon letuma umonin bahen rishon vesheni lefichach metammein et hayyadayim bichvetza. veen happiggul vehannotar mitztarfin af al pi sheshshiuran shava bichvetza hoil vetumat hayyadayim middivrehen. aval shear hoochalin mitztarfin sheen ochalim temein metammein et hayyadayim ad sheyyihyu kevetza: 
Kulit happiggul o hannotar af al pi shehi setuma hannogea bah beyadav nitmeu yadav shehaatzamot shel kadashim sheshshimmeshu notar o piggul metammein et hayyadayim hoil venaasu basis ledavar haasur: 
Besar kodesh sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato hare hu safek im metamme et hayyadayim o lo. lefichach eno metamme shessefek tumat hayyadayim tahor kemo sheyyitbaer. veim besar pesach sheyyatza chutz labbayit hu hare hu tahor, bene chavura zerizin hen: 
En tumat yadayim bammikdash. shebbeshaa sheggazru tuma al hayyadayim lo gazru bammikdash ella hannogea boochalin temeim vechayyotze bahen ben shennaga bammikdash ben shennaga chutz lammikdash venaga bekadashim bammikdash lo timmean. veim naga chutz lammikdash hare ze metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Mi shennitmet yado achat venaga baacheret haacheret tehora venotel et hattemea vedayyo. bamme devarim amurim litruma. aval lekodesh im nitmet yado achat venaga bashsheniyya timmeah. ushetehen tzerichot tevila lekodesh aval litruma bintilat yadayim bilvad yittaharu yadav: 
Shelomo hammelech uvet dino gazru al kol hayyadayim sheyyihyu sheniyyot veaf al pi shello yada bevadday shennitmeu mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot. velo gazar shelomo al hayyadayim tuma ella lekodesh. veachar kach gazru chachamim sheacharav af litruma. ulefichach tzarich netilat yadayim litruma veim naga bitruma kodem sheyyittol yadav pesula venisrefet al tuma zo: 
Lat adam yadav bemappa veochel teruma belo netilat yadayim veen choshshin shemma yigga aval lo yaase ken bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh o al tohorat teruma gezera shemma yigga lefi sheeno makpid alehen: 
Hoil vehayyadayim sheniyyot im nagu bemashke asaum techilla. veim nagu mashkin ellu boochalin osin otan sheni. veim nagu bemashkin acherim osin otan techilla shehammashkin techilla leolam kemo shebbearnu. aval en mashkin ellu shennitmeu mechamat hayyadayim metammein kelim sheikkar tumat hayyadayim middivrehem. vechen gazru chachamim al kol adam sheyyochal ochalin temein ben sheachal ochel rishon o ochel sheni veal kol hashshote mashkin temeim sheyyihye sheni letuma ad sheyyitbol. veim naga boochalin asaan shelishi. veim naga bemashkin afillu mashke chullin asaan techilla letamme ochalin umashkin acherim. aval lo letamme kelim hoil veikkar tumat adam ze middivrehem. umippene ma gazru tuma al haochel ochalin temeim. shemma yochal ochel rishon o sheni veyishte alav mashke teruma venimtza hammashke teruma tame baochel shebbefiv. vechen hashshote mashkin temeim shemma yochal immahen ochel teruma venimtza tame bemashkin shebbefiv. uchevar bearnu bitrumot sheasur leechol teruma temea: 
Eno mittamme ad sheyyochal maachalim temeim kachatzi peras shehu kevetza umechetza socheket. vechen hashshote eno mittamme ad sheyyishte mimmashkin temein reviit. vechol hoochalin mitztarfin lechachatzi peras lifsol et haggeviyya. vechol hammashkin mitztarfin lirviit. veim achal o shata pachot mishshiur ze tahor. achal meat veshaha veachal meat im yesh mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras mitztarfin veim lav en mitztarfin. vechen im shata meat veshaha veshata meat im yesh mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras mitztarfin veim lav en mitztarfin. achal pachot mikkeshiur vetaval veala veachal meat miyyad im lo shaha benehen vahare ben achila shellifne tevila veshelleachar tevila bichde achilat peras hare ellu mitztarfin: 
Ishsha shehi rishon letuma umenika et benah hare habben tahor velo gazru alav tuma sheafillu tomar sheyyanak reviit efshar sheyyesh mittechilla vead sof yeter mikkede achilat peras shehare eno yonek bevat achat: 
Hameubberet hittiru lah leechol ochalin temein pachot mikkeshiur. veaf al pi shehi ochelet harebe mippene hassakkana. veenah tzericha tevila ella hare hi tehora:

Habba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha login mayim sheuvin hare hu kesheni letuma ad sheyyitbol. veim naga boochalin asaan shelishi. veim naga bemashkin temeim asaan techilla letamme ochalim umashkin acherim aval lo letamme kelim. umippene ma gazru tuma al adam ze. mippene shehayu tevule yom tovlin bimarot shemmemehen raim veachar kach hayu rochatzin bemayim sheuvim yafim derech nekiyyut ufashat hamminhag kach ad shehayu rov haam medammim shemmayim sheuvim sherochatzin bahen baacharona hen shemmetaharin lo hattevila shebbeme mikve vehayu tovlin bezilzul belo kavvana. ulefichach gazru shekkol shebba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvim o shennaflu al rosho verubbo nitma venaasa kesheni letuma. afillu tahor sheeno tevul yom im naflu al rosho verubbo shelosha login mayim sheuvin o shebba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin hare ze kesheni letuma ad sheyyitbol. taval eno tzarich haarev shemesh mippene sheikkar tuma zo middivrehen. vechen haochel ochalin temeim vehashshote mashkin temein vetaval eno tzarich haarev shemesh. vechen kelim shennitmeu bemashkin kevan shemmatbilan tiharu veen tzerichin haarev shemesh mippene shettumot ellu ikkaran middivrehen: 
Mi shennaflu alav shelosha login mayim sheuvin mishshene kelim o mishshelosha im hitchil hashsheni ad shello pasak harishon mitztarfin veim lav en mitztarfin. naflu mearbaa kelim en mitztarfim veaf al pi shehitchil ze ad shello pasak ze hare ze tahor. naflu al rosho aval lo al rubbo o shennaflu al rubbo velo al rosho o shennaflu al rosho bilvad millemala veal rubbo naflu min hatztzad o millematta hare ze tahor ad sheyyippelu al rosho veal rubbo hassamuch lerosho kedarko. vechen im ba rosho bemayim sheuvin velo ba rubbo o ba rubbo velo ba rosho o shebba rosho bilvad uva mishshear gufo verubbo bemayim sheuvin millematta o min hatztzad hare ze tahor ad sheyyavo rosho verubbo hassamuch lerosho kedarko: 
Habba merosho verubbo hachetzi bemayim sheuvin venaflu al hachetzi haacher mayim sheuvin hoil vechetzyo binfila vechetzyo bevia tahor: 
Hayu sheloshet hallogin shennaflu alav o shebba bahen miktzatan sheuvin umiktzatan enan sheuvin o shennitarev bahen yayin devash vechalav hare ze tahor ad sheyyihyu hashshelosha kullan mayim sheuvin. sheloshet login ellu shennaflu al hattahor o shebba bahen vetimmeuhu kevan shennaasa kesheni letuma hare hammayim haellu temein shehare nagu besheni vahare ellu hammayim omrin laze hattahor timmenu oto vetimmeanu: 
Barishona hayu mannichin kikkarot shel teruma betzad hassefarim veomrim ze kodesh veze kodesh uvain haachbarim vekorin et hassefarim lefichach gazru shekkol teruma shettigga beechad mikkitve hakkodesh nitmet vahare hi kishlishi letuma keillu nagu besheni venimtzeu kol kitve hakkodesh poslin et hatteruma kesheni. velo od ella mi shehayu yadav tehorot venaga beechad mikkitve hakkodesh naasu yadav sheniyyot umetammein et hatteruma veet hammashkin veaf al pi sheen hayyadayim mittammeot ella merishon letuma kemo shebbearnu hen mittammeot min hassefer: 
Retzuot tefillin im hattefillin vegillayon shebbassefer shellemala veshellematta shebbattechilla veshebbassof keshehen mechubbarin lesefer. vesefer shennimchak venishtayyer bo shemonim vechamesh otiyyot. umegilla shekkatuv bah min hattora shemonim vechamesh otiyyot kefarashat <small>(Bamidbar 10 la)</small> "vayhi binsoa haaron". hare ellu metammein et hayyadayim. velo divre tora bilvad ella kol kitve hakkodesh afillu shir hashshirim vekohelet shehen divre chachma metammein et hayyadayim: 
Targum shebbeezra veshebbedaniyyel hare hu mikkelal kitve hakkodesh. aval targum shekketavo ivrit veivrit shekketavo targum o shekkatav kitve hakkodesh bichtav ivri enan metammein et hayyadayim ad sheyyihyu ketuvim ashshurit al haor uvidyo: 
Hakkotev hallel ushema letinok lehitlammed bo af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ellu metammein et hayyadayim: 
Hammeshichot vehartzuot shettefaran lesefer af al pi sheeno rashshay lekayyeman kol zeman shehen mechubbarin lassefer metammein et hayyadayim: 
Tik shel sefer umitpachot sefarim bizman shehen tefurot metammein et hayyadayim. aval habberachot af al pi sheyyesh bahen meotiyyot shel shem umeinyanim harebe shel tora enan metammein et hayyadayim: 
Sifre hamminim enan metammein et hayyadayim. parashat sota hoil velimchika omedet enah metammea et hayyadayim:

Kol hammittamme beav meavot hattumot ben adam ben kelim hare hu rishon letuma kemo shebbearnu ad sheyyitbol. taval hare hu kesheni letuma ad sheyyaariv shimsho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "bammayim yuva vetame ad haerev vetaher" hakkatuv kara litvul yom tame:

Echad tevul yom mittuma chamura kegon shettaval mizzivut mittumat met vetzaraat veechad tevul yom mittumat sheretz vechayyotze bo kol hattaun haarev shemesh ben adam ben kelim ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim hare hu kesheni letuma ad sheyyaariv shimsho:

Tevul yom posel ochole teruma umashke teruma veochole hekdesh umashke hekdesh posel hakkol. ketzad. tevul yom shennaga boochalin shel teruma asaan shelishi letuma mippene shehu sheni vechen im naga bemashkin shel teruma temein vahare hen shelishi letuma. naga tevul yom bemashkin shel kodesh timmean vahare hen revii letuma vechen im naga beachle hekdesh asaan revii. aval im naga boochalin chullin umashke chullin hare hen tehorin. vedin mechussar kippurim utevul yom bingiat hakkodesh echad hu. hare nitbaer lecha mikkol ellu haddevarim sheen shem mashkin sheniyyot leolam ella hammashkin techilla leolam chutz mimmashkin shennaga bahen tevul yom shehen shelishi im hayu teruma o revii im hayu kodesh:

Kol hametammein ben chamurin ben kallin mashkin hayyotzin mehen kegon rukkan umeme raglehen hare hen kemashkin shennagu bahen ellu veellu rishon letuma kemo shebbearnu chutz mizzav vachaverav shemmashkin hayyotzin mehen av tuma umashkin shehazzav vachaverav nogin bahen techilla. afillu ochel ochalin temein o shote mashkin temein hammashkin hayyotzin mimmennu kodem sheyyitbol kemo hammashkin shennaga bahen shehen techilla. vechen tevul yom mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu kemashkin shehu nogea bahen sheen metammein acherim kelal ella im naga bemashke chullin hare hen tehorin veim naga bemashke teruma hare hen shelishi veim naga bemashke kodesh hare hen revii:

Veatta yitbaer lecha sheen shelishi shebbitruma velo revii shebbekodesh metamme mashke acher o ochel acher. veen tzarich lomar sheen metammein kelim. lefichach kedera shemmelea mashkin venaga bah tevul yom im haya mashke chullin hakkol tahor. veim haya mashke teruma hammashkin pesulin vehakkedera tehora. veim hayu yadav temeot hammashke tame ben mashke teruma ben mashke chullin. veze chomer beyadayim mibbitvul yom. vechomer bitvul yom mibbeyadayim temeot shessafek tevul yom posel missafek vesafek hayyadayim tahor kemo sheyyitbaer:

Echad tahor shehayu yadav temeot o tevul yom sheyyadav temeot hare ze metamme mashke chullin veose otan techilla letamme ochalin umashkin kemo shebbearnu. umeachar shemmashke sheyyatza mittevul yom kemashkin shennaga bahen. tevul yom shennafal merukko o meme raglav al kikkar shel teruma hare ze tahor mippene shehen kemashkin shennaga bahen:

Mikkol ellu haddevarim shehikdamnu levaaram atta lamed shehaadam yihye av letuma veyihye rishon letuma middivre tora. uleolam lo yihye haadam sheni ella middivre sofrim vehu haochel ochalin temeim o hashshote mashkin temein o habba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin shekkol ellu kesheni letuma middivrehem. vechen shear kol hakkelim chutz mikkele cheres yihyu av tuma veyihyu rishon letuma middivre tora. velo yihye hakkeli leolam sheni letuma ella middivre sofrim sheim yitma bemashkin temeim yihye sheni middivrehen kemo shebbearnu:

Kevar bearnu shekkeli cheres lo yihye av tuma leolam lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim. veyihye rishon letuma middivre tora vesheni middivrehen im nitma bemashkin kishar hakkelim. velo yihye haadam velo hakkelim shelishi velo revii leolam lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Hoochalim lo yihyu av tuma leolam lo middivre tora velo middivrehem. veyihyu rishon vesheni middivre tora shehaadam o hakkeli shehu rishon letuma im naga beochel asauhu sheni vehoochalin yihyu shelishi urevii letuma middivrehen bilvad:

Hammashkin yihyu av tuma middivre tora. kegon me chattat verok hazzav umeme raglav. veyihyu rishon letuma middivre tora kegon shennagu beav meavot hattumot. vechen im nagu hammashkin bivlad hattuma ben adam ben kelim nitmeu middivre tora vahare hen karishon letuma letamme acherim middivrehen. vechen im nagu besheni ben adam ben kelim ben boochalin naasu rishon letamme acherim middivrehem kemo shebbearnu. veyihyu hammashkin shelishi urevii middivrehem. ketzad. im naga tevul yom bemashke teruma asaahu shelishi veim naga bemashke kodesh asaahu revii. veen atta motze mashkin sheniyyot leolam velo mashke sheeno techilla chutz mimmashke tevul yom o mechussar kippurim bekodesh kemo shebbearnu shehu posel middivrehem veeno metamme:
Kol makom shenneemar boochalin pasul hu sheyyihye haochel atzmo tame velo yetamme ochel acher. ella im naga beochel acher hare hu tahor:

Harishon shebbechullin tame umetamme. hashsheni pasul velo metamme veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin. uminnayin leochel sheni shehu pasul bechullin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "ucheli cheres asher yippol mehen el tocho kol asher betocho yitma". nimtza hashsheretz av ucheli cheres shennafal hashsheretz laaviro rishon vehaochel shebbakkeli sheni vahare hu omer yitma. vechen sheretz shennafal laavir hattannur happat sheniyya shehattannur rishon:

Harishon vehashsheni shebbatteruma temeim umetammeim. hashshelishi pasul velo metamme veen shelishi ose revii bitruma. minnayin leochel shelishi shehu pasul bitruma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakodashim" nimtza tevul yom asur bitruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho veim naga bah pesalah utevul yom kesheni letuma hu. ha lamadta shehashsheni ose shelishi bitruma:

Harishon vehashsheni vehashshelishi bakkodesh temein umetammein. harvii pasul veeno metamme veen revii ose chamishi leolam. uminnayin lashshelishi bakkodesh shehu tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 19)</small> "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel" uchevar kara hakkatuv lashsheni tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "kl asher betocho yitma" ha lamadta shebbesar hakkodesh shennaga besheni nitma veyissaref. uminnayin larvii bakkodesh shehu pasul mikkal vachomer. uma mechussar kippurim shehu muttar bitruma asur bekodesh ad sheyyavi kapparato. hashshelishi shehu pasul bitruma eno din sheyyaase revii bekodesh. aval hachamishi tahor:

Besar taava af al pi shehu tahor gazru alav sheyyihye kishlishi letuma metamme et hakkodesh veeno posel et hatteruma. veyerae li shello gazru alav ella kede shello yearvuhu im besar hakkodesh veyavou litot velishgog bo vidammu shehabbasar ze hu chol vehu kodesh veyochlennu betuma:

Chibbure ochalin al yede mashkin hare hen chibbur letamme tumat ochalin vehaddavar safek im chashuvim keguf echad limnot bahen rishon vesheni ushelishi. o choshvim ze haochel shennaga bo hattuma rishon vehaochel hamechubbar lo sheni:
Hashsheni shebbechullin posel ochole teruma veose otan shelishi. veim naga bemashke chullin timmean veen tzarich lomar im naga bemashke teruma o bemashke kodesh shehu metamme et hakkol:

Hashshelishi shebbatteruma shennaga beochole kodesh pesalan venaasu revii. veim naga bemashke hakkodesh timmean venaasu techilla. aval im naga shelishi shebbitruma bemashke teruma hare hu tahor. vechen revii shebbakkodesh im naga bemashke kodesh hare ze tahor:

Chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma hashshelishi shebbahen pasul kitruma. veim naga bakkodesh eno osehu revii vaafillu mashke kodesh eno posel. vechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh hashshelishi shebbahen tahor kechullin:

Haochel revii shebbakkodesh asur lo leechol et hakkodesh umuttar ligga bakkodesh veeno poslo. afillu tavshil shennitarev bo hakkodesh veen bo kezayit bichde achilat peras hare ze lo yeachel birvii shel kodesh ella bachamishi shehu tahor kemo shebbearnu:

Haochel shelishi shebbatteruma atzmah o shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma hare ze asur leechol et hatteruma ad sheyyitbol. umuttar ligga bitruma vahare hi tehora. baachila asu maala bingia lo asu maala. bamme devarim amurim bitruma atzmah. aval tavshil shennitarva bo teruma im en sham kezayit bichde achilat peras hare ze muttar leechol meoto tavshil kederech shemmuttar ligga bitruma:

Haochel shelishi shebbitruma o shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat hatteruma af al pi shehu tahor lingiat teruma hare hu kesheni leinyan kodesh shettohorat teruma tuma hi etzel hakkodesh. aval haochel shelishi shebbechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh hare hu tahor sheen lecha davar sheose revii bakkodesh ella kodesh mikkodesh bilvad:

Kol kodesh haamur beinyan tumat ochalin umashkin hu kadshe mikdash hamekuddashin kegon besar kadshe kadashim. uvesar kadashim kallim. vechallot toda urekike nazir shennishchat alehen hazzevach. vehammenachot shekkadshu bichli. ushete hallechem velechem happanim mishshekkarmu battannur. aval challot toda urekike nazir shello nishchat alehen hazzevach. vehammenachot shello kadshu bichli. enan lo kekodesh velo kechullin ella kitruma:
Hachalla vehabbikkurim vetashlume teruma [vechumshah] hare hen kitruma:
Hattevel. vehamedumma. vegiddule teruma. umaaser sheni verishon. veissa hattevula lechalla. hare hen kechullin veharishon tame bahen vehashsheni pasul veen bahen shelishi:

Kol davar shevvaddao metamme et hachullin min hattora gazru al sefeko bechullin hattevulin lechalla shettease otah haissa betohora. umafrishim mimmenna challa vechallatah teluya lo neechelet velo nisrefet:

Achat esre maalot asu chachamim lakkodesh al hatteruma veellu hen. yesh leadam lehatebil kelim betoch kelim litruma aval lo lekodesh. gezera shemma yihye pi hakkeli tzar velo yihye bo kishfoferet hannod venimtzeu hakkelim shebbetocho keillu tavlu bemayim shebbakkeli lo bammikve. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hakkeli haggadol sheyyesh betocho hakkelim hattemein tahor. aval im haya tame mittoch shealta lo tevila alta tevila lakkelim shebbetocho afillu lehishtammesh bahen bakkodesh: 
Keli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin lo nitma tocho velo bet etzba shebboovi sefato. vehammashkin shebbetocho o shebbevet tzeviato tehorin. veshote bo veeno choshesh shemma yiggeu mashkin shebbefiv baachore hakkeli veyachzeru vitammeu tocho. bamme devarim amurim litruma. aval lekodesh nitmeu achorav nitma kullo: 
Hannose et hammidras muttar lo lissa immo teruma keechad vehoil veen hannose nogea batteruma velo teruma nogaat bemidras hare hi tehora aval lo hakkodesh af al pi shello naga bo. maase haya beechad shennasa chavit shel kodesh temea bemidras shennasa immah beotah shaa gazru shehannose et hammidras lo yissa et hakkodesh. velo gazru ella bemidras im hakkodesh kemaase shehaya. veim avar venasa hoil velo naga bekodesh hare hakkodesh tahor: 
Bigde ochle teruma af al pi shehen tehorin venizharin min hattumot hare bigdehen midras lekodesh: 
Keli shehu mefutztzal veluchotav vekorotav mekushsharot kegon mitta vechayyotze bah. im nitma vetzarich lehatebilo litruma yesh lo lehatebilo kullo keechad keshehu mekushshar. aval lekodesh mattir umenaggev shemma yesh sham davar hachotzetz umatbil veachar kach kosher: 
Kelim hannigmarin betohora afillu haya haose otan talmid chacham venizhar bahen hare ellu tzerichin tevila lekodesh veenan tzerichin haarev shemesh. aval litruma mishtammesh bahen belo tevila shehare naasu betohora. umippene ma hitzrichum tevila lekodesh gezera mishshum rok am haaretz sheyyigga bahen bishat melacha vaadayin hu lach: 
Achar shennigmar hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lekodesh aval lo litruma. ketzad. keli shehu male perot perudin ze mizze kegon tzimmukin ugerogarot venaga tuma beechad mehen. nitma kol ma shebbakkeli lekodesh aval lo litruma. vechol hammaalot shel divrehem hem. veremez yesh lemaala zo battora <small>(Bamidbar 7 14)</small> "kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret" amru chachamim kol ma shebbakkaf hare hu keguf echad. afillu sheen lo toch metzaref ma shealav lekodesh. kegon shehayu tzevurin al gabbe halluach o al gabbe haor af al pi sheen happerot nogin ze baze: 
Hayu shene hatztzibburin betoch hakkeli vedavar achar benehen venitma echad mishshenehen. im haya haddavar shebbenehen tzarich lakkeli hakkeli metzarfan venitma hakkol. veim eno tzarich lakkeli lo nitma ella ze shennaga bo hattuma bilvad: 
Hayu shene tzibburin bichli vehatztzibbur haechad mechubbar lammayim sheachore hakkeli venaga tame batztzibbur hashsheni nitmeu shenehen betzeruf hakkeli venitmeu hammayim sheachore hakkeli mechamat ze haochel hamechubbar lahen af al pi shehen achore hakkeli. naga hattame bemayim sheachore hakkeli nitma haochel hamechubbar lahen. vehaddavar safek im nitma haochel hashsheni betzeruf hakkeli o lo nitma mechamat hatztzeruf: 
Ochel kodesh shennitma vehinnicho bichli uvetoch hakkeli ochel kodesh acher tahor veen nogin ze baze. hattahor betohorato vehattame betumato. ba tevul yom venaga baochel hattame yesh bedavar ze safek im nifsal hattahor mechamat magga tevul yom mippene tzeruf hakkeli o lo nifsal. shello naga tevul yom ella baochel shessava min hattuma velo hosif lo kelum: 
Harvii bekodesh pasul aval bitruma tahor. vechen shelishi bitruma im naga bemashke kodesh hare ze nitma kemo shebbearnu. vehashshelishi shebbitruma o shebbekodesh im naga bemashke teruma lo pesalo: 
Mi shennitmet yado achat venaga bah beyado sheniyya o beyad chavero pasal et hashsheniyya vahare hi kishlishi. veim hayta yado belula bammashke af al pi shello naga nitmet chavertah vetzarich lehatebil et shetehen veachar kach yigga bekodesh. aval bitruma im nitmet yado haachat lo nitmet chavertah. vaafillu naga bah keshehi neguva. veen tzarich lehatebil yado shennitmet ella notlah venogea bitruma: 
Ochalin neguvin shello huchsheru ochlin otam beyadayim mesoavot. bamme devarim amurim bitruma. aval bekodesh chibbat hakkodesh machshartan veasur lemi sheyyadav temeot leechol kodesh shello huchshar. vaafillu lo naga bo ella bechush o shettachav lo chavero letoch piv hare ze asur. veen tzarich lomar sheim naga tuma boochalin shel kodesh shello huchsheru shennitmeu mippene shechibbat hakkodesh machshartan: 
Bamme devarim amurim lifsol haochel atzmo uleasro baachila. aval limnot bo rishon vesheni hare ze safek. ketzad. naga ochel shennitma belo hechsher beochel sheni shehuchshar hare ze hashsheni safek mippene sheharishon lo huchshar: 
Haonen achar shettam zeman aninuto umechussar kippurim achar shehevi kapparato tzerichin tevila laachilat hakkodesh aval lo litruma shehaonen umechussar kippurim muttarin leechol et hatteruma. umippene ma hitzrichum tevila lakkodesh shehare ad atta hayu asurin leechol et hakkodesh vehissichu datan veshemma nitmeu vehem lo yadu. velo asu maala zo ella laachila aval lingia nogim bekadashim kodem tevila: 
Shesh maalot harishonot asaum ben lekodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh. vachamesh acharonot shehen min hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho vahala asaum bekodesh bilvad aval lo bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh. ella hare hen bechamesh ellu kechullin lefichach chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh harishon tame bahen vehashsheni pasul. vehashshelishi tahor bechullin kemo shebbearnu:

Chamesh maalot asu chachamim bivgadim veellu hen. bigde am haaretz midras leochle chullehen betohora vechen amme haaretz atzman kezavin letohorot kemo shebbearnu. uvigde ochle chullehen betohora midras leochle maaser sheni aval ochle chullehen betohora vehen hannikraim perushim enam kezavim afillu litruma hare ze happarush tahor afillu im naga bah begufo. uvigde ochle maaser sheni midras leochle teruma. uvigde ochle teruma midras lekodesh aval ochle teruma atzman enan kezavin bekodesh. uvigde ochle kodesh midras lechattat kemo shebbearnu behilchot para adumma aval hattahor lekodesh eno kezav lechattat: 
Vechen asu chachamim maalot bitvila. ketzad. mi shettaval belo kavvana hare ze tahor lechullin veasur bemaaser sheni ad sheyyitkavven litbol lemaaser. taval lemaaser hare ze bechezkat tohora lemaaser veasur bitruma. taval litruma huchzak litruma veasur bekodesh. taval lekodesh huchzak lekodesh veasur lechattat. taval lechattat huchzak lakkol shehattovel lechamur huchzak lekal. taval setam velo nitkavven leechad mikkol ellu hare ze tahor lechullin bilvad vetame keshehaya afillu lemaaser. vechen hannotel yadav o hitbilan tzarich kavvana afillu lemaaser. umin hammaaser vamala tzarich kavvana aval lechullin eno tzarich kavvana. vechol hammaalot haellu middivre sofrim aval din tora hoil vetaval mikkol makom hare hu tahor lakkol: 
Mi shehaya tahor litruma vehissiach et libbo milleechol nitma behesseach haddaat veasur leechol teruma ad sheyyitbol paam sheniyya veeno tzarich haarev shemesh. hayu yadav tehorot litruma vehissiach libbo milleechol af al pi sheomer yodea ani shello nitmeu yaday hare yadav temeot behesseach haddaat shehayyadayim askaniyyot. im litruma ken kal vachomer lekodesh shekkol hammassiach dato tzarich tevila. veim lo shamar atzmo mittumat met velo yada bevadday shello nitma hare ze tzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii mippene hesseach haddaat. veim yada shello nitma bemet vehissiach dato mishshear tumot hare ze tzarich tevila vehaarev shemesh af litruma. vedavar barur hu shekkol ellu hattevilot middivrehen: 
Vechen gazru chachamim al hakkelim hannimtzaim bashshevakim uvarchovot afillu bammidbarot sheyyihyu bechezkat tuma. shemma bezav o bemet nitmeu. vechen harukkin hannimtzain sham bechezkat tuma shemma rok zav vechayyotze bo hu harok hazze: 
Kol hakkelim hannimtzain birushalayim tehorin afillu nimtzeu derech yerida levet hattevila. shello gazru tuma al hakkelim hannimtzaim birushalayim chutz min hassakkinim lishchitat hakkadashim mippene chumrat hakkadashim. bamme devarim amurim besakkin hannimtzet birushalayim bishar yemot hashshana. aval im matza sakkin birushalayim bearbaa asar benisan shochet bah hakkadashim miyyad vaafillu chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat shello gazru al hassakkinin hannimtzaim bayyom hazze. vechen im metzaah beyom tov shochet bah miyyad shechezkat kol hakkelim beyom tov tehorin: 
Matza hassakkin bishlosha asar mazze aleha umatbilah veshochet bah lemachar mippene sheasauhu beyom ze keillu yom shelosha asar shevii shellah: 
Matza sakkin keshura lassakkin hayedua etzlo ben beyom tov ben bishar hayyamim hare hi kamoha im tehora tehora veim temea temea: 
Kol harukkin hannimtzaim birushalayim beemtza hadderech gazru alehen tuma kishar harukkin hannimtzaim bechol makom. vechol harukkin hannimtzaim batztzedadin birushalayim tehorim. shehapperushim hen shemmehallechin batztzedadin kede shello yittammeu bemagga amme haaretz. uvishat haregel shebbeemtza hadderech tehorim shekkol yisrael tehorim baregel. veshebbatztzedadin temeim shehattemeim baregel meattim vehen porshim letzidde hadderachim: 
Keshem sheharishon ose sheni vehashsheni ose shelishi ken sefek rishon ose sefek sheni usefek sheni ose sefek shelishi: 
Teruma vekadashim shennitmeu bisfek av meavot hattumot shel tora hare ellu nisrafin betuma zo kegon shennistappek lo im naga beav ze o lo naga: 
Veyesh sham sefekot sheen sorfin alehen veen ochlin otan ochalin shennistappek lo bahen ella tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin. veyesh sham sefekot shessorfin alehen et hatteruma veen tzarich lomar kadashim: 
Aval al sefek sefek hattuma en sorfin alav teruma leolam veen tzarich lomar kadashim. ella tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin: 
Al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma vechullam gezera middivrehem veellu hen. al bet happeras. veal afar habba meeretz haammim. veal bigde am haaretz. veal hakkelim hannimtzaim. veal harukkim hannimtzaim. veal me ragle adam tame shennitarev beme ragle behema mechetza lemechetza veen yadua im batlu maritan im lo. ketzad. im nitmet teruma mechamat echad mishshishsha ellu af al pi sheikkar tumatan besafek hare zo tissaref. hoil uvadday sefekot ellu tumatan min hattora shehammet vehazzav temein min hattora. veachat teruma shennaga beachat mishshesh tumot haellu. o shennitmet mechamat achat mehen vahare hi shelishi leachat mehen hare zo tissaref. aval im nistappek lo bechol makom im naga bevet happeras uveeretz haammim o lo naga. im naga bivgadim verukkin vechelim ume regalim o lo naga. hare ellu tolin mippene sheikkar tumatan mippene hassafek shemma temein hen o tehorim veim tomar temein shemma naga shemma lo naga venimtzeu shene sefekot veen sorfin al shene sefekot ella tolin kemo shebbearnu:

Shennem asar sefekot toharu chachamim veellu hen. sefek mayim sheuvim lemikve. sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim. sefek mashkin letamme acherim. aval letumat atzman temeim missafek. sefek hayyadayim ben letumat atzman ben letamme acherim ben letohorat yadayim mittumatan. sefek divre sofrim. sefek hachullin. sefek karbanot. sefek negaim. safek over veomed. sefek sheratzim. sefek reshut harabbim. sefek shete reshuyot: 
Sefek mayim sheuvin lemikve ketzad. shelosha login mayim sheuvin shennaflu lammikve pesaluhu. safek naflu safek lo naflu vaafillu naflu safek yesh bahen shiur o en bahen sefeko tahor vahare hammikve bechashruto. veen morin lo litbol bemikve ze velaasot tohorot lechattechilla. veim taval veasa tohorotav tehorot: 
Sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim ketzad. sheretz shehaya tzaf al pene hammayim. ben shehayu hammayim bechelim o bekarkaot veyarad lammayim afillu en sham ella melo adam vetuma hare ze tahor ad sheyyeda vadday shennaga. velo amru sefek tuma tzafa tahor ella lesheretz bilvad. vechol hannitlim vehannigrarin hare hen kemunnachin: 
Sheretz shehaya munnach bichli ucheli tzaf al pene hammayim o shehaya munnach al hammet o al hannevela vaafillu nimmoach hannevela o basar met shettachtav o shehaya munnach al shichvat zera hatztzafa al pene hammayim hare ze kemunnach al haaretz shessefeko birshut hayyachid tame kemo sheyyitbaer. haya sheretz al gabbe sheretz tzaf al pene hammayim hare ze ketuma ava shetztzafa al pene hammayim usefeko tahor. haya munnach al gabbe me chattat ume chattat tzafin al pene hammayim hare ze safek im hu kemunnach o eno kemunnach. lefichach yerae li shessefeko tahor: 
Kederech shettiharu sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim ben bechelim ben bekarkaot kach tiharu sefek tohora hatztzafa al pene hammayim ben bechelim ben bekarkaot. ketzad. areva shehi teme met vechikkar teruma karuch besiv o binyar venatun betochah veyardu letochah me geshamim venitmallet venifshat hanneyar vahare hakkikkar tzaf al pene hammayim vehanneyar mavdil beno leven hammayim vesafek naga tziddo baareva safek lo naga. hare hu betohorato mippene shehu tzaf: 
Sheretz shennimtza tzaf al gabbe bor betoch haggat litruma sefeko tame. velappoalin sefekan tahor. mippene shehi tuma tzafa: 
Safek mashkin letamme acherim tahor. letumat atzman tame. ketzad. haya makkel beyado uverosho mashkin temeim uzerakan letoch kikkarot tehorot. safek nagu hammashkin bakkikkarot safek lo nagu tehorot. vechen im nistappek lo im nagu mashkin temein bichli ze o lo nagu hare hakkeli tahor. vechen im nistappek lo im nagu mashkin ellu hattemein bemashkin acherim o lo nagu hare hammashkin haacherim tehorin. aval tame sheppashat yado o raglo leven mashkin tehorin. o shezzarak kikkar tame leven mashkin tehorin safek naga bammashkin safek lo naga hare ellu temein besafek. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Chavit shehi melea mashkin ufashat hattame et yado laavirah safek naga bammashkin safek lo naga bahen hammashkin temein vehechavit tehora sheen sefek hammashkin metamme. vechen im nichnesu mashkin shehen temein missafek laavir hechavit hare hechavit tehora vehammashkin shebbetochah tehorin sheenan mittammein ella min hechavit. veim nitarvu mashkin ellu hassafek bemashkin shebbechavit hare kol hammashkin temein besafek vehechavit tehora. vechen im naflu mashkin ellu letoch hattannur hare happat vehattannur tehorin: 
Hamerabbetz beto bemayim temeim o shezzillefan vehayu sham tohorot safek nittezu alehen safek lo nittezu sefeko tahor: 
Zillef mashkin tehorin utemeim betoch habbayit venimtzeu achar kach mashkin al kikkar shel teruma. netalah venishal aleha hare zo tehora shessefek hammashkin letamme tahor. hinniach hakkikkar ad sheyyinnagvu hammayim shealeha hare zo temea besafek shessefek tuma birshut hayyachid tame kemo sheyyitbaer. vahare en kan mashkin ella kikkar shehi safek temea safek tehora: 
Sefek yadayim ben lehittamme ben letamme acherim ben letohoratan tahor ketzad. hayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene kikkarim temein safek naga safek lo naga. o shehayu yadav temeot ulefanav shene kikkarim tehorim safek naga safek lo naga. o shehayu yadav achat tehora veachat temea ulefanav shene kikkarim tehorim venaga beechad mehen vesafek battemea naga safek battehora. o shehayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene kikkarim echad tahor veechad tame venaga beechad mehem safek battame naga safek battahor naga. o shehayu yadav achat tehora veachat temea ulefanav kikkar tame vechikkar tahor venaga bishnehen safek temea battame vehattehora battahor o temea battahor vehattehora battame. hayyadayim kemo shehayu vehakkikkarim kemot shehayu. vechen im hayu yadav temeot vehitbilan o netalan safek shehammayim shettiharu bahen kesherim leyadayim safek shehen pesulin. safek yesh bahen keshiur safek en bahen. safek shehaya davar chotzetz al yado safek shello haya. hare yadav tehorot: 
Hayta yado achat temea veeno yodea e zo hi omrin lo shello yaase tohorot ad sheyyittol shete yadav. veim naga beachat mehen betohorot kodem sheyyittol yadav tohorotav tehorot:

Sefek divre sofrim ketzad. safek achal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein safek shello achal veshello shata. safek shebba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin o shennaflu alav shelosha login mayim sheuvin safek shello ba veshello naflu hare ze tahor. vechen im achal ochalin temein o shata mashkin temein o ba bemayim sheuvin o naflu alav shelosha login mayim sheuvin vesafek naga betohorot ellu safek lo naga hare tohorot ellu tehorot. vechen haochel sefek ochalin temeim vehashshote mashkin shehen temeim besafek hare ze tahor. vechen haochel teruma teluya tahor. vechen kol kayyotze beellu mivvalde tumot shehen middivre sofrim sefekan tahor. aval av [hattuma] shehu middivre sofrim sefeko tame ella im ken haya haav atzmo tame besafek kegon bet happeras veeretz haammim sheen sorfin al sefek maggaan kemo shebbearnu: 
Sefek hachullin hi tohorat ochle chullehen betohora vehen hannikraim perushim. ketzad. ochle chullehen betohora shennolad lahen sefek tuma betohorotehen hare ellu tehorim kechol hassefekot kullan. veen lahen tuma ella tuma vaddait: 
Sefek hakkarbanot ketzad. mechussar kippurim sheyyesh alav sefek chamishsha karbanot. kegon haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh zivot o sefek chamesh ledot. meviin karban echad vetahor leechol bekadashim veen hashshear alav chova kemo shebbearnu behilchot mechussere kappara: 
Sefek negaim ketzad. ad shello nizkak letuma sefeko tahor kemo shebbearnu beferek shishshi mehilchot negaim: 
Safek omed veover ketzad. metzora sheyyoshev tachat hailan vehattahor over safek heehil alav hailan vetame safek lo heehil alav vechen im haya hattahor yoshev tachat hailan vehametzora over tachtav safek amad hametzora venitma hattahor safek lo amad sefeko tahor: 
Sefek sheratzim ze sefek hannizrakin. ketzad. zarak sheretz o davar tame leven hakkikkarot o shezzarak kikkar leven hattemeot vesafek naga safek lo naga hare ze tahor hoil umatza hakkikkar hattahor sheeno nogea battuma shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan. veen omrin shemma naga bo veachar kach nafal betziddo ella hare hen kishat metziatan: 
Hashsheretz befi hachulda umehallechet al gabbe kikkarot shel teruma safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor mippene shello nacha hattuma. hayta mehallechet bo venogaat bechikkarot safek chay safek met hare hen tehorot. bamme devarim amurim bizman shennetalattu vehalcha lah. aval im nimtza met befiha hare ellu temeot. rauhu chay befiha af al pi shemmetzauhu met befiha hare ellu tehorot. vechen hashsheretz befi hachulda vehannevela befi hakkelev veavru ben hattehorim o sheavru tehorim benehen sefeko tahor. mippene sheen lattuma makom kavua. hayu menakkerin bahen al haaretz hare hen kemunnachin umetammein lemafrea missafek im hayu birshut hayyachid kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Safek reshut harabbim ketzad. tuma shemmunnachat birshut harabbim safek naga bah safek lo naga sefeko tahor. hayta birshut hayyachid vesafek naga bah safek lo naga sefeko tame. vechol ellu hassefekot shettiharu chachamim afillu birshut hayyachid mippene sheen bahen daat lehishshael kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Safek shete reshuyot ketzad. haya davar tame birshut hayyachid vedavar tahor birshut harabbim o shehaya haddavar lehefech venaga beechad mehem veen yadua bee ze mehen naga. o shehesit et echad mehen veen yadua e ze hesit. im haya haddavar hattame metamme bemassa o shehaya echad mehen metamme beohel veheehil al echad mehen veen yadua e ze mehen heehil hare ze tahor af al pi shessafek reshut harabbim tahor. kesheyyavo lishshael omrin lo im tavalta en bechach hefsed. im taval hare ze meshubbach. veim lo taval veasa tohorot hare hen tehorot shessefek reshut harabbim tahor: 
Sheretz shennimtza saruf umunnach al gabbe ochalin vechen tallit shennimtzet beluya umachat shennimtzet shevura o chaluda ben hakkelim hare ellu tehorin ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid. veen omrin shemma achar shennaga boochalin nisraf veachar shennitmeu hakkelim bemagga hattallit vehammachat nishbera o hechlida uvalta hattallit ad shettahara shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan: 
Shene edim omrin lo nitma vehu omer tahor ani hu neeman al yede atzmo. veaf al pi chen en omrin lo asok betohorot ella im asa tohorot hare hen tehorot veyachush leatzmo. ed omer nitma ushenayim omrim lo nitma ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid tahor. shenayim omrim nitma veed echad omer lo nitma ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim hare ze nitma. ed omer nitma veed omer lo nitma ishsha omeret nitma veishsha omeret lo nitma birshut hayyachid tame birshut harabbim tahor:

Mippenne ma tiharu chachamim sefek tuma birshut harabbim. shehare hatztzibbur osin pesach betuma bizman shehattemeim merubbin. im tuma vaddait nidchet mippenehen kal vachomer lisfek tuma sheissur kol hassefekot middivrehen kemo shebbearnu behilchot biot asurot. umippene ma hechmiru bisfek reshut hayyachid. shehare sota shennistera af al pi shehaddavar safek hare hi temea levalah ad shettishte: 
Ucheshem shehassota uvoalah shenayim kach sefek tuma bishnayim. aval im hayu shelosha birshut hayyachid hare sefek tumatan sham tahor kirshut harabbim. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ze shennitma besafek yesh bo daat lehishshael velidrosh mimmennu ma era lo kesota. aval im haya cheresh o shote o katan sheeno yodea lehashiv al hainyan kesheshshoalin oto hare sefeko tahor. ketzad. cheresh o shote o katan sheen bo daat lehishshael shennimtzeu bechatzer o bemavoy sheyyesh sham tuma vesafek nagu vesafek lo nagu hare ellu tehorin. vechen kol sheen bo daat lehishshael af al pi shennolad lo hassafek birshut hayyachid sefeko tahor: 
Hassuma vehayyashen vehamehallech ballayla sefekan birshut hayyachid tame mippene sheyyesh bo daat lehishshael. bamme devarim amurim shekkol sheen bo daat lishshael sefeko tahor beshehaya haddavar shakul veen sham chazaka. aval im haya haddavar yadua shechezkato shennitma hare ze tame. ketzad. tinok tame shennimtza betzad haissa vehabbatzek beyado hare haissa temea shedderech hattinok letappeach uvechach hi chezkato. veen sorfin al chazaka zo: 
Hayu mashkin temein uvatzek tahor uvehema o chayya o ofot babbayit venimtza babbatzek mekom neshichatan. chazaka sheshshatu mashkin venashchu babbatzek vetimmeuhu. hayta sham para uven hammashkin vehabbatzek kede shettelachech et leshonah hare habbatzek tahor. uvishar kol habbehema kede shettenaggev et piha. pachot mizze habbatzek tame. veim haya kelev afillu hayu mashkin betzad habbatzek hare ze tahor. sheen darko shel kelev lehanniach hammazon velelech lo el hammayim. nimtza babbatzek nekirat hattarnegolin im yesh ben hammashkin vehabbatzek kede sheyyenaggevu et pihen baaretz habbatzek tahor. veim lav tame shechezkatan sheshshatu venikkeru babbatzek bammashkin shebbefihem. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu hammashkin tzelulin shebbavua shel tinok nikkeret bahen. aval achurim habbatzek tahor. sheillu nikkeru bammashkin haya mekom hammashkin nikkar babbatzek. im hayu tzelulin af al pi shehabbatzek bechezkat tuma en sorfin al chazaka zo ella tolin: 
Ezo hi chazaka shessorfin aleha birshut hayyachid. issa babbayit usheratzim utzefardeim metappelin sham venimtzeu chatichot mibbesaran baissa im rov hametappelim sheratzim haissa temea vetissaref. veim harov tzefardeim tehora: 
Hayu tumot vetohorot betziddo o lemala mimmennu venitattef betallito vesafek nagu safek lo nagu beet shennitattef im hayu birshut hayyachid sefeko tame. shessefek tuma habbaa bide adam nishalin aleha afillu bichli hammunnach al gabbe karka hare hu kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishshael. veim hayu birshut harabbim sefeko tahor veim i efshar shello yigga sefeko tame: 
Kikkar shel teruma shennatun al gabbe haddaf umidras natun tachtav vei efshar lo kesheyyippol shello yigga bammidras. af al pi shehu bimkom midron uva umatza hakkikkar bemakom acher hare hu betohorato sheani omer adam ba unetalo unetano bemakom ze. veim amar bari li shello ba adam lechan tame shevvadday nafal venaga bammidras keshennafal: 
Tinok shennimtza betzad bet hakkevarot vehashshoshannim beyado af al pi sheen sham shoshannim ella bimkom hattuma sefeko tahor shemma acher likketan unetanam lo. vechen chamor haomed bevet hakkevarot kelav tehorin veen omrin shemma nitmaech bahen venagu bakkever mippene sheen bo daat lishshael ucheshennimtzeu lo nimtzeu nogin vechol hattumot kishat metziatan: 
Tinok shehaya tofes beyado shel aviv o shehaya rochev al gabbe ketefo shel aviv sefeko birshut hayyachid tame mippene sheaviv nishal alav: 
Vearbaa sefekot amru chachamim betinok. tinok sheeno yachol lehallech shehinnichattu immo uvaa umetzaattu kemo shehu bimkomo tahor veen omrin shemma tuma baa uneshakattu vegippafto. hitchil hattinok latzet ulehachnis begadav tehorin veenan midras kishar bigde am haaretz. veaf al pi shehen tehorin en osin al gabbehen tohorot. higdil ad sheyyihye bo daat lishshael sefeko tame birshut hayyachid. higdil ad sheyyihye bo daat lishmor et gufo ochlin al gufo tohorot. yodea lishmor et yadav ochlin al gabban tohorot. ketzad bodkin oto. matbilin oto venotnin lo chullin leshem teruma im yodea lishmor et gufo ochlin aggav gufo tohorot veim yodea lishmor et yadav ochlim aggav yado tohorot:

Kezayit min hammet befi haorev safek heehil al haadam veal hakkelim birshut hayyachid safek shello heehil hare haadam tame missafek vehu sheyyihye bo daat lishshael vehakkelim tehorim mippene sheen lahen daat lishshael. vechen hamemalle bichli venatan baasara kelim venimtza hashsheretz beechad mehen hu tame vehakkelim tehorin af al pi shekkullan safek shemma hashsheretz bakkeli shemmille bo haya techilla mippene shehen kelim veen bahen daat lishshael. veim haya lakkeli shemmille bo aznayim hoil veefshar sheyyetzu hammayim veyitacher bo hashsheretz kullan temeim. vechen hamemalle baasara delayim ze achar ze venatan baasara kelim middeli echad lichli acher veen yadua harishon min haacharon venimtza hashsheretz bichli echad mehen hare hattisha kelim im aseret haddelayim tehorin sheani omer shemma bichli ze haya hashsheretz mittechillato. veim yesh laddelayim aznayim hare kol haddelayim im kol hakkelim temein. hameare mikkeli lichli venimtza hashsheretz battachton haelyon tahor. veen omrin mehaelyon nafal ella shemma battachton haya mippene shehen kelim veen lahen daat lishshael. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kuppa shennishtammesh bah betohorot venimtza bah sheretz im yesh lah shulayim o aznayim af al pi sheen lah shulayim hare kol hattohorot shennishtammeshu bah temeot. afillu hayta beduka umechussa shemma im hagebahat yado min habbedika nafal hashsheretz. vaafillu nishtammesh bah betohorot bezavit zo vetiltelah lezavit acheret venimtza bah hashsheretz kullan temeot lefi shemmachazikin tuma mimmakom lemakom litlot aval lo lisrof: 
Hazzolef et habbor umemalle mimmennu chaviyyot im haya mashkia kol chavit vechavit babbor umemalle otan venimtza hashsheretz barishona kullan temeot. nimtza baacharona hi temea vechullan tehorot sheani omer achar shemmille et harishonot nafal sheretz labbor. haya zolef bichli venoten letoch hechaviyyot ad shemmillean venimtza hashsheretz beachat mehen hi bilvad temea vechullan tehorot sheani omer bezo bilvad nafal hashsheretz o haya bah ad shello zillef letochah. lefichach im haya bodek kol chavit mehen veachar kach noten bah hayyayin umechasse otah achar shezzolef letochah venimtza hashsheretz beachat mehen kullan temeot. vechen im nimtza hashsheretz babbor o bakkeli shezzolef bo hakkol tame: 
Haya kotze zetim min hammaatan umaale otan laggag venimtza hashsheretz baggag zetim shebbammaatan tehorim. nimtza bammaatan hammaatan tame. nimtza ben kotel lazzetim hazzetim tehorim. nimtza hashsheretz betoch gush shel zetim vehaggush baggag im betoch sheloshet yamim af hammaatan tame. sheani omer gush ze min hammaatan ala vehashsheretz betocho. veim nimtza achar shelosha yamim mishsheheela zetim laggag hare hammaatan tahor shemma baggag nitkabbetzu venaasu gush betoch hashshelosha yamim: 
Hakkoretz mikretzet min haissa venimtza sheretz bammikretzet hammikretzet levaddah temea. nimtza baissa haissa levaddah temea. nimtza betoch hammikretzet af haissa temea: 
Ochel tame shennimtza garina shello betoch hakkikkar o al gabbe tavshil roteach af al pi sheen aleha mashke tofeach hare hen temeim. sheani omer haochel kullo nafal sham venimmoach betoch hakkikkar o mechamat harticha venishara garinato. nimtzet haggarina al gabbe hakkikkar o betoch tavshil tzonen hare ellu tehorin af al pi sheyyesh aleha mashke sheani omer garina zo levaddah nafla achar sheavad haochel mealeha shehare enah metammea: 
Hayu babbayit ochalin temein voochalin tehorim venimtzet garina babbayit holchin achar harov. vechen im hayu damim tehorim vedamim temeim betoch habbayit venimtza dam al haochel holchim achar harov. maase haya bechikkar shel teruma shennimtza alav dam uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharuhu. sheafillu nomar dam sheretz hu hareni omer dam sheretz chay hu shehu tahor: 
Ir sheyyesh bah nevelot ushechutot. basar hannimtza bah holchim achar harov. vechen im haya hannimtza bah sefek sheretz sefek tzefardea holchin achar harov sheyyesh beotah hair beoto hazzeman. ze hakkelal benimtza hallech achar harov: 
Haishsha shemmegabbevet gevava bechatzer venimtza sheretz betoch gevava hare zo tehora sheen hashsheretz metamme bemassa. nimtza al gabbe gevava hare zo temea shemma naga bo. hayta koveret bichvara venimtza sheretz betoch happerot shebbakkevara hare zo tehora. nimtza al gabbe hakkevara hare zo safek temea shemma naga bo vechol safek birshut hayyachid tame kemo shebbearnu:

Kol sheatta yachol lerabbot sefekot usefeke sefekot birshut harabbim tahor, birshut hayyachid tame. ketzad. nichnas lemavoy vehattuma bechatzer safek nichnas lechatzer safek lo nichnas. tuma babbayit safek nichnas labbayit safek lo nichnas. vaafillu nichnas safek shello hayta sham safek hayta sham. veim tomar hayta sham beet shennichnas safek yesh bah keshiur safek en bah. veim tomar yesh bah safek shehi tuma safek enah tuma. vaafillu hi tuma safek naga safek lo naga. sefeko tame shehammavoy reshut hayyachid: 
Tisha tzefardeim vesheretz echad benehen birshut hayyachid venaga beechad mehen veeno yodea e zehu sefeko tame. tisha sheratzim utzefardea benehen birshut harabbim venaga beechad mehen sefeko tahor. ze hakkelal kol safek birshut harabbim tahor ad sheyyomar nitmeti bevadday. vechol safek birshut hayyachid tame ad sheyyomar vadday shello nitmeti. lefichach atzmot hammet veetzem nevela birshut harabbim. o gush meeretz tehora vegushim mibbet happeras o meeretz haammim venaga beechad mehen o hesito veen yadua bema naga mehen uvema hesit. kezayit min hammet uchezayit min hannevela veheehil al echad mehen veen yadua al e ze mehen heehil. shene shevilin echad tahor veechad tame halach beechad mehen veen yadua bee ze halach. o shennaga beadam ze bederech veen yadua im hu tame o tahor. o shehayu shene anashim echad tame veechad tahor venaga beechad mehen veen yadua bee ze mehen naga. bechol ellu hassefekot tahor: 
Hammotze met mushkav lerachbo shel derech im haya shalem vehu min hakkatze el hakkatze hare ze tame litruma shechezkato shennaga. haya lo makom laavor o shehaya meshubbar umeforak sheefshar sheavar ben shokav uferakav hare ze tahor. veim haya kever lechol rochav hadderech hakkever metzarfo vehaover sham tame. sheen ze kishar sefekot ella chezkato shennaga: 
Sheretz shennimtza bemavoy metamme lemafrea ad haet sheyyomar badakti et hammavoy hazze beyom peloni velo haya bo sheretz afillu kibbedo velo bedako hare ze metamme lemafrea mikkodem hakkibbud. bamme devarim amurim shemmetzao yavesh. aval im metzao lach eno metamme lemafrea ella ad shaa sheefshar sheyyamut bah veyihye atta lach beet shennimtza: 
Shene rukkin birshut hayyachid echad tahor veechad min harukkin hannimtzaim sheggazru alehen tuma kemo shebbearnu venaga beechad mehen o hesito veen yadua e zehu tolin alav et hatteruma. mippene shehen shene sefekot safek battahor naga safek bannimtza veim tomar bannimtza safek shehu tame safek shehu tahor. hayu shene harukkin birshut harabbim im hayu neguvin umunnachin sham venaga beechad mehen sefeko tahor. nasa echad mehen tolin alav shehare mishshennesao eno munnach birshut harabbim. vechen im haya echad mehen lach venitla bo harok hallach tolin alav shehare eno munnach birshut harabbim kede sheyyihye sefeko tahor ella hare hu al bigdo. kevar bearnu sheim naga barok hannimtza o nesao o hesito bechol makom sorfin alav et hatteruma kevet happeras vechayyotze bah shessorfin al vadday maggaan bechol makom: 
Mi sheyyashav birshut harabbim uva echad vedaras al begadav o sherakak venaga bo harok. al rukko sorfin et hatteruma. veal begadav holchin achar harov. im rov hair temein begadav midras. veim rov hair tehorim hare hu tahor: 
Mi sheavad lo keli umetzao birshut hayyachid hare ze tame midras vetame teme met. avad lo birshut harabbim umetzao birshut harabbim. im ibbedo bayyom umetzao bo bayyom tahor. avad bayyom umetzao ballayla ballayla umetzao bayyom o sheavad bayyom umetzao bayyom shel acharav hare ze bechezkat tame. ze hakkelal kol sheavar alav hallayla o miktzato tame: 
Hinniach keli o shechacho birshut harabbim af al pi sheavar alav hallayla tahor. hinnicho o shechacho birshut hayyachid hare ze teme midras vetahor mitteme met. umippene ma lo hechmiru beshocheach umanniach kimabbed mippene sheeno davar matzuy tamid lo gazru alav: 
Hameabbed umatza betoch habbayit hare ze tahor mippene shehu bechezkat shimmur: 
Hashshoteach kelim birshut harabbim hare ellu tehorin. uvirshut hayyachid temeim shemma nagu bahen temeim. veim haya meshammeran tehorim. naflu vehalach lahaviam temeim mippene shenneelmu meenav. vechen mi sheavdu kelav birshut hayyachid umetzaan afillu bo bayyom hare hen midras uteme met kemo shebbearnu: 
Shota achat bair o nachrit kol harukkin shebbair bechezkat tuma leolam bechol makom: 
Mi sheddarsa ishsha al begadav o sheyyashva immo bisfina. im makkirattu shehu ochel bitruma kelav tehorin veim lav yishalenna: 
Mi sheyyashan birshut harabbim veamad kelav tehorim: 
Naga birshut harabbim beechad ballayla veen yadua im chay im met uvashshachar amad umetzao met hare ze tame shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan. veim rauhu chay baerev uvashshachar matzu met hare ze safek birshut harabbim vetahor: 
Hamesukkan birshut hayyachid venitallef veen yadua im met o adayin hu chay vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim vechazru vehichnisuhu lirshut hayyachid. keshehu birshut hayyachid sefeko tame ucheshehu birshut harabbim sefeko tahor. maase beechad shehaya mesukkan veholichuhu meir leir bemitta vehayu kittot mitchallefot tachtav uvaacharona nimtza met velo timmeu chachamim ella kat acharona bilvad: 
Tame shehaya omed umedabber al habbor venitteza tzinora mippiv safek higgia labbor safek lo higgia. im haya bor shel shemen sefeko tame birshut hayyachid. veim haya bor shel yayin sefeko tahor bechol makom mippene shessefat habbor koletet:

Shenne shevilin echad tame veechad tahor halach beechad mihn veen yadua bee ze mehen halach veasa tohorot veneechlu vehizza shelishi ushevii vetaval vetahar vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot hare ellu tehorot. im kayyamot harishonot ellu veellu teluyot shebbevadday sheechad min hattohorot tame. veim lo tahar bentayim harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarfu shehare hen temeot bevadday shezze tame hu mippene shehalach bishne hashshevilin. vechen hashsheretz vehatztzefardea birshut harabbim veen tzuratan nikkeret veen yadua e zehu hashsheretz venaga beechad mehen veasa tohorot veneechlu vetaval venaga bashsheni veasa tohorot hare ellu tehorot. veim kayyamot harishonot ellu veellu teluyot. veim lo taval bentayim harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarfu: 
Shene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor halach beechad mehen veasa tohorot uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot im bau venishalu ze achar ze morin lechol echad mehen bifne atzmo shehu tahor. bau shenehen keechad o shebba haechad veshaal alav veal chavero veamar shenayim hayinu uvishne hashshevilim halachnu ushete tohorot asinu hare shenehem temein vetohorot sheasu nisrafot. vechen im nitmeu betuma kalla. ketzad. shene kikkarim echad tame veechad tahor achal et echad mehem veasa tohorot uva chavero veachal et hashsheni veasa tohorot im nishalu ze achar ze shenehen tehorin mippene shehen safek divre sofrim shehu mikkelal hassefekot shettiharu chachamim kemo shebbearnu. nishalu shenehen keachat o shennishal alav veal chavero shenehen temein missafek vetohorotam nisrafot shehare vadday achat mehen temea. vaafillu kikkar echad tame shennitarev bemea kikkarot tehorin kullan temein veyissarfu: 
Kikkar tame shennitarev betisha kikkarot tehorin uvau chamishsha bene adam veachlu chamishsha kikkarot mehen uvau chamishsha bene adam acherim veachlu hachamishsha hannisharim harishonim temeim mippene sheen lahen anashim acherim sheyyitlu bahen vehachamishsha haanashim haacharonim tehorin mippene shehen tolin barishonim: 
Shene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor vehalchu bahen shene anashim ish echad tahor veish echad tame afillu haya haechad taluy hare ze hattahor tole battaluy veomrin ze hattahor halach bashshevil hattahor vahare hu betohorato veze hattaluy halach bashshevil hattame. veaf al pi shennishalu shenehen keechad:

Kol makom shehu reshut harabbim leinyan shabbat kach hu reshut harabbim leinyan tuma: 
Arba ammot hassemuchot lirshut harabbim hare hen kirshut harabbim letuma. vechen hakkarmelit kegon hayyam vehaitztevavnit hare hen kirshut harabbim letuma: 
Yesh sham mekomot sheaf al pi shehen reshut hayyachid leshabbat hare hen kirshut harabbim leinyan tuma veellu hen. hashshevilin hamefullashin leshichin ulevorot ulegittot vehabbika hammukkefet gader bimot hachamma uvasilki melachim shehu binyan rachav harebe laamod bo anshe hammerkava veyesh lo petachim harebe petuchim lirshut harabbim vehapporan vehu habbinyan haggadol sheyyesh lo shene petachim ze keneged ze vechatzer sheharabbim nichnasin befetach ze veyotzin befetach acher. vechen mevoot hayyordim layyam o lannahar af al pi shehen gedurin mikkan umikkan verabbim metappesin veolin bahen vehabbimosot vehammerchatzaot hare hen kirshut harabbim letuma. vechen kol haazara kirshut harabbim letuma: 
Ginnot hair shedderech hair overet alehen reshut harabbim letuma: 
Hagginna bizman shehi mishtammeret reshut hayyachid uvizman sheenah mishtammeret reshut harabbim letuma. vechen basilki gedola bizman sheppotchin otah reshut harabbim letuma uvizman shennoalin otah reshut hayyachid lakkol: 
Habbika hammukkefet gader bimot haggeshamim reshut hayyachid leshabbat uletuma veim lo hayta mukkefet hare hi reshut hayyachid letuma bilvad. uvika sheavru aleha bimot haggeshamim hare hi reshut hayyachid letuma afillu bimot hachamma. veellu hen yemot hachamma mishshetteaker hattevua mittochah. veellu hen yemot haggeshamim mishshettered revia sheniyya. ben haiggulim shel anavim lazzogin reshut harabbim letuma: 
Kerem shellifne habbotzrim reshut hayyachid uleachar habbotzrim reshut harabbim letuma. ematay bizman sheharabbim nichnasim beruach zo veyotzim baruach shekkenegdah. shear kol hammekomot chutz meellu shebbearnu dinam keshem shehen reshut hayyachid leshabbat kach hem reshut hayyachid letuma: 
Veyesh mekomot sheenan reshut hayyachid leshabbat veaf al pi chen hen reshut hayyachid letuma mippene sheen haam mishtammeshin bahen veellu hen. hailanot vechore reshut harabbim af al pi sheen bahen arbaa al arbaa. ketzad. ilan shehu omed birshut harabbim vetuma betocho ala lerosho safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tame. hichnis yado lechor sheyyesh bo tuma safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tame: 
Chanut shehi temea ufetucha lirshut harabbim safek nichnas safek lo nichnas sefeko tahor shekkol hachanut kemo sheretz hammunnach birshut harabbim shessefek maggao tahor. hayu shete chanuyyot achat tehora veachat temea venichnas leachat mehen safek letame nichnas safek letahor sefeko tame shezze safek reshut hayyachid shehachanut reshut hayyachid. vechen bika bimot haggeshamim sheyyesh bah sadot harebe uvah sade achat temea veachat tehora veamar nichnasti levika zo veeni yodea im nichnasti leotah sade o lo nichnasti sefeko tame shessefek tuma birshut hayyachid afillu sefek bia tame: 
Makom shehaya reshut hayyachid venaasa reshut harabbim vechazar venaasa reshut hayyachid keshehu reshut hayyachid sefeko tame ucheshehu reshut harabbim sefeko tahor: 
Devarim shehen birshut harabbim hare hen kirshut harabbim. ketzad. kuppa birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim vehattuma betochah safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor. hichnis yado letochah safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tame. hayta kefisha netuna al ketefo vechikkar teruma karuch besiv o binyar venatun letochah safek naga bah acher safek lo naga sefeko tame: 
Chamor birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim vetuma netuna alav safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor. pashat yado al gabbav safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tame. vechen sela hammunnach birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim vetuma netuna alav safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor. ala berosh hassela safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tame: 
Haya zav rochev al chamoro veze rochev al chamoro umehallechin badderech safek naga bazzav safek lo naga. tinok tame murkav al ketefo shel aviv vetinok tahor murkav al ketefo shel aviv vehalchu ze betzad ze safek naga safek lo naga. chavila al ketefo veharok mudbak bakkotel safek naga safek lo naga. kelim shetuchin birshut harabbim lemala measara vehattame over safek hesit safek lo hesit hakkol tahor: berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Ownerless Property and Gi:
Hahefker kol hammachazik bo zacha. vechen hammidbarot vehanneharot vehannechalim kol shebbahen hefker vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. kegon haasavim vehaetzim vehapperot shel ilanot shel yaar vechayyotze bahen: 
Hatztzad dagim min hayyamim umin hanneharot. o shetztzad ofot o mine chayyot. hoil veen lahem bealim zacha. uvilvad shello yatzud bisde chavero. veim tzad sham kana. veim hayu haddagim babbevarim shel bealim vechen chayya veof shebbabbevarim. af al pi shehu bevar gadol vehu mechussar tzida hare ze shel baal habbevarim vehatztzad mishsham hare ze gazlan: 
Aval hallokeach dagim mittoch metzudato shel chavero keshehu betoch hayyam. o shellakach chayya mimmetzudato keshehi perusa bammidbar hare ze asur middivre sofrim. veim haya hammetzuda keli velakach mittoch hammetzuda hare ze gazlan: 
Happores metzuda bisde chavero vetzad bah chayya o of af al pi sheen lo reshut laasot davar ze kana. veim haya omed baal hassade betoch sadehu veamar zachta li sadi kana baal hassade. veen levaal hammetzuda kelum: 
Dagim shekkaftzu letoch hassefina kana baal hassefina. shezzo kechatzer hammishtammeret hi veenah chatzer hamehallechet. shehammayim hen shemmolichin otah veenah holechet mechamat atzmah: 
Ger shemmet velo holid yisrael achar shennitgayyer en lo yorshin ella kol hakkodem vehechezik binchasav zacha. veen baal hammetzar yachol lesalleko bedamim shezzo kemattana hi: 
Shete sadot benichse hagger umetzar echad benehen. hechezik beachat mehen liknotah kenaah. hechezik bah liknot otah veet chavertah. zo shehechzik bah kana aval chavertah lo kana. hechezik bah kede liknot et chavertah lo kana achat mehen. chavertah mippene shello hechezik bah. veotah mippene shello hechezik bah kede liknotah. hechezik bah kede liknotah veliknot et chavertah veet hammetzar shebbenehen. o shehechzik bammetzar liknot shetehen hare ze safek. veim ba echad vehechezik bah kede liknotah zacha haacharon: 
Vechen shene battim ze lefanim mizze shehechzik beechad mehen liknoto veliknot et hashsheni lo kana ella ze shehechzik bo bilvad. hechezik beechad mehen kede liknot et hashsheni af ze shehechzik bo lo kana: 
Hammachazik bishtar minnichse hagger kede liknot et hakkarka hakketuva beoto shetar lo kana ella hashshetar bilvad latzur al pi tzelochito vechayyotze baze: 
Sade hametzuyyenet bimtzareha kevan shehikkish bah makkosh echad kana et kullah. veim enah metzuyyenet bimtzareha kone mimmenna beoto makkosh kede sheyyelech hatztzemed bishat charisha veyachzor. hammetzar vehechatzav shemmetachamin bo techumin mafsikin benichse hagger. vechol hammachazik besade lo kana ella ad hammetzar o ad hechatzav: 
Kol hammafsik lefea mafsik benichse hagger. ketzad. haya sham nachal o ammat hammayim vechayyotze bahen lo kana ella ad hannachal o ad haamma. vechol hammafsik birshut shabbat mafsik benichse hagger kegon shehaya ben shete hassadot reshut hayyachid o karmelit afillu haya benehem reshut shecholeket legittin: 
Kol davar hammafsik letuma mafsik benichse hagger. ketzad. kegon shennichnas adam levika zo vetuma babbika betziddah acheret veeno yodea im higgia limkom hattuma im lav. kol makom shemmachazikin oto letuma hare hu kemakom acher, muchlak bifne atzmo: 
Bika gedola sheyyesh bah sadot rabbot vechullan shel ger echad velo haya benehen lo metzar velo chatzav velo davar middevarim hammafsikin. uva echad vehechezik bemiktzat habbika liknot et kullah. kol hannikra al shem oto hagger kone oto: 
Akkum shemmachar mittaltelin leyisrael o kana mittaltelin miyyisrael. kone bimshicha umakne bimshicha o bedamim. aval hakkarka eno kone oto miyyisrael ella bishtar veeno makne oto leyisrael ella bishtar sheen dato somechet ella al hashshetar. lefichach yisrael shellakach sade min haakkum venatan haddamim. vekodem sheyyachzik bah ba yisrael acher vehechezik bah kederech shemmachazikin benichse hagger zacha acharon venoten larishon et haddamim. mippene shehaakkum meet shellakach haddamim sillek reshuto veyisrael lo kana ad sheyyaggia hashshetar leyado. venimtzeu nechasim ellu kenichse midbar shekkol hammachazik bahen zacha: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheen mishpat yadua lammelech. aval im din oto hammelech umishpato shello yizke bakkarka ella mi shekkotev bishtar o hannoten damim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. osin kefi mishpat hammelech. shekkol dine hammelech bemamon al pihen danin:

Nichse ger sheen lo yorshim. venichse hahefker vesade shemmecharah haakkum leyisrael vaadayin lo hechezik bah. kullam dinam shave. kol hammachazik bahem bederech middarche hachazaka kemo shebbearnu behilchot mechira kana chutz meachilat happerot:

Ketzad. hallokeach karka mechavero vehechezik bah baachilat peroteha kana kemo shebbearnu. aval benichse hefker o nichse hagger afillu achal perot hailan kamma shanim lo kana guf hailan velo guf hakkarka ad sheyyaase maase beguf haaretz o yaavod avoda bailan. umaase beishsha achat sheachla perot dekel shelosh esre shana uva echad vehechezik bailan baavoda sheavad beguf hailan uva maase lifne chachamim veamru ze haacharon kana:

Yesh devarim rabbim sheim hechezik bahen hallokeach lo kana adayin. veim hechezik beechad mehen benichse hagger o benichse hefker kana. ketzad. hammotze palterim gedolim benuyin benichse hagger o benichse hefker vesiyyed bahen siyyud echad o kiyyer bahen kiyyur echad kegon amma o yoter keneged happetach kana:

Hatztzar tzura benichse hagger kana. vehammatztzia matztzaot benichse hagger kana. hannar et hassade benichse hagger kana. hamefatztzel zemorot haggefen o sarige ilanot vechappot temarim benichse hagger. im dato laavod hailan kana. veim dato lehaachil haetzim livhema lo kana:

Ketzad. haya koret mikkan umikkan hare chezkato shennitkavven laavodat hailan. haya koret meruach achat eno mitkavven ella laetzim. vechen hamelakket etzim vaasavim vaavanim min hassade. im dato letakken haaretz kana. veim laetzim lo kana:

Ketzad. likket haggas vehaddak hare zo bechezkat shennitkavven letakken et haaretz. likket haggas velo haddak hare ze bechezkat shennitkavven laetzim. vechen hammashve pene haaretz. im dato letakken haaretz kana. veim dato lehashevot makom sheyyaamid bo goren lo kana:

Ketzad. haya lokeach afar mimmakom gavoah venotno lammakom hannamuch hare ze metakken haaretz. reinuhu sheeno makpid al ze ella mashlich heafar vehatztzerorot bechol makom belo hakepada hare ze bechezkat sheeno mitkavven ella lehashevot makom ledayish. vechen happoteach mayim letoch haaretz. im letakken haaretz kana. veim latzud haddagim lo kana:
Ketzad. asa makom sheyyikkansu bo hammayim bilvad hare ze mitkavven letakken haaretz. asa shene petachim echad lehachenis veechad lehotzi hare ze mitkavven latzud dagim:

Habbone palterin gedolim benichse hagger uva acher veheemid lahem delatot kana haacharon. sheharishon lo asa beguf haaretz kelum. vahare hu kemi sheasa gal avanim al haaretz sheeno kone. shehare lo hoil begader ze mippene shehu rachav beyoter umefullash. veen tzurat oto habbinyan moelet lo ad sheyyaamid delatot:
Hammefitz hazzera letoch hattelamim lo kana. shebbeet shehishlich hazzera lo hishbiach kelum uveet shetztzamach vehishbiach shevach habba meelav hu veeno kone:

Hayta mechitztza benichse hagger uva ze veasa mechitztza acheret al gabbah lo kana. vaafillu nivlea mechitztza hattachtona vahare haelyona kayyemet. shebbeet shebbana lo hoil uveet shehoil meelav ba hammaase:
Hammachazik benichse hagger uvehefker vehu en dato liknot. af al pi shebbana vegadar lo kana:
Haoder benichse hagger vechassavur shehen shello lo kana. adar benichse ger ze uchesavur shel ger acher. hoil venitkavven bemaasav ellu lizkot min hahefker hare ze kana:
Haya mashkon yisrael beyad hagger ucheshemmet hagger ba yisrael acher vehechezik bemashkon ze. motziin oto miyyado. shekkevan shemmet hagger batel shibudo:
Haya mashkon hagger beyad yisrael uva yisrael acher vehechezik bo. lokeach mimmennu harishon keneged meotav vehaacharon kana et hashshear:
Bamme devarim amurim beshello haya hammashkon bachatzar harishon. aval im haya bachatzero chatzero kona lo shello middato kemo shebbearnu beinyan metzia. veen leze haacharon kelum:

Ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael et nechasav vehayu bahen avadim gedolim. kanu atzman bene chorin. aval haavadim hakketannim hare hen kivhema vechol hammachazik bahen zacha bahem. uchevar bearnu darche hachazaka sheyyiknu bahem et haavadim:

Ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael et nechasav. veshamu sheadayin lo met o sheyyesh lo ben o sheishto meubberet. kullan chayyavin lehachezir. hechziru kullan veachar kach shamu shemmet sheshshemua rishona emet hayta uvarishona met. o met beno mikkodem o hippila ishto. kol hammachazik bashsheniyya kana uvarishona lo kana:

Hannoten mattana lachavero en hamekabbel zoche bah ella beechad min hadderachim shehakkone zoche bahen bemikkacho. im mittaltelin rotze litten lo ad sheyyagbiah o sheyyimshoch davar sheen darko lehagebiah o yikne beechad mishshear haddevarim shehammittaltelin niknin bahen. veim karka o avadim natan lo ad sheyyachzik kederech shemmachzik hallokeach o ad sheyyaggia shetar mattana leyado. aval bidvarim lo zacha hamekabbel ella kol echad mehen adayin yachol lachzor bo: 
Machal lachavero chov sheyyesh lo alav. o natan lo happikkadon shehaya mufkad etzlo. hare zo mattana hanniknet bidvarim bilvad. veen tzarich davar acher kemo shebbearnu:
