Vechen haomer lachavero mane sheyyesh li beyadcha tenehu laze kana. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. ben shennatan hammane bechov sheyyesh lo etzlo ben shennetano lo mattana ben shehaya chov etzlo ben shehaya pikkadon etzlo kemo shebbearnu: 
Keshem sheen tzerichim edim leinyan mikkach umimkar ella legallot haddavar bilvad im hayta sham taana uchefira. kach bimchilot umattanot en tzerichin edim ella mippene hameshakkerim: 
Keshem shemmocher tzarich lesayyem hammimkar kemo shebbearnu kach hannoten. ketzad. hakkotev lachavero karka minnechasay netuna lecha. o shekkatav lo kol nechasay kenuyin lecha chutz mimmiktzatan. hoil velo siyyem haddavar shennatan lo veeno yadua lo kana kelum. veeno yachol lomar lo ten li pachut shebbinchasecha ad shessiyyem lo hammakom shennatan lo. aval im amar lo chelek kach vechach besade pelonit hoil vesiyyem hassade af al pi shello siyyem hachelek notel oto chelek min happachut shebbeotah sade: 
Kol hannoten mattana al tenay. ben shehitna noten ben shehitna hamekabbel. vehechezik hamekabbel vezacha bah. im nitkayyem hattenay nitkayyem hammattana veim lo nitkayyem hattenay betela hammattana veyachzir perot sheachal. vehu sheyyihye hattenay karauy: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol tenain sheyyesh bemattanot o bemikkach umimkar tzarich sheyyihye tenay kaful. vehen kodem lelav. utenay kodem lemaase. veyihye tenay sheefshar lekayyemo. veim chaser echad meellu hattenain batel ucheillu en sham tenay: 
Vechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dami veeno tzarich lichpol hattenay. kach horu miktzat haggeonim velaze dati nota. verabbotay horu sheen tzarich lichpol hattenay ulehakdim hen lelav ella begittin uvekiddushin bilvad. veen ledavar ze reaya: 
Hannoten mattana al menat lehachezir hare zo mattana. ben shehitna lehachezir miyyad ben shehitna lehachezirah lizman katzuv. o kol yeme chayyav shel echad mehem. o kol yeme chayyav shel peloni. hare zo mattana ben bemittaltelin ben bekarka. veochel perot kol zeman hammattana: 
Haomer lachavero shor ze ani noten lecha bemattana al menat shettachzirehu. hikdisho vehecheziro hare ze mukdash umuchzar. amar lo al menat shettachzirehu li eno kadosh. shello hitna alav ella sheyyachzir davar harauy lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asur leyisrael litten leakkum mattenat chinnam. aval noten hu leger toshav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenachri", bimchira velo bemattana. aval leger toshav ben bimchira ben bintina mippene sheatta metzuvve lehacheyoto. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "ger vetoshav vachay immach": 
Hannoten mattana leeved o leishsha kana habbaal vehaadon. ella shehaadon kone lagguf vehabbaal kone otah leferot: 
Natan mattana leishsha al menat sheen levalah reshut bah. uleeved al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo. kana haadon vekana habbaal. aval hannoten mattana leishsha o leeved vehitna immahen hannoten begufah shel mattana shettihye lechach vechach. lo kana haadon velo kana habbaal: 
Ketzad. hannoten mattana leishsha veamar lah hare hammaot haellu netunim lecha bemattana al menat shettilbeshi bahen o al menat shettishti bahem vetaasi ma shettirtzi belo reshut habbaal. lo kana habbaal. vechen im amar leeved al menat shettochal bahen vetishte bahen. al menat shettetze bahem lecherut. o al menat shettaase bahem kol ma shettirtze belo reshut adon shellecha. lo kana haadon. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hannoten kol nechasav leavdo kana atzmo veyatza ben chorin vekana shear hannechasim. veim shiyyer kol shehu afillu mittaltelin lo kana kelum sheen ze get cherut gamur shehare shiyyer bo beget umittoch shello nishtachrer lo kana kelum:

Hamekabbel et hammattana vezacha bah. veachar shebbaa leyado vehu shotek chazar bo veamar eni rotze bah. o eni mekabbelah. o hare hi betela. o sheamar mum ze nire li bah. lo amar kelum. ucheshem sheen hannoten yachol lachzor bo kach hamekabbel eno yachol lachzor bo achar shezzacha. mattana zo sheamar hamekabbel eni rotze bah achar shebbat leyado hare hi hefker vechol hakkodem bah zacha bah shehare hifkirah hamekabbel achar shezzacha bah. aval im haya tzoveach meikkaro lo kana hamekabbel vechozeret labbealim harishonim: 
Hamezakke lachavero bemattana al yede acher kevan shehechzik bah acher kegon shemmashach hammittaltelin o higgia shetar hakkarka leyado o hechezik bakkarka zacha chavero af al pi shello higgia hammattana leyado veen hannoten yachol lachzor bo. aval hamekabbel yado al haelyona im ratza mekabbel im lo ratza eno mekabbel shezzachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav uzechut hu shettinnaten lo mattana im yirtze. aval im lo yirtze en notnin mattana leadam beal karcho: 
Zikka lo al yede acher uchesheshshama hamekabbel shatak veachar kach tzavach veamar eni mekabbelah. hare ze safek im ze sheshshatak kevar ratza veze shechazar vetzavach chazar bo. o sheshshatak mippene sheadayin lo higgia leyado kelum veze shetztzavach hochiach sofo al techillato. lefichach im kadam acher vezacha bah leatzmo en motziin miyyado. shemma hamekabbel zacha vechevan sheamar eni rotze bah hare hifkirah kemo shebbearnu. veze shekkadam ulekachah min hahefker zacha. veim chazru habbealim harishonim utefasuha miyyad ze shekkadam vezacha bah en motziin otah miyyadam. shemma hamekabbel lo zacha vechevan sheamar eni rotze hochiach sofo al techillato velo kana otah uvirshut bealim harishonim hi kayyemet adayin: 
Reuven sheratza litten mea dinarin leshimon veshalach lo hammea al yede levi. im amar lo zeche bemea zuz leshimon. o ten mea zuz leshimon. eno yachol lachzor bo. aval im amar lo holech mea zuz leshimon yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyaggia hammea leyad shimon: 
Halach levi bemea zuz shennishtallechu immo leholichan leshimon uvikkesh shimon velo metzaahu yachzir liruven. met shimon bechayye reuven yachzir liruven o leyorshav. met reuven bechayye shimon yitten hammea leshimon o leyorshav shemmitzva lekayyem divre hammet veaf al pi sheamar haddevarim vehu bari. shehare hammea beyado shel shaliach adayin: 
En adam zoche bemattana lachavero ad sheyyihye hazzoche gadol uven daat. veechad ish veechad ishsha vaafillu eshet ish veeved veshifcha. aval haakkum eno zoche hoil veen rauy lishlichut leolam kach eno zoche leyisrael. ucheshem sheen yisrael naase shaliach leakkum kach eno zoche leakkum: 
Katan shennotnin lo tzeror vezorko egoz venotlo zoche leatzmo veeno zoche laacherim. pachot mizze lo zacha leatzmo velo laacherim. vechen hashshote eno zoche lo lo velo laacherim. vehamezakke leshote al yede ben daat zacha. aval hacheresh zoche leatzmo kemo shebbearnu behilchot gezela: 
Zachin lekatan afillu ben yom echad. ulegadol ben befanav ben shello befanav. vachatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato af al pi sheeno omed sham kevan shehiggia hammattana lachatzero keillu zacha bah acher: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechatzer hammishtammeret. aval bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret kegon sadehu vechurbato ad sheyyihye omed betziddah veyomar zachta li sadi. vechen arba ammot shel adam shehu omed betziddan konin lo besimta o betzidde reshut harabbim o bechatzer sheen lah bealim. aval birshut harabbim o bisde chavero eno zoche ad sheyyaggia mattana leyado. uketanna tizke lah chatzerah vearba ammot shellah. aval hakkatan eno zoche ad shettaggia mattana leyado o ad sheyyizke lo acher: 
Hammattana keget, sheen adam yachol limsor devarim leshaliach. ketzad. amar lishlosha imru lifloni ufeloni sheyyichtevu veyachtemu bishtar mattana veyittenuha lifloni en ze kelum. veim amru leotan haedim vechatvu venatnu lamkabbel lo kana. vechen im amar lishnayim kitvu vechitmu bishtar mattana utenuhu lifloni enan yecholin lomar lassofer lichtov ella hen atzman kotvin kemo beget: 
Hakkotev bishtar natatti sade pelonit lifloni. o shekkatav netattiha lo o hare hi shello. hare zoche bah kesheyyaggia hashshetar leyado. aval im katav bashshetar ettenenna lo. af al pi sheheidu alav haedim. lo zacha hamekabbel ad sheyyomar laedim kitvu shetar mattana utenu lo vechotvin venotnin lo. sheen hamekabbel zoche ad sheyyaggia shetar hammattana leyado o ad sheyyizke lo bo al yede acherim kemo shebbearnu: 
Haomer natatti sade pelonit lifloni vehu omer lo natan li. choshshin shemma zikka lo al yede acher. aval im amar katavti venatatti lo vehu omer lo katav velo natan li. im hamekabbel mattana hu sheamar ken. hodaat baal din kemea edim hu vehannoten ochel perot sadehu. veim ben hamekabbel hu sheamar lo natatta leavi sade zo vehu omer katavti venatatti lo. mannichin et happerot al yede shalish ad sheyyivvada haddavar heach hu: 
Mekabbel mattana shettaan veamar zo shettachat yadi enah mattana beyadi ella shomer ani aleha vechayyotze bo. o sheamar betela hayta mittechillatah lefi shello kibbaltiha o beal karchi beones o betaut vechayyotze bidvarim ellu devarav kayyamin. venishba al ze shevuat hesset vetachzor livaleha: 
Taan hannoten veamar shomer atta aleha o sheamar shello middati netattiha o gezula hi beyadcha veze omer atta natatta li. nishba hamekabbel shevuat hesset veniftar:

Hannoten mattana ben bari ben chole tzarich shettihye geluya umefursemet. amar leedim kitvu basseter utenu lo enah kelum. shezze maarim kede leabbed mamon acherim sheyyachazor veyimkor achar sheyyitten: 
Lefichach kol shetar mattenat karka sheen katuv bo veamar lanu peloni hannoten shevu bashshevakim uvarchovot vechitvu lo mattana geluya umefursemet vechayyotze beinyanim ellu choshshin lah shemma mattana mesutteret hi velo zacha hamekabbel: 
Hakkotev shete mattanot al sade achat harishona mesutteret vehaacharona geluya umefursemet acharon kana vaafillu hayta harishona setam veen bah lo inyan setira velo inyan gilluy ella mattana setam haacharon kana: 
Kevar bearnu shehammoser modaa veachar kach natan hammattana betela af al pi sheen ze ones. sheen holchin bemattana ella achar daat hannoten. hoil vegilla dato sheeno rotze bah mattenato betela. lefichach mi shehayu haddevarim mochichin sheen dato litten mattana zo afillu shennetanah mattana geluya venimtzet shennittena mikkodem mattana mesutteret hare shete hammattanot betelot. harishona mippene shehi mesutteret. vehashsheniyya mippene shehaddavar mochiach sheeno rotze vahare kadma zo hammattana shennimtzea kemo modaa lah: 
Maase beechad sheratza lissa ishsha. amra lo eni nisset lecha ad shettichtov li kol nechasecha. shama beno haggadol vetzavach al shemmannicho rekan. amar laedim lechu vehechavu vechitvu lo kol nechasay bemattana. veachar kach katav lah kol nechasav unesaah. uva maase lifne chachamim veamru habben lo kana vehaishsha lo kanta. shehare lo birtzono katav lah ucheanus baddavar hu. shehare gilla dato bammattana harishona af al pi shehi betela mippene shehi mesutteret. vechen kol kayyotze beinyanim ellu: 
Shene shetarot shezzemannan beyom echad vehen ketuvin al sade achat ben bemecher ben bemattana. im derech anshe hammakom lichtov shaot kol hakkodem zacha. veim en derech hammakom lichtov shaot hare haddavar masur laddayyanim. kol sheddatam nota lehaamid sade zo beyado yaamidu: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishtar sheen bo kinyan ella kana sade zo bishtar ze. sheen anu yodin mi hu mishshenehem shehiggia shetaro leyado techilla. aval im haya bechol shetar mehen kinyan kol shekkadam lo hakkinyan zacha veyishalu haedim. vechen im hayu sham edim shezze higgia leyado shetar mattenato techilla kana harishon: 
Shene shetarot hayyotzim al sade achat beshem kone echad veen zemannam shave. im haya shetar echad mecher veechad mattana. im haya hashshetar harishon mattana vehashsheni sheacharav mecher lo bittel haacharon et harishon. sheyyesh lomar lehosif lo acharayut chazar vechatav beshem mecher af al pi shello haya kotev sham acharayut sheacharayut taut sofer hu. vechen im harishon mecher vehashsheni mattana kana hassade mizzeman rishon. shello katav lo shetar mattana ella leyappot kocho umishshum din ben hammetzar: 
Hayu shene hashshetarot bemecher o shenehem bemattana. im hosif bashsheni kelum hare harishon kayyam shello katav hashsheni ella mippene hattosefet. veim lo hosif bittel shetar sheni et harishon veen lo acharayut ella mizzeman hashsheni. lefichach kol happerot sheachal hallokeach mizzeman rishon ad zeman sheni machzir otam. veim haya al otah sade chok lammelech bechol shana. hannoten o hammocher noten oto hachok ad zeman hashshetar hashsheni:

Leolam omdin daat hannoten. im hayu haddevarim marin sof dato osin al pi haomed af al pi shello peresh. ketzad. mi shehalach beno limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet vechatav kol nechasav leacher mattana geluya gemura veachar kach ba beno en mattenato kayyemet. shehaddevarim mochichin sheillu yada shebbeno kayyam lo haya noten kol nechasav. lefichach im shiyyer minnechasav kol shehu ben karka ben bemittaltelin mattenato kayyemet: 
Vechen hakkotev kol nechasav mattana leechad mibbanav ben shehaya bari ben shehaya shechiv mera. afillu haya ben katan hammuttal baarisa lo asahu ella appotroppos. vahare hu bechol hannechasim keechad meechav. umdan daat hu shello nitkavven ella lihyot echav nishmain lo. veim shiyyer kol shehu ben karka ben bemittaltelin zacha habben bemattana: 
Bamme devarim amurim shekkatav leven ben habbanim. aval im katav kol nechasav leven ben habbanot o levat ben habbanot o leechad min hayyorshin ben shear hayyorshin. af al pi shello shiyyer kelum mattenato kayyemet: 
Vechen hakkotev kol nechasav leishto ben bari ben shechiv mera af al pi shekkanu miyyado lo asaah ella appotroppa al yorshav. ben shehayu yorshe banav mimmenna o meishsha acheret o echav o shear yorshav. veim shiyyer kol shehu ben karka ben mittaltelin kanta kol shekkatav lah: 
Bamme devarim amurim binsua. aval im katav kol nechasav leishto arusa o ligrusha af al pi shello shiyyer kelum hare hi kishar bene adam umattenato kayyemet: 
Hakkotev kol nechasav leechad mibbanav uleacher. ze haacher kana chatzi hannechasim bemattana. venishar hachetzi levanav. vehabben shennatnu lo appotroppos minnahu al shear echav: 
Vechen im katav kol nechasav leishto uleacher. ze haacher kana mechetza veishto appotroppa al mechetza: 
Kol ishsha shekkanta kol nichse balah bemattana. ibbeda ketubbatah vetikkara. lefichach im yatza shetar chov alav vehalchu kol hannechasim bechovo shekkadam hammattana tishshaer hi belo kelum velo tikkach bichtubbatah shekkadma hachov. sheumdan daat hu shebbahanaa shebbaa lah bishmua zo shekkatav lah kol nechasav ibbeda kol zechut sheyyesh lah bannechasim chutz mimmattana zo: 
Vechen hakkotev nechasav levanav ben zecharim ben nekevot ben bari ben shechiv mera vechatav leishto immahen karka kol shehu. hoil veasa otah shuttaf ben habbanim velo machata ibbeda ketubbatah veenah torefet minnechasim ellu kelum. aval minnechasav sheyyavou lo achar ellu notelet mehen ketubbatah: 
Katav lah immahen mittaltelin bilvad o sheshshiyyer leatzmo karka kol shehu. ketubbatah kayyemet. vetakkanat haggeonim hi sheafilu shiyyer mittaltelim kol shehu. shehare hi omeret mimma sheshshiyyer ani gova umittoch shettered lema sheshshiyyer tered lishar nechasim vetitrof: 
Hakkotev kol nechasav levanav vechatav leishto chelek immahen. umet echad min habbanim bechayye aviv. hare zo tigbe ketubbatah mechelek ze shemmet. shello ibbeda ketubbatah ella millitrof mehen: 
Harotza lehinnase vechatva kol nechaseha ben livnah ben leacher. veachar kach nisset venitgarsha o shemmet balah. mattenatah betela shezzo mavrachat hi velo katva kol nechaseha ella lehaveriach mibbalah shello yirashenna. ucheshettihye tzericha lahen yachzeru lah. lefichach im meta hi bechayye balah kana hamekabbel mattana et hakkol. veim shiyyera kelum afillu mittaltelin mattenatah kayyemet veaf al pi shennitgarsha enah chozeret: 
Kol hannotnin kol nichsehem. mishshettibbatel hammattana veyachzeru kol hannechasin labbealim harishonim en hamekabbel mattana machzir perot. sheafilu natan haadam mattana beferush al menat lehachezir kol yeme chayye peloni hare ze ochel perot kol zeman hammattana kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi sheshshalach kelim mimmedinat hayyam veamar yinnatnu ellu levanay. hare ellu yinnatnu labbanim velabbanot. harauy labbanim kegon sefarim uchele milchama labbanim. veharauy labbanot kegon kele meshi hatztzevuim vachali zahav yittelum habbanot. hayu reuyin lizcharim velinkevot yittelu otan hazzecharim. vechen hameshalleach kelim leveto setam vehayu bahen kelim haruyin levanot. yittelu otan benotav. umdan daat hu shellahen shalach. veim en lo banot o shehayu benotav nesuot. yittelu otan neshe banav. shehaddaat nota shellahen shalach: 
Hammassi beno gadol livtula babbayit kana habbayit. vehu sheyyihyu nissuin rishonim leze habben. velo hissi haav ben acher kodem lo velo shiyyer haav beze habbayit sheyyiched lo kelum. udevarim ellu kahalacha sheen lahem taam hem. venagu chachamim baddavar hazze meumdan haddaat. shemmerov simchato veahavato gamar vehiknahu habbayit. shehare lo shiyyer bah leatzmo kelum. lefichach im shiyyer sham afillu pach echad lo kana habbayit. yiched lo bayit uchele bayit af al pi sheshshiyyer babbayit keli echad leatzmo o haya lo sham otzar vechayyotze bo. kana kele habbayit aval habbayit lo kana: 
Yiched lo bayit vaaliyya. bayit kana aliyya lo kana. vechen im yiched lo bayit veachsadra bayit kana achsadra lo kana. shene battim ze lefanim mizze lo kana ella haechad shennasa bo: 
Kevar bearnu benissuin sheshshenayim shehaya benehem shidduchin ufasak ze al yede beno veze al yede bitto. veamru kamma atta noten levincha. kach vechach. vechamma atta noten levittecha. kach vechach. veamdu vekiddeshu. kanu baamira. veen konin baamira zo ad sheat nissuin shekkol happosek dato lichnos. utzerichin sheyyihyu haddevarim shehen poskin metzuyin birshuto. sheen adam makne davar shello ba laolam kemo shebbearnu. udevarim ellu lo nittenu lehikkatev. lefichach enan kishtar ad sheyyitrof bahen: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha. afillu kiddeshah beelef dinar. ben shechazra hi ben shechazar hu. ben shemmet hu ben shemmeta hi. en hakkiddushin chozrin leolam. ella hare hen mattana gemura sheen lahem chazara: 
Veim hayu kiddushe taut chozrin hammaot: 
Vhamekaddesh achoto hammaot mattana. adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baarayot veen ze toe ella gamar venatan leshem mattana: 
Hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv ben merubbin ben muatin. ben sheachal sham seudat erusin ben shello achal. ben shemmet hu ben shemmeta hi. o shechazar bo haish. yachzeru hassivlonot kullan chutz min hammaachol vehammashke: 
Vechen kelim muatim sheshshalach lah lehishtammesh sham bevet aviha. im nishtammesha bahen uvalu o avdu enan mishtallemin. aval im hayu kayyamin chozer hakkol vegove otam bevet din. shehaddavar yadua shello shelacham ella derech noy bilvad: 
Chazra hi bah chozer hakkol. vaafillu hammaachol vehammashke notenet damav bezol. uchevar hiskimu haggeonim sheim hayu deme maachol umashke [shave] shishsha mishtallemet arbaa im chazra bah. shello natan lah mattana zo ella ledaat shello tachzor bah: 
Horu rabbotay sheim haya minhag hammedina sheyyaase kol adam seuda veyaachil lereav o yechallek maot lashshammashin velachazzanin vechayyotze bahen veasa kederech sheosin kol haam vechazra bah meshallemet hakkol. shehare garma lo leabbed mamon vechol haggorem leabbed mamon chavero meshallem. vehu sheyyihyu lo edim kamma hotzi. sheen ze nishba venotel:

Minnehag pashut berov hammedinot shebbizman sheyyissa adam ishsha meshallechin lo reav umeyuddaav maot kede sheyyitchazzek bahen al hahotzaa shemmotzi beishto. uvaim otan hareim vehameyuddaim sheshshalchu lo veochlin veshotin im hechatan beshivat yeme hammishte o bemiktzatan. hakkol keminhag hammedina. veellu hammaot shemmeshallechin nikrain shoshvinut. veotam sheshshalchu hammaot veochlin veshotin im hechatan nikraim shoshvinin:

Hashshoshvinut enah mattana gemura. haddevarim yeduim shello shalach ze asara dinarin bishvil sheyyochal veyishte baze velo shalach ella mippene shebbedato haya sheim yissa hu ishsha yachzor veyishlach lo kemo sheshshalach lo. lefichach im nasa ze ishsha velo hechzir lo hashshoshvinut hare ze tovo bedin umotzi mimmennu:

Veen yachol letavo ad sheyyissa kederech shennasa hu. ketzad. reuven shennasa betula veshshalach lo shimon shoshvinut veachar kach nasa shimon almana. eno yachol litboa lehachezir lo hashshoshvinut shehare omer lo eni machzir lecha ella bivtula kemo shennatatta li. vechen im shalach lo benissue almana eno yachol letavo lehachezir lo benissue betula:
Asa reuven mishte begaluy uvefarhesya veasa shimon betzina. o sheasa reuven betzina veshimon befarhesya eno yachol letavo. shehare omer lo eni ose immecha ella kederech sheasita immi:

Reuven shennasa ishsha veshalach lo shimon shoshvinut veachal veshata immo veachar kach nasa shimon kenissue reuven atzman uva reuven veachal veshata immo. o shekkara lo shimon velo ratza lavo. o shehaya bammedina veshama kol tavla bemakom sheen darkan likrot echad echad ella kol hashshomea yavo. veshama velo ba. chayyav lehachezir lo hashshoshvinut kullah. shehare yada velo ba o kara lo bemakom sheddarkan likrot echad echad velo ba:

Lo haya reuven bammedina menakkin lo deme ma sheachal veshata shimon etzlo umachazir lo shear hashshoshvinut. vechen im haya bammedina velo keraahu o lo hodio menakkin lo veyesh lo alav taromet mippene shello hodio:

Vechamma menakkin. nahagu benikkuy im dinar echad shalach lo shimon eno machzir lo kelum shehare ze deme ma sheachal. veim yitter al haddinar ad sela menakke lo mechetza. missela ulemala omdin daat hameshalleach:
Veshiur hashshoshvinut im adam chashuv menakke lo mechetza. veim tzar ayin umedakdek behotzaato eno menakke lo ella shiur ma sheachal veshata umeshallem lo hashshear:
Met shimon kodem sheyyissa ishsha o shennasa umet betoch yeme hammishte en reuven chayyav lehachezir leyorshe shimon kelum shehare omer lahem tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo:

Lefichach im samach immo veachar kach met shimon. o kara lo velo ba o shello haya bammedina o shello hodio. hoil veshalmu yeme hammishte veachar kach met shimon. chayyav reuven lehachezir hashshoshvinut leyorshav o kullah o benikkuy im lo hodio o lo haya immo bammedina:

Met reuven veachar kach nasa shimon ishsha veshalmu yeme hammishte. makom shennahagu ligbot hashshoshvinut miyyorshin kofin yorshe reuven lehachezir benikkuy. umakom shello nahagu en hayyorshin meshallemin kelum:

Met reuven achar shennasa shimon ishsha veshalmu yeme hammishte. kofin et yorshav umeshallemin hashshoshvinut bechol makom. shehare nitchayyev avihen leshallem. veim kullah haya chayyav leshallem meshallemin kullah. veim benikkuy meshallemin benikkuy:

Chamishsha devarim neemru bashshoshvinut. nigbet bevet din sheenah ella kemo milve. veenah mishtallemet ella beonatah keen nissue rishon. shezze kemo tenay hu af al pi shello peresh sheal daat ze shelachah. veen bah mishshum ribbit. afillu shalach lo dinar vehechzir lo asara muttar shello al menat lehosif lo shalach. veen hashsheviit meshammattah sheeno yachol liggosho oto uletavo ad sheyyissa kederech shennasa hu. veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim keshettachzor layyorshin mippene shehu rauy veen habbechor notel barauy kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Hashsholeach teshura lachavero. o shennatan lo maot keshemmata yado vehu memaen likkach. veze nishba shei efshar shello tikkach vehiftzir bo ad shellakach. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. af al pi shello peresh hare ellu mattana. veeno yachol lachzor hu velitboa ad sheyyefaresh shehu milve:
Vechen hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen uferot beet hannissuin. en nigbin bevet din. mippene shehi gemilut chasadim. velo neemru dine shoshvinut ella bemaot bilvad:
Hasuma o happisseach. o haggiddem. o hachoshesh berosho. o beeno. o beyado o beraglo vechayyotze bahen hare hu kevari lechol devarav bemikkacho o bemimkaro umattenotav:

Aval hachole shettashash koach kol hagguf. vechashal kocho mechamat hacholi ad sheeno yachol lehallech al raglo bashshuk vahare hu nofel al hammitta. hu [hannikra] shechiv mera. umishpete mattenotav enam kemattenat bari. ketzad. shechiv mera shetztzivva veamar litten lifloni kach vechach ben bechol ben beshabbat. ben katav ben lo katav. zachu hakkol kesheyyamut bechol ma shennatan lahem veeno tzarich kinyan. sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin hen. vedavar ze middivre sofrim. veaf al pi sheeno ella middivrehem asu otah keshel tora. kede shello tittaref dato alav kesheyyeda sheen devarav kayyamim:
Lefichach im amar kenu mimmenni. afillu beshabbat konin mimmennu, shezze hakkinyan eno tzarich:
Veen shechiv mera tzarich lomar attem eday. ella kol hashshomea et devarav hare ze ed. sheen adam meshatte bishat mita:
Shechiv mera shetztzivva latet mattana leubbar shebbime immo. zacha haubbar mippene sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno kemo shebbearnu:

Amar im yalda ishti zachar yittol mane veim nekeva matayim. veyalda zachar. notel mane. yalda nekeva notelet matayim. yalda zachar unekeva hazzachar notel mane vehannekeva matayim. yalda tumtum veanderoginus notel kappachut shebbishnehem:

Shechiv mera sheamru lo nechasav lemi. veamar lahem dome sheyyesh lo ben o sheishto meubberet. achshav sheen lo ben o sheen ishto meubberet nechasav lifloni. venoda sheyyesh lo ben o shehayta ishto meubberet af al pi shehippila o met habben achar kach. en mattenato mattana:
Mattenat shechiv mera enah kona ella leachar mita. veen acher zoche baddavar shetztzivva lo ben mekarkein ben mittaltelin ella leachar mita:

Lefichach motziin lichtubbat haishsha umezon haalmana vehabbanot miyyad ellu shetztzivva latet lahem. shehare bemitato nitchayyevu hannechasim bichtubba uvimzonot. veellu shennatan lahem lo yiknu ella leachar mita:

Mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan. ben shehayta bemiktzat nechasav ben shehayta bechol nechasav. choshshin lah shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar. vehoil umattana zo lo tikkane ella leachar mita. en shetar leachar mita vahare hammattana betela:
Veim kanu mimmennu kede leyappot koach hamekabbel. kegon shekkatuv vekaninu mimmennu mosif al mattana zo. hare hi kayyemet:
Shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utenu lifloni mane. umet kodem sheyyichtevu veyittenu lo. en kotvin veen notnin. shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita:
Veim amar kitvu. kede leyappot koach hamekabbel. kegon sheamar tenu mane lifloni veamar veaf kitvu utenu lo. hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin leachar mita:

Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav mattana setam velo shiyyer kelum. im amad chozer. vaafillu kanu miyyado kede leyappot et kocho. ben shehikna kol nechasav leechad ben shekketavam lishnayim. sheomed daat hu shello natan ze hakkol ella shennitkavven shello yiknu kelum ella leachar moto:

Shiyyer kelum leatzmo ben karka ben mittaltelin. hare zo mattana bemiktzat usetamah kemattenat bari shekkone mizzeman hakketiva. lefichach eno chozer. vehu shekkanu miyyado. shemmattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat tzericha kinyan. ben amad ben lo amad:
Bamme devarim amurim beshennatan setam. shehare anu omdin dato veomrin hoil veshiyyer lo nitkavven ella lehakenot lo mechayyim bemattenat bari:

Aval im natan lo hammiktzat beferush bemattenat shechiv mera sheeno ella leachar mita eno tzarich kinyan. veim amad chozer. veim lo amad kana ze hammiktzat. veim haya bah kinyan lo kana ella im ken haya meyappe kocho kemo shebbearnu:

Al tite bishchiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav uferesh shennatan hakkol meachshav vehikna mechayyim. sheen ze mattenat shechiv mera ella kishar kol mattenot habberiim. sheim higgia hashshetar leyad hamekabbel o shekkanu miyyad hannoten kana hakkol veen yachol lachzor bo:

Hannoten mattana keshehu shechiv mera vechatav bah bachayyim uvammavet o mechayyim uvammavet. ben bakkol ben bemiktzat. hoil vechatuv bo uvammavet hare zo mattenat shechiv mera. shezzo shekkatuv bah uvammavet shello yikne ella leachar mita. veze shekkatuv bah mechayyim siman leyashshev et dato sheyyichye mecholi ze:

Shechiv mera shennatan hannechasim shehaddavar galuy shehen kol nechasim sheyyesh lo. hare ze kemattana bemiktzat veim kanu miyyado veamad eno chozer. choshshin anu shemma nisharu lo nechasim acherim bimdinat hayyam. ad sheyyomar kol nechasay shehen ellu o shehaya muchzak sheen lo nechasim ella ellu. veachar kach tihye hammattana bakkol:

Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim. roin. im kimchallek ketavam. met kanu kullan. amad chozer bechullan. veim kenimlach achar sheshshiyyer chazar vechatav vekanu miyyado al kol echad veechad. met kanu kullan. amad eno chozer ella baacharon shehare natan lo kol hannechasim hannisharim:
Hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved. shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin:
Shechiv mera shetztzivva mechamat mita. kegon shehayta dato nota shehu met vadday. venikkar davar ze mikkelal devarav. af al pi shekkanu miyyado bemiktzat im amad chozer:

Vehamefaresh bayyam. vehayyotze beshayyara. vehayyotze bekolar. vehamesukkan vehu shekkafatz alav hacholi vehichbid alav chalyo. kol echad mearbatan kimtzavve mechamat mita. vahare devarav kichtuvin vechimsurin umekayyemin otan im met. veim nitztzal veamad afillu kanu miyyado bemiktzat chozer. kedin kol metzavve mechamat mita:
Shechiv mera shennittak mecholi lecholi. im lo amad velo halach al mishanto bashshuk mattenato mattana:

Amad ben hacholi shetztzivva bo uven hacholi shemmet mimmennu vehalach al mishanto. omdin oto al pi rofim. im mechamat choli harishon met mattenato kayyemet veim lav en mattenato kayyemet. veim halach bashshuk belo mishenet eno tzarich omed ella batlu mattenotav harishonot:

Mattenat shechiv mera sheen katuv bah shemmittoch hacholi hazze shetztzivva bo met veen haedim metzuyin lishl lahem. af al pi shehare ze hametzavve met. hare hammattana betela. sheen mitato reaya. shemma mecholi shennatan bo hammattana nirpa veachar kach chala choli acher umet. lefichach hannechasim bechezkat hayyorshin. ad sheyyavi reaya shemmittoch hacholi hazze shennatan bo mattana zo met:
